4.102.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
smarayāmi hṛṣīkeśa yannoktaṃ bhavatā kvacit ..
tatsāvitrīvrataṃ brūhi mamopari dayāṃ kuru .. 1 ..
4.102.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
स्मरयामि हृषीकेश यन्नोक्तं भवता क्वचित् ॥
तत्सावित्रीव्रतं ब्रूहि ममोपरि दयां कुरु ॥ 1 ॥
4.102.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / “I remind you, O Hṛṣīkeśa, of that which was not spoken by you anywhere: / tell me of that Sāvitrīvrata; have compassion on me.”

4.102.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kathayāmi kulastrīṇāṃ mahābhāgyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
yathā cīrṇaṃ vratavaraṃ sāvitryā rājakanyayā .. 2 ..
4.102.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
कथयामि कुलस्त्रीणां महाभाग्यं युधिष्ठिर ॥
यथा चीर्णं व्रतवरं सावित्र्या राजकन्यया ॥ 2 ॥
4.102.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / “I shall tell, O Yudhiṣṭhira, of the great good fortune of noble women, / and how the excellent votive observance was performed by the royal maiden Sāvitrī.

4.102.s:
āsīnmadreṣu dharmātmā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ ..
pārthivośvapatirnāma paurajānapadapriyaḥ .. 3 ..
4.102.d:
आसीन्मद्रेषु धर्मात्मा सर्वभूतहिते रतः ॥
पार्थिवोश्वपतिर्नाम पौरजानपदप्रियः ॥ 3 ॥
4.102.m: In Madra there was a righteous king named Aśvapati, devoted to the welfare of all beings, / dear to the citizens and the country-folk.

4.102.s:
kṣamāvāṃśca kṣitipatiḥ satyavāṃśca jitendriyaḥ ..
sa sabhāryo vratamidaṃ cacāra nṛpatiḥ svayam .. 4 ..
4.102.d:
क्षमावांश्च क्षितिपतिः सत्यवांश्च जितेन्द्रियः ॥
स सभार्यो व्रतमिदं चचार नृपतिः स्वयम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.102.m: The lord of the earth was forgiving, truthful, and had subdued his senses; / accompanied by his wife, that ruler personally undertook this votive observance,

4.102.s:
sāvitrīvratasiddhaṃ tatsarvakāmapradāyakam ..
tasya tuṣṭābhavadrājansāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā .. 5 ..
4.102.d:
सावित्रीव्रतसिद्धं तत्सर्वकामप्रदायकम् ॥
तस्य तुष्टाभवद्राजन्सावित्री ब्रह्मणः प्रिया ॥ 5 ॥
4.102.m: that well-accomplished Sāvitrīvrata, granter of all desires. / Sāvitrī, beloved of Brahmā, became pleased with him, O king.

4.102.s:
bhūrbhuvaḥsvaritītyeṣā sākṣānmūrtimatī sthitā ..
kamaṃḍaludharā devī prasannavadanekṣaṇā .. 6 ..
4.102.d:
भूर्भुवःस्वरितीत्येषा साक्षान्मूर्तिमती स्थिता ॥
कमंडलुधरा देवी प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणा ॥ 6 ॥
4.102.m: Standing visibly embodied as the [words] ‘bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ’, / holding a water-pot, the goddess had a gracious face and eyes.

4.102.s:
uvāca duhitā hyekā tava rājanbhaviṣyati ..
ityevamuktvā sāvitrī jagāmādarśanaṃ punaḥ .. 7 ..
4.102.d:
उवाच दुहिता ह्येका तव राजन्भविष्यति ॥
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सावित्री जगामादर्शनं पुनः ॥ 7 ॥
4.102.m: She said: ‘A single daughter shall indeed be born to you, O king.’ / Having spoken thus, Sāvitrī disappeared once again.

4.102.s:
kālena sā tathā rājanduhitā devarūpiṇī ..
sāvitryā prītayā dattā sāvitryā japtayā tadā ..8..
4.102.d:
कालेन सा तथा राजन्दुहिता देवरूपिणी ॥
सावित्र्या प्रीतया दत्ता सावित्र्या जप्तया तदा ॥8॥
4.102.m: In time, O king, that daughter of divine form was given / by Sāvitrī, who was pleased when Sāvitrī was chanted at that time.

4.102.s:
sāvitrītyeva nāmāsyāścakrurviprāstathā pitā ..
sā gṛhavatī saśrīrvyavarddhata nṛpātmajā ..
sāvitrī sukumārāṅgī yauvanasthā babhūva ha .. 9 ..
4.102.d:
सावित्रीत्येव नामास्याश्चक्रुर्विप्रास्तथा पिता ॥
सा गृहवती सश्रीर्व्यवर्द्धत नृपात्मजा ॥
सावित्री सुकुमाराङ्गी यौवनस्था बभूव ह ॥ 9 ॥
4.102.m: ‘Sāvitrī’ was the name that the vipras and her father gave to her. / Endowed with a household and splendour, the king’s daughter grew; / of delicate limbs, Sāvitrī reached youthfulness.

4.102.s:
tāṃ sumadhyāṃ pṛthuśroṇīṃ pratimāṃ kāñcanīmiva ..
prāpteva devakanyeti dṛṣṭvā tāmitare janāḥ .. 4.102.10 ..
4.102.d:
तां सुमध्यां पृथुश्रोणीं प्रतिमां काञ्चनीमिव ॥
प्राप्तेव देवकन्येति दृष्ट्वा तामितरे जनाः ॥ 4.102.10 ॥
4.102.m: Having seen her of slender waist and broad hips, like a golden statue, / other people thought: ‘She is as if a divine maiden arrived [on earth].’

4.102.s:
sā tu padmapalāśākṣī prajvalaṃtīva tejasā ..
cacāra sā ca sāvitrīvrataṃ yadbhṛguṇoditam .. 11 ..
4.102.d:
सा तु पद्मपलाशाक्षी प्रज्वलंतीव तेजसा ॥
चचार सा च सावित्रीव्रतं यद्भृगुणोदितम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.102.m: She, whose eyes were like lotus petals, blazing as if with brilliance, / performed the Sāvitrīvrata that was taught by Bhṛgu.

4.102.s:
athopoṣya śiraḥsnātā devatāmabhigamya sā ..
hutvāgniṃ vidhivadviprānvācayitveṃduparvaṇi .. 12 ..
4.102.d:
अथोपोष्य शिरःस्नाता देवतामभिगम्य सा ॥
हुत्वाग्निं विधिवद्विप्रान्वाचयित्वेंदुपर्वणि ॥ 12 ॥
4.102.m: Then, having fasted, bathed her head, approached the deity, / offered into the fire according to rule, and caused the vipras to recite blessings on the day of the moon’s conjunction,

4.102.s:
tebhyaḥ sumanasaḥ śeṣāḥ pratigṛhya nṛpātmajā ..
sādhvī pativratābhyetya devaśrīriva rūpiṇī .. 13 ..
4.102.d:
तेभ्यः सुमनसः शेषाः प्रतिगृह्य नृपात्मजा ॥
साध्वी पतिव्रताभ्येत्य देवश्रीरिव रूपिणी ॥ 13 ॥
4.102.m: the king’s daughter, having received from them the remnant flowers, / virtuous, devoted to her husband, approached [her father] like the goddess Śrī incarnate.

4.102.s:
sobhivādya pituḥ pādau śeṣānpūrvaṃ nivedya ca ..
kṛtāṃjalirvarārohā nṛpateḥ pārśvataḥ sthitā .. 14 ..
4.102.d:
सोभिवाद्य पितुः पादौ शेषान्पूर्वं निवेद्य च ॥
कृतांजलिर्वरारोहा नृपतेः पार्श्वतः स्थिता ॥ 14 ॥
4.102.m: Having saluted her father’s feet and first offered the remnant [flowers], / the lovely-hipped woman stood by the side of the king with folded hands.

4.102.s:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā yauvanaṃ prāptāṃ svacchāṃ tāṃ devarūpiṇīm ..
uvāca rājā saṃmaṃtrya smṛtyarthaṃ saha maṃtribhiḥ ..15..
4.102.d:
तां दृष्ट्वा यौवनं प्राप्तां स्वच्छां तां देवरूपिणीम् ॥
उवाच राजा संमंत्र्य स्मृत्यर्थं सह मंत्रिभिः ॥15॥
4.102.m: Seeing her who had reached youth, pure and of divine form, / the king, having deliberated with his ministers regarding the legal tradition, said:

4.102.s:
yuktaḥ pradānakālo'syāstena kaścidvṛṇotvimām..
vicārayitvā paśyāmi varaṃ tulyaṃ mahātmanaḥ..16..
4.102.d:
युक्तः प्रदानकालोऽस्यास्तेन कश्चिद्वृणोत्विमाम्॥
विचारयित्वा पश्यामि वरं तुल्यं महात्मनः॥16॥
4.102.m: ‘The time for giving her [in marriage] has arrived; therefore let someone choose her. / Having reflected, I shall consider a match equal to the high-souled one.’

4.102.s:
devādīnāṃ yathā vācyo na labdheyaṃ tathā kuru ..
boddhayamānā mayā putri dharmaśāstreṣu gaccha tam .. 17 ..
4.102.d:
देवादीनां यथा वाच्यो न लब्धेयं तथा कुरु ॥
बोद्धयमाना मया पुत्रि धर्मशास्त्रेषु गच्छ तम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.102.m: Act so that I incur no blame from the gods and others. / Instructed by me in the Dharmaśāstras, my daughter, go to him.

4.102.s:
piturgṛhe tu yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyatyasaṃskṛtā ..
brahmahatyā pitustatra sā kanyā vṛṣalī smṛtā .. 18 ..
4.102.d:
पितुर्गृहे तु या कन्या रजः पश्यत्यसंस्कृता ॥
ब्रह्महत्या पितुस्तत्र सा कन्या वृषली स्मृता ॥ 18 ॥
4.102.m: A maiden who observes her menses unmarried in her father's house— / the father incurs the guilt of killing a brahmin, and that maiden is regarded as a degraded woman.

4.102.s:
atorthaṃ preṣayāmīti kuru putri svayaṃvaram ..
vṛddhairamātyaiḥ sahitā śīghraṃ gaccha vidhāraya .. 19 ..
4.102.d:
अतोर्थं प्रेषयामीति कुरु पुत्रि स्वयंवरम् ॥
वृद्धैरमात्यैः सहिता शीघ्रं गच्छ विधारय ॥ 19 ॥
4.102.m: For this reason I send you; daughter, make your own choice of husband. / Accompanied by elderly ministers, go swiftly and decide.

4.102.s:
evamastviti sāvitrī proktā tasmādviniryayau ..
tapovanāni ramyāṇi rājarṣīṇāṃ jagāma sā .. 4.102.20 ..
4.102.d:
एवमस्त्विति सावित्री प्रोक्ता तस्माद्विनिर्ययौ ॥
तपोवनानि रम्याणि राजर्षीणां जगाम सा ॥ 4.102.20 ॥
4.102.m: Having said, 'So be it,' Sāvitrī went forth from there. / She went to the delightful penance groves of royal sages.

4.102.s:
mānyānāmatra vṛddhānāṃ kṛtvā pādābhiṣecanam ..
tatobhigamya tīrthāni sarvāṇyevāśrayāṇi ca ..21..
4.102.d:
मान्यानामत्र वृद्धानां कृत्वा पादाभिषेचनम् ॥
ततोभिगम्य तीर्थानि सर्वाण्येवाश्रयाणि च ॥21॥
4.102.m: There, having washed the feet of the venerable elders, / and then having visited all the sacred bathing places and hermitages,

4.102.s:
ājagāma punarveśma sāvitrī saha maṃtribhiḥ..
tatrāpaśyacca devarṣiṃ nāradaṃ purataḥ pituḥ ..22..
4.102.d:
आजगाम पुनर्वेश्म सावित्री सह मंत्रिभिः॥
तत्रापश्यच्च देवर्षिं नारदं पुरतः पितुः ॥22॥
4.102.m: Sāvitrī returned home again with the ministers. / There she saw the celestial sage Nārada in the presence of her father.

4.102.s:
āsīnamāsane vipraṃ praṇamya smitabhāṣiṇī ..
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ yathā vṛtaṃ vane'bhavat .. 23 ..
4.102.d:
आसीनमासने विप्रं प्रणम्य स्मितभाषिणी ॥
कथयामास तत्सर्वं यथा वृतं वनेऽभवत् ॥ 23 ॥
4.102.m: Bowing to the brahmin seated on the seat, smiling as she spoke, / she narrated everything just as it happened in the forest.

4.102.s:
.. sāvitryuvāca .. ..
āsītsālveṣu dharmātmā kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
dyumatsena iti khyāto devadatto babhūva saḥ ..24..
4.102.d:
॥ सावित्र्युवाच ॥ ॥
आसीत्साल्वेषु धर्मात्मा क्षत्रियः पृथिवीपतिः ॥
द्युमत्सेन इति ख्यातो देवदत्तो बभूव सः ॥24॥
4.102.m: Sāvitrī said: / 'Among the Śālvas there was a righteous kṣatriya king, / known as Dyumatsena; he was god-given.

4.102.s:
.. nārada uvāca ..
aho bata mahatkaṣṭaṃ sāvitryā nṛpateḥ kṛtam ..
bālyabhāvādyadanayā na kṛtaḥ satyavānnṛpaḥ .. 25 ..
4.102.d:
॥ नारद उवाच ॥
अहो बत महत्कष्टं सावित्र्या नृपतेः कृतम् ॥
बाल्यभावाद्यदनया न कृतः सत्यवान्नृपः ॥ 25 ॥
4.102.m: Nārada said: / 'Alas, what great hardship Sāvitrī has brought upon the king! / For out of childishness, she did not choose a king who will live long.

4.102.s:
satyaṃ vadatyasya pitā satyaṃ mātā prabhāṣate ..
upeto'sti guṇaiḥ sarvairdyumatsenasuto balī ..26..
4.102.d:
सत्यं वदत्यस्य पिता सत्यं माता प्रभाषते ॥
उपेतोऽस्ति गुणैः सर्वैर्द्युमत्सेनसुतो बली ॥26॥
4.102.m: His father speaks truth, his mother speaks truth; / endowed with all virtues, the son of Dyumatsena is strong.

4.102.s:
eko doṣo'sti nānyo'sya so'dyaprabhṛti satyavāk ..
saṃvatsareṇa hīnāyurdeha tyāgaṃ kariṣyati..27..
4.102.d:
एको दोषोऽस्ति नान्योऽस्य सोऽद्यप्रभृति सत्यवाक् ॥
संवत्सरेण हीनायुर्देह त्यागं करिष्यति॥27॥
4.102.m: He has one flaw and no other: he who speaks truth from this day forth / will, with his lifespan depleted, abandon his body in a year.'

4.102.s:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā tanayāṃ prāha pārthivaḥ ..
putri sāvitri gaccha tvamanyaṃ varaya satpatim..
saṃvatsareṇa solpāyurdehatyāgaṃ kariṣyati ..28..
4.102.d:
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तनयां प्राह पार्थिवः ॥
पुत्रि सावित्रि गच्छ त्वमन्यं वरय सत्पतिम्॥
संवत्सरेण सोल्पायुर्देहत्यागं करिष्यति ॥28॥
4.102.m: Having heard Nārada's words, the king said to his daughter: / 'Daughter Sāvitrī, go, choose another noble husband. / In a year, short-lived, he will abandon his body.'

4.102.s:
.. sāvitryuvāca .. ..
sakṛjjalpaṃti rājānaḥ sakṛjjalpaṃti paṃḍitāḥ ..
sakṛtpradīyate kanyā trīṇyetāni sakṛtsakṛt ..29..
4.102.d:
॥ सावित्र्युवाच ॥ ॥
सकृज्जल्पंति राजानः सकृज्जल्पंति पंडिताः ॥
सकृत्प्रदीयते कन्या त्रीण्येतानि सकृत्सकृत् ॥29॥
4.102.m: Sāvitrī said: / 'Kings speak but once; wise men speak but once; / a daughter is given but once; these three occur only once.

4.102.s:
dīrghāyuratha vālpāyuḥ saguṇo nirguṇo'pi vā ..
sakṛdvṛtomayā bhartā na dvitīyaṃ vṛṇomyaham..4.102.30..
4.102.d:
दीर्घायुरथ वाल्पायुः सगुणो निर्गुणोऽपि वा ॥
सकृद्वृतोमया भर्ता न द्वितीयं वृणोम्यहम्॥4.102.30॥
4.102.m: Whether long-lived or short-lived, endowed with virtues or devoid of virtues, / once chosen by me as husband, I do not choose a second.

4.102.s:
manasā niścayaṃ kṛtvā tato vācā'bhidhīyate..
kriyate karmaṇā paścātpramāṇaṃ me manaḥ sadā..31..
4.102.d:
मनसा निश्चयं कृत्वा ततो वाचाऽभिधीयते॥
क्रियते कर्मणा पश्चात्प्रमाणं मे मनः सदा॥31॥
4.102.m: First a resolve is made with the mind, then it is expressed in speech, / and afterwards it is carried out in action; my mind is ever my authority.'

4.102.s:
..nārada uvāca .. ..
yadyetadiṣṭaṃ duhitustataḥ śīghraṃ vidhīyatām ..
avighnamagre sāvitryāḥ pradāne duhitustava..32..
4.102.d:
॥नारद उवाच ॥ ॥
यद्येतदिष्टं दुहितुस्ततः शीघ्रं विधीयताम् ॥
अविघ्नमग्रे सावित्र्याः प्रदाने दुहितुस्तव॥32॥
4.102.m: Nārada said: / 'If this is your daughter's desire, let it be performed swiftly, / so that no obstacle arises in the giving of your daughter Sāvitrī.'

4.102.s:
evamuktvā samutpatya nāradastridivaṃ gataḥ ..
rājā ca duhituḥ sarvaṃ vaivāhikamathākarot ..
śubhe muhūrte pārśvasthairbrāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ .. 33 ..
4.102.d:
एवमुक्त्वा समुत्पत्य नारदस्त्रिदिवं गतः ॥
राजा च दुहितुः सर्वं वैवाहिकमथाकरोत् ॥
शुभे मुहूर्ते पार्श्वस्थैर्ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः ॥ 33 ॥
4.102.m: Having spoken thus, Nārada flew up and went to heaven. / The king then performed the entire wedding ceremony for his daughter / at an auspicious hour, with the brahmins versed in the Vedas standing by.

4.102.s:
sāvitryapi varaṃ labdhvā bhartāraṃ manasepsitam ..
mumude'tīva tanvaṃgī svargaṃ prāpyeva puṇyakṛt ..34..
4.102.d:
सावित्र्यपि वरं लब्ध्वा भर्तारं मनसेप्सितम् ॥
मुमुदेऽतीव तन्वंगी स्वर्गं प्राप्येव पुण्यकृत् ॥34॥
4.102.m: Having obtained the husband desired by her mind, the slender-limbed Sāvitrī / rejoiced exceedingly, like a doer of merit who has attained heaven.

4.102.s:
evaṃ tatrāśrame teṣāṃ vasatāṃ prītipūrvakam ..
kālastapasyatāṃ kaścidaticakrāma bhārata ..35..
4.102.d:
एवं तत्राश्रमे तेषां वसतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ॥
कालस्तपस्यतां कश्चिदतिचक्राम भारत ॥35॥
4.102.m: While they were thus dwelling affectionately in that hermitage, / some time passed as they practiced austerities, O descendant of Bharata.

4.102.s:
sāvitryāstapyamānāyāstiṣṭhaṃtyāśca divāniśam..
nāradena yaduktaṃ tadvākyaṃ manasi vartate ..36..
4.102.d:
सावित्र्यास्तप्यमानायास्तिष्ठंत्याश्च दिवानिशम्॥
नारदेन यदुक्तं तद्वाक्यं मनसि वर्तते ॥36॥
4.102.m: As Sāvitrī performed austerities day and night, / that statement spoken by Nārada remained present in her mind.

4.102.s:
tataḥ kāle bahutithe vyatikrāṃte kadācana..
saprāptakālo mriyeta iti saṃciṃtya bhāminī..
proṣṭhapade site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ rajanīmukhe .. 37 ..
4.102.d:
ततः काले बहुतिथे व्यतिक्रांते कदाचन॥
सप्राप्तकालो म्रियेत इति संचिंत्य भामिनी॥
प्रोष्ठपदे सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां रजनीमुखे ॥ 37 ॥
4.102.m: Then, after a great deal of time had elapsed, / reflecting that the appointed time had arrived when he would die, the lady, / in the month of Proṣṭhapada, during the bright fortnight, on the twelfth lunar day at nightfall,

4.102.s:
gaṇayantī ca sāvitrī nāradoktaṃ vaco hṛdi ..
vrataṃ trirātramuddiśya divārātraṃ vinābhavat .. 38 ..
4.102.d:
गणयन्ती च सावित्री नारदोक्तं वचो हृदि ॥
व्रतं त्रिरात्रमुद्दिश्य दिवारात्रं विनाभवत् ॥ 38 ॥
4.102.m: calculating in her heart the statement made by Nārada, / undertook a three-night votive observance, fasting day and night.

4.102.s:
tatastrirātraṃ nirvartya snātvā saṃtarpya devatāḥ ..
caturthe'hani martavyamiti saṃciṃtya bhāminī ..
śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pādau vavaṃde cāruhāsinī .. 39 ..
4.102.d:
ततस्त्रिरात्रं निर्वर्त्य स्नात्वा संतर्प्य देवताः ॥
चतुर्थेऽहनि मर्तव्यमिति संचिंत्य भामिनी ॥
श्वश्रूश्वशुरयोः पादौ ववंदे चारुहासिनी ॥ 39 ॥
4.102.m: Then, having completed the three nights, bathed, and gratified the deities, / reflecting that he was to die on the fourth day, the lady of charming smile / bowed at the feet of her mother-in-law and father-in-law.

4.102.s:
atha pratasthe paraśuṃ gṛhītvā satyavānvanam ..
sāvitryapi ca bhartāraṃ gacchataḥ pṛṣṭhato'nvagāt .. 4.102.40 ..
4.102.d:
अथ प्रतस्थे परशुं गृहीत्वा सत्यवान्वनम् ॥
सावित्र्यपि च भर्तारं गच्छतः पृष्ठतोऽन्वगात् ॥ 4.102.40 ॥
4.102.m: Then Satyavān, taking an axe, set out for the forest, / and Sāvitrī followed behind her departing husband.

4.102.s:
tato'vadatsa bhartā tāṃ pṛcchasva śvaśurau nijau ..
tathetyuktvā hi papraccha natvā śvaśrūpadāni sā .. 41 ..
4.102.d:
ततोऽवदत्स भर्ता तां पृच्छस्व श्वशुरौ निजौ ॥
तथेत्युक्त्वा हि पप्रच्छ नत्वा श्वश्रूपदानि सा ॥ 41 ॥
4.102.m: Then her husband said to her: 'Ask your parents-in-law.' / Saying, 'So be it,' she bowed at her mother-in-law's feet and asked.

4.102.s:
śvaśurāvavadatāṃ ca na gaṃtavyaṃ tvayānaghe ..
bāle tvaṃ paramaṃ bhīruḥ kathaṃ gacchasi kānanam .. 42..
4.102.d:
श्वशुराववदतां च न गंतव्यं त्वयानघे ॥
बाले त्वं परमं भीरुः कथं गच्छसि काननम् ॥ 42॥
4.102.m: Both parents-in-law said: 'You should not go, sinless one. / Young woman, you are exceedingly timid; how can you go to the forest?'

4.102.s:
bhūyo bhāvena sā proce draṣṭavyaṃ kānanaṃ mayā ..
gaccheti tāṃ tadocāte śvaśurau cāruhāsinīm .. 43 ..
4.102.d:
भूयो भावेन सा प्रोचे द्रष्टव्यं काननं मया ॥
गच्छेति तां तदोचाते श्वशुरौ चारुहासिनीम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.102.m: With earnest intent she spoke again: 'I must see the forest.' / The parents-in-law then said to that woman of charming smile: 'Go.'

4.102.s:
tato gṛhītvā tarasā phalapuṣpasamitkuśān ..
yathā śuṣkāṇi vādāya kāṣṭhabhāramakalpayat .. 44 ..
4.102.d:
ततो गृहीत्वा तरसा फलपुष्पसमित्कुशान् ॥
यथा शुष्काणि वादाय काष्ठभारमकल्पयत् ॥ 44 ॥
4.102.m: Then, having quickly gathered fruits, flowers, firewood, and kuśa grass, / and collecting dry wood, he prepared a bundle of firewood.

4.102.s:
atha pāṭayataḥ kāṣṭhaṃ jātā śirasi vedanā ..
vyathā māṃ bādhate bāle svaptumicchāmi suṃdari .. 49 ..
4.102.d:
अथ पाटयतः काष्ठं जाता शिरसि वेदना ॥
व्यथा मां बाधते बाले स्वप्तुमिच्छामि सुंदरि ॥ 49 ॥
4.102.m: Then, as he was splitting wood, a pain arose in his head: / 'Pain afflicts me, girl; beautiful one, I wish to sleep.'

4.102.s:
viśramasva mahābāho sāvitrī prāha duḥkhitā ..
paścādupagamiṣyāmi svāśramaṃ śramanāśanam .. 46 ..
4.102.d:
विश्रमस्व महाबाहो सावित्री प्राह दुःखिता ॥
पश्चादुपगमिष्यामि स्वाश्रमं श्रमनाशनम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.102.m: The sorrowful Sāvitrī said: 'Rest, mighty-armed one. / Later I will go to our own hermitage, which dispels fatigue.'

4.102.s:
yāvadutsaṃgake kṛtvā śira āste mahītale ..
tāvaddadarśa sāvitrī puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṃgalam ..
kirīṭinaṃ pītavastraṃ sākṣātsūryamivoditam .. 47 ..
4.102.d:
यावदुत्संगके कृत्वा शिर आस्ते महीतले ॥
तावद्ददर्श सावित्री पुरुषं कृष्णपिंगलम् ॥
किरीटिनं पीतवस्त्रं साक्षात्सूर्यमिवोदितम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.102.m: While she sat on the earth holding his head in her lap, / Sāvitrī saw a dark and tawny man, / wearing a diadem, dressed in yellow garments, like the sun visibly risen.

4.102.s:
tamuvācātha sāvitrī praṇamya madhupiṃgalam ..
kastvaṃ devo'tha vā daityo māṃ dharṣayitumāgataḥ .. .. 48 ..
4.102.d:
तमुवाचाथ सावित्री प्रणम्य मधुपिंगलम् ॥
कस्त्वं देवोऽथ वा दैत्यो मां धर्षयितुमागतः ॥ ॥ 48 ॥
4.102.m: Then Sāvitrī, bowing to the honey-tawny one, said to him: / 'Who are you—a god or a daitya—who have come to overpower me?

4.102.s:
na cāhaṃ kenacicchakyā svadharmādavaropitum ..
spraṣṭuṃ vā puruṣaśreṣṭha dīptā vahniśikhā yathā ..49..
4.102.d:
न चाहं केनचिच्छक्या स्वधर्मादवरोपितुम् ॥
स्प्रष्टुं वा पुरुषश्रेष्ठ दीप्ता वह्निशिखा यथा ॥49॥
4.102.m: Nor can I be brought down from my own duty by anyone, / or touched, O best of men, like a blazing flame of fire.'

4.102.s:
.. yama uvāca .. ..
yamaḥ saṃyamanaścāsmi sarvalokabhayaṃkaraḥ ..
kṣīṇāyureṣa te bhartā taṃ nayāmi pativrate ..
na śakyaḥ kiṃkarairnetumato'haṃ svayamāgataḥ .. 4.102.50 ..
4.102.d:
॥ यम उवाच ॥ ॥
यमः संयमनश्चास्मि सर्वलोकभयंकरः ॥
क्षीणायुरेष ते भर्ता तं नयामि पतिव्रते ॥
न शक्यः किंकरैर्नेतुमतोऽहं स्वयमागतः ॥ 4.102.50 ॥
4.102.m: Yama said: / 'I am Yama, the Subduer, terrifying to all worlds. / Your husband's lifespan is depleted; I am taking him away, O devoted wife. / He cannot be taken by attendants, therefore I have come myself.'

4.102.s:
evamuktvā satyavataḥ śarīrātpāśasaṃcayaiḥ ..
aṃguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ niścakarṣa yamo balāt ..
atha prayātumārebhe paṃthānaṃ pitṛsevitam .. 51 ..
4.102.d:
एवमुक्त्वा सत्यवतः शरीरात्पाशसंचयैः ॥
अंगुष्ठमात्रं पुरुषं निश्चकर्ष यमो बलात् ॥
अथ प्रयातुमारेभे पंथानं पितृसेवितम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.102.m: Having spoken thus, Yama forcibly drew out with a bundle of nooses / a person the size of a thumb from Satyavān's body; / then he set out on the path traversed by the ancestors.

4.102.s:
sāvitryapi varārohā pṛṣṭhato' nujagāma ha ..
pativratāṃ tathā śrāṃtāṃ tāmuvāca yamastadā .. 52 ..
4.102.d:
सावित्र्यपि वरारोहा पृष्ठतो' नुजगाम ह ॥
पतिव्रतां तथा श्रांतां तामुवाच यमस्तदा ॥ 52 ॥
4.102.m: Sāvitrī of shapely limbs followed behind. / To the devoted wife who was thus weary, Yama then said:

4.102.s:
nivarta gaccha sāvitri svagṛhe tvamihāgatā ..
eṣa mārgo viśālākṣi na kenāpyanugamyate .. 53 ..
4.102.d:
निवर्त गच्छ सावित्रि स्वगृहे त्वमिहागता ॥
एष मार्गो विशालाक्षि न केनाप्यनुगम्यते ॥ 53 ॥
4.102.m: 'Turn back, go to your own home, Sāvitrī, since you have come here. / This path, large-eyed one, is not followed by anyone.'

4.102.s:
.. sāvitryuvāca .. ..
na śramo na ca me glāniḥ kadācidapi jāyate ..
bhartāramanugacchaṃti yāstāsāṃ na śramādayaḥ ..54..
4.102.d:
॥ सावित्र्युवाच ॥ ॥
न श्रमो न च मे ग्लानिः कदाचिदपि जायते ॥
भर्तारमनुगच्छंति यास्तासां न श्रमादयः ॥54॥
4.102.m: Sāvitrī said: / 'Neither fatigue nor weariness ever arises in me. / For women who follow their husband, fatigue and the like do not exist.

4.102.s:
satāṃ saṃto gatirnānyā strīṇāṃ bhartā sadā gatiḥ ..
vedo varṇāśramāṇāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāṃ ca gatirguruḥ .. 55 ..
4.102.d:
सतां संतो गतिर्नान्या स्त्रीणां भर्ता सदा गतिः ॥
वेदो वर्णाश्रमाणां च शिष्याणां च गतिर्गुरुः ॥ 55 ॥
4.102.m: For the virtuous, the virtuous are their recourse and none other; for women, the husband is always the recourse. / The Veda is the recourse of the social classes and stages of life, and the teacher is the recourse of students.

4.102.s:
sarveṣāmeva jaṃtūnāṃ sthānamasti mahītalam ..
bhartāra eva manujastrīṇāṃ nānyaḥ samāśrayaḥ .. 56 ..
4.102.d:
सर्वेषामेव जंतूनां स्थानमस्ति महीतलम् ॥
भर्तार एव मनुजस्त्रीणां नान्यः समाश्रयः ॥ 56 ॥
4.102.m: For all creatures, the earth is their dwelling place; / for women, husbands alone are their only shelter, no other.'

4.102.s:
evamanyaiśca vividhairvākyairddharmārthasaṃhitaiḥ ..
tutoṣa sūryatanayaḥ sāvitrīṃ ceda mabravīt.. 57 ..
4.102.d:
एवमन्यैश्च विविधैर्वाक्यैर्द्धर्मार्थसंहितैः ॥
तुतोष सूर्यतनयः सावित्रीं चेद मब्रवीत्॥ 57 ॥
4.102.m: With these and various other words endowed with righteousness and profit, / the son of Sūrya was pleased and spoke thus to Sāvitrī:

4.102.s:
tuṣṭo'smi tava bhadraṃ te varaṃ varaya bhāmini ..
sāvitryapi varānvavre vinayāvanatānanā .. 58 ..
4.102.d:
तुष्टोऽस्मि तव भद्रं ते वरं वरय भामिनि ॥
सावित्र्यपि वरान्वव्रे विनयावनतानना ॥ 58 ॥
4.102.m: “I am pleased with you; hail to you! Choose a boon, O passionate woman!” / Then Sāvitrī too chose her boons, her face bowed in modesty:

4.102.s:
cakṣuḥprāptistathā rājyaṃ śvasu rasya mahātmanaḥ ..
pituḥ putraśataṃ caiva putrāṇāṃ śatamātmanaḥ .. 59 ..
4.102.d:
चक्षुःप्राप्तिस्तथा राज्यं श्वसु रस्य महात्मनः ॥
पितुः पुत्रशतं चैव पुत्राणां शतमात्मनः ॥ 59 ॥
4.102.m: The restoration of eyesight and the kingdom for her high-souled father-in-law, / a hundred sons for her father, and a hundred sons for herself,

4.102.s:
jīvitaṃ ca tathā bhartudharmasiddhiśca śāśvatī ..
dharmarājo varāndattvā preṣayāmāsa tāṃ tataḥ .. 4.102.60 ..
4.102.d:
जीवितं च तथा भर्तुधर्मसिद्धिश्च शाश्वती ॥
धर्मराजो वरान्दत्त्वा प्रेषयामास तां ततः ॥ 4.102.60 ॥
4.102.m: and likewise the life of her husband, and the perpetual accomplishment of righteousness. / Having granted the boons, the King of Justice then sent her away.

4.102.s:
atha bhartāramāsādya sāvitrī hṛṣṭamānasā ..
jagāma sāśramapadaṃ saha bhartrā nirākulā .. 61 ..
4.102.d:
अथ भर्तारमासाद्य सावित्री हृष्टमानसा ॥
जगाम साश्रमपदं सह भर्त्रा निराकुला ॥ 61 ॥
4.102.m: Then, having reached her husband, Sāvitrī, her mind delighted, / went untroubled to the hermitage along with her husband.

4.102.s:
bhādrasya paurṇamāsyāṃ tu yathā cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ tvidam ..
māhātmyamasya nṛpate kathitaṃ sakalaṃ mayā .. 62 ..
4.102.d:
भाद्रस्य पौर्णमास्यां तु यथा चीर्णं व्रतं त्विदम् ॥
माहात्म्यमस्य नृपते कथितं सकलं मया ॥ 62 ॥
4.102.m: How this votive observance was practiced on the full moon of the month of Bhādra, / its entire greatness has been narrated by me, O king.

4.102.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kīdṛśaṃ tadvrataṃ deva sāvitryā yadanuṣṭhitam ..
tasminbhādrapade māsi siddhānnaṃ tasya kīdṛśam .. 63 ..
4.102.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कीदृशं तद्व्रतं देव सावित्र्या यदनुष्ठितम् ॥
तस्मिन्भाद्रपदे मासि सिद्धान्नं तस्य कीदृशम् ॥ 63 ॥
4.102.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Of what kind was that votive observance, O lord, which was performed by Sāvitrī / in that month of Bhādrapada? What kind of cooked food [is offered] in it?

4.102.s:
kā devatā vrate tasminbrūhi kāmaṃ prati prabho ..
savistaraṃ hṛṣīkeśa brūhi dharmaṃ sanātanam .. 64 ..
4.102.d:
का देवता व्रते तस्मिन्ब्रूहि कामं प्रति प्रभो ॥
सविस्तरं हृषीकेश ब्रूहि धर्मं सनातनम् ॥ 64 ॥
4.102.m: Which deity is in that votive observance? Tell me according to my desire, O lord. / Tell in full detail, O Hṛṣīkeśa, the eternal righteousness.

4.102.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. .
śrūyatāṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha sāvitrīvratamādarāt ..
kathayāmi kathaṃ cīrṇaṃ tayā satyā yudhiṣṭhira .. 65 ..
4.102.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ।
श्रूयतां पांडवश्रेष्ठ सावित्रीव्रतमादरात् ॥
कथयामि कथं चीर्णं तया सत्या युधिष्ठिर ॥ 65 ॥
4.102.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hear with reverence, O best of the Pāṇḍavas, the votive observance of Sāvitrī; / I shall tell how it was performed by that faithful wife, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

4.102.s:
trayodaśyāṃ bhādrapade daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam ..
trirātraṃ niyamaḥ kāryaṃ upavāsasya bhārata .. 66 ..
4.102.d:
त्रयोदश्यां भाद्रपदे दंतधावनपूर्वकम् ॥
त्रिरात्रं नियमः कार्यं उपवासस्य भारत ॥ 66 ॥
4.102.m: On the thirteenth day in Bhādrapada, preceded by cleansing the teeth, / a three-night rule of fasting is to be undertaken, O Bhārata.

4.102.s:
aśaktyā tu trayodaśyāṃ naktaṃ kuryājjitendriyaḥ ..
ayācitaṃ caturdaśyāmupavāsena pūrṇimām .. 67 ..
4.102.d:
अशक्त्या तु त्रयोदश्यां नक्तं कुर्याज्जितेन्द्रियः ॥
अयाचितं चतुर्दश्यामुपवासेन पूर्णिमाम् ॥ 67 ॥
4.102.m: In case of inability, on the thirteenth one with subdued senses should take a nocturnal meal, / unsolicited [food] on the fourteenth, and the full moon with a fast.

4.102.s:
nityaṃ snātvā mahānadyāṃ taḍāge cātha nirjhare ..
viśeṣaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu snānaṃ sarṣapamṛjjalaiḥ .. 68 ..
4.102.d:
नित्यं स्नात्वा महानद्यां तडागे चाथ निर्झरे ॥
विशेषः पौर्णमास्यां तु स्नानं सर्षपमृज्जलैः ॥ 68 ॥
4.102.m: Having bathed daily in a great river, a pond, or a mountain torrent, / the special rule on the full moon is a bath with mustard, clay, and water.

4.102.s:
gṛhītvā tilakānpātre prasthamātraṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
atha vā dhānyamādāya yavaśālitilādikam .. 69 ..
4.102.d:
गृहीत्वा तिलकान्पात्रे प्रस्थमात्रं युधिष्ठिर ॥
अथ वा धान्यमादाय यवशालितिलादिकम् ॥ 69 ॥
4.102.m: Taking a prastha measure of sesame seeds in a vessel, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / or having taken grain—barley, rice, sesame seeds, and the like—

4.102.s:
tato vaṃśamaye pātre vastrayugmena veṣṭayet ..
sāvitrīpratimāṃ kṛtvā sarvāvayavaśobhanām .. 4.102.70 ..
4.102.d:
ततो वंशमये पात्रे वस्त्रयुग्मेन वेष्टयेत् ॥
सावित्रीप्रतिमां कृत्वा सर्वावयवशोभनाम् ॥ 4.102.70 ॥
4.102.m: one should then wrap a bamboo vessel with a pair of cloths. / Having made an image of Sāvitrī, beautiful in all its limbs,

4.102.s:
sauvarṇī mṛnmayīṃ vāpi svaśaktyā raupyanirmitām ..
raktavastrayugaṃ dadyātsāvitryai brahmaṇe tathā .. 71 ..
4.102.d:
सौवर्णी मृन्मयीं वापि स्वशक्त्या रौप्यनिर्मिताम् ॥
रक्तवस्त्रयुगं दद्यात्सावित्र्यै ब्रह्मणे तथा ॥ 71 ॥
4.102.m: made of gold, or of clay, or fashioned of silver according to one's means, / one should offer a pair of red garments to Sāvitrī and likewise to Brahmā.

4.102.s:
sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇā sārddhamevaṃ bhaktyā prapūjayet ..
gaṃdhaiḥ sugaṃdhipuṣpaiśca dhūpanaivedyadīpakaiḥ .. 72..
4.102.d:
सावित्रीं ब्रह्मणा सार्द्धमेवं भक्त्या प्रपूजयेत् ॥
गंधैः सुगंधिपुष्पैश्च धूपनैवेद्यदीपकैः ॥ 72॥
4.102.m: One should thus worship Sāvitrī together with Brahmā with devotion, / using perfumes, fragrant flowers, incenses, food offerings, and lamps,

4.102.s:
pūrṇaiḥ kośātakairbhakṣyaiḥ kūṣmāṃḍaiḥ karkaṭīphalaiḥ ..
nālikeraiśca kharjūraiḥ kapisthairdāḍimīphalaiḥ .. 73 ..
4.102.d:
पूर्णैः कोशातकैर्भक्ष्यैः कूष्मांडैः कर्कटीफलैः ॥
नालिकेरैश्च खर्जूरैः कपिस्थैर्दाडिमीफलैः ॥ 73 ॥
4.102.m: with filled luffa gourds, sweetmeats, ash gourds, cucumber fruits, / coconuts, dates, wood-apples, pomegranate fruits,

4.102.s:
jaṃbūjaṃbīranāraṃgaiḥ karkaṭaiḥ panasaistathā ..
jīrakaiḥ kaṭukhaṃḍaiśca guḍena lavaṇena ca .. 74 ..
4.102.d:
जंबूजंबीरनारंगैः कर्कटैः पनसैस्तथा ॥
जीरकैः कटुखंडैश्च गुडेन लवणेन च ॥ 74 ॥
4.102.m: rose-apples, limes, oranges, crab apples, and jackfruits, / cumin seeds, ginger slices, molasses, and salt,

4.102.s:
virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiśca vaṃśapātre prakalpitaiḥ ..
rājanyā sūtrakaṃṭaiśca śubhaiḥ kuṃkumakeśaraiḥ .. 75 ..
4.102.d:
विरूढैः सप्तधान्यैश्च वंशपात्रे प्रकल्पितैः ॥
राजन्या सूत्रकंटैश्च शुभैः कुंकुमकेशरैः ॥ 75 ॥
4.102.m: with sprouted seven grains arranged in a bamboo vessel, / with turmeric, thread necklaces, and auspicious saffron filaments.

4.102.s:
avatāravatītyevaṃ sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā ..
tāmarcayeta maṃtreṇa sāvitrīṃ brāhmaṇaḥ svayam ..
itareṣāṃ purāṇoktamaṃtro'tra samudāhṛtaḥ .. 76 ..
4.102.d:
अवतारवतीत्येवं सावित्री ब्रह्मणः प्रिया ॥
तामर्चयेत मंत्रेण सावित्रीं ब्राह्मणः स्वयम् ॥
इतरेषां पुराणोक्तमंत्रोऽत्र समुदाहृतः ॥ 76 ॥
4.102.m: “She who takes incarnations”, thus is Sāvitrī, the beloved of Brahmā; / a brāhmaṇa himself should worship that Sāvitrī with the mantra. / For others, the mantra stated in the Purāṇa is pronounced here:

4.102.s:
oṃkārapūrvake devi vīṇāpustaka dhāriṇi ..
vedamātarnamastubhyamavaidhavyaṃ prayaccha me .. 77 ..
4.102.d:
ओंकारपूर्वके देवि वीणापुस्तक धारिणि ॥
वेदमातर्नमस्तुभ्यमवैधव्यं प्रयच्छ मे ॥ 77 ॥
4.102.m: “O goddess preceded by the syllable Om, holder of the lute and book, / mother of the Vedas, homage to you; grant me freedom from widowhood!”

4.102.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivajjāgaraṃ kārayettataḥ ..
gītavāditraśabdena hyaṣṭatārīkadaṃbakaiḥ .. 78 ..
4.102.d:
एवं संपूज्य विधिवज्जागरं कारयेत्ततः ॥
गीतवादित्रशब्देन ह्यष्टतारीकदंबकैः ॥ 78 ॥
4.102.m: Having thus worshipped according to rule, one should then keep a vigil / accompanied by sounds of singing and instrumental music, and ensembles of eight-stringed instruments,

4.102.s:
nṛtyahāsairnayedrātriṃ pṛṣṭhataśca kathānakaiḥ ..
sāvitryākhyānakaṃ vāpi vācayeddvijasattamam ..
yāvatprabhātasamayaṃ gītyā bhāvarasaiḥ samam .. 79 ..
4.102.d:
नृत्यहासैर्नयेद्रात्रिं पृष्ठतश्च कथानकैः ॥
सावित्र्याख्यानकं वापि वाचयेद्द्विजसत्तमम् ॥
यावत्प्रभातसमयं गीत्या भावरसैः समम् ॥ 79 ॥
4.102.m: one should pass the night with dances and laughter, and subsequently with stories; / or one should have the best of the twice-born recite the tale of Sāvitrī / until daybreak, along with song and emotional expressions.

4.102.s:
tataḥ prabhāte vimala uṣaḥkāle hyupasthite ..
brāhmaṇe vedaviduṣi sāvitrīṃ vinivedayet .. 4.102.80 ..
4.102.d:
ततः प्रभाते विमल उषःकाले ह्युपस्थिते ॥
ब्राह्मणे वेदविदुषि सावित्रीं विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 4.102.80 ॥
4.102.m: Then, when the clear morning arrives, when the dawn has appeared, / one should present Sāvitrī to a brāhmaṇa who knows the Vedas,

4.102.s:
yathā sāvitrakalpajñe sāvitryākhyānavācake ..
daivajña uṃcchavṛttau ca daridre cāgnihotriṇi .. 81 ..
4.102.d:
यथा सावित्रकल्पज्ञे सावित्र्याख्यानवाचके ॥
दैवज्ञ उंच्छवृत्तौ च दरिद्रे चाग्निहोत्रिणि ॥ 81 ॥
4.102.m: such as one who knows the ritual of Savitṛ, who recites the tale of Sāvitrī, / an astrologer, one living by gleaning grain, or a poor maintainer of the sacred fire.

4.102.s:
maṃtreṇānena kauṃteya praṇamya vidhipūrvakam ..
darbhākṣatatilairmiśrā pūrvāśābhimukhāsthitā ..
sudhī vipravaro vipra oṃkārasvastipūrvake .. 82 ..
4.102.d:
मंत्रेणानेन कौंतेय प्रणम्य विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
दर्भाक्षततिलैर्मिश्रा पूर्वाशाभिमुखास्थिता ॥
सुधी विप्रवरो विप्र ओंकारस्वस्तिपूर्वके ॥ 82 ॥
4.102.m: With this mantra, O son of Kuntī, having bowed according to rule, / [the offering] mixed with darbha grass, unbroken grains, and sesame, facing toward the eastern quarter, / the wise, best of brāhmaṇas, O brāhmaṇa, with Om and svasti preceding:

4.102.s:
sāvitrīyaṃ mayā dattā sahiraṇyā mahāsatī ..
brahmaṇaḥ prīṇanārthāya brāhmaṇa pratigṛhyatām .. 83 ..
4.102.d:
सावित्रीयं मया दत्ता सहिरण्या महासती ॥
ब्रह्मणः प्रीणनार्थाय ब्राह्मण प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥ 83 ॥
4.102.m: “This Sāvitrī, the great chaste wife, is given by me along with gold / to please Brahmā; O brāhmaṇa, let her be accepted!”

4.102.s:
evaṃ dattvā dvijeṃdrāya sāvitrīṃ tāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
naivedyādi ca tatsarvaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ svagṛhaṃ nayet ..
svayaṃ daśapadaṃ gacchetsvaveśma punarāviśet .. 84 ..
4.102.d:
एवं दत्त्वा द्विजेंद्राय सावित्रीं तां युधिष्ठिर ॥
नैवेद्यादि च तत्सर्वं ब्राह्मणं स्वगृहं नयेत् ॥
स्वयं दशपदं गच्छेत्स्ववेश्म पुनराविशेत् ॥ 84 ॥
4.102.m: Having thus given that Sāvitrī to the foremost of the twice-born, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / and all that food offering and the rest, one should escort the brāhmaṇa to his own house; / one should oneself walk ten paces, [and then] re-enter one's own dwelling.

4.102.s:
tatra bhuktvā haviṣyānnaṃ brāhmaṇairbāṃdhavaiḥ saha ..
visarjayettato viprānsāvitrī prīyatāmiti .. 85 ..
4.102.d:
तत्र भुक्त्वा हविष्यान्नं ब्राह्मणैर्बांधवैः सह ॥
विसर्जयेत्ततो विप्रान्सावित्री प्रीयतामिति ॥ 85 ॥
4.102.m: Having eaten sacrificial food there together with brāhmaṇas and kin, / one should then dismiss the brāhmaṇas, saying, “May Sāvitrī be pleased.”

4.102.s:
paṃcadaśyāṃ tathā jyeṣṭhe vaṭake ca mahāsatī ..
trirātropoṣitā nārī vidhinānena pūjayet .. 86 ..
4.102.d:
पंचदश्यां तथा ज्येष्ठे वटके च महासती ॥
त्रिरात्रोपोषिता नारी विधिनानेन पूजयेत् ॥ 86 ॥
4.102.m: Likewise, on the fifteenth day in Jyeṣṭha, at a banyan tree, a woman, a great chaste wife, / having fasted for three nights, should worship according to this rule

4.102.s:
sārddhaṃ satyavatā sādhvī phalanaivedyadīpakaiḥ ..
paṭṭāvalaṃbanaṃ kṛtvā kāṣṭhabhāraṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 87 ..
4.102.d:
सार्द्धं सत्यवता साध्वी फलनैवेद्यदीपकैः ॥
पट्टावलंबनं कृत्वा काष्ठभारं युधिष्ठिर ॥ 87 ॥
4.102.m: together with Satyavat, the virtuous woman, with fruits, food offerings, and lamps, / having hung a silk cloth and [placed] a bundle of firewood, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

4.102.s:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā nṛtyagītapurassaraiḥ ..
prabhāte vidhinā pūrvaṃ pūrvoktena narottamaḥ ..
tatsarvaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyātpraṇipatya kṣamāpayet .. 88 ..
4.102.d:
रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा नृत्यगीतपुरस्सरैः ॥
प्रभाते विधिना पूर्वं पूर्वोक्तेन नरोत्तमः ॥
तत्सर्वं ब्राह्मणे दद्यात्प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ॥ 88 ॥
4.102.m: Having kept a vigil at night preceded by dancing and singing, / in the morning, according to the rule previously stated, the best of men / should give all of that to a brāhmaṇa, bow down, and ask for forgiveness.

4.102.s:
etattu te vratamidaṃ kathitaṃ vidhivanmayā ..
yāścariṣyaṃti lokesminputrapautrasamanvitāḥ ..
bhuktvā bhogāṃściraṃ bhūmau yāsyaṃti brahmaṇaḥ padam .. 89 ..
4.102.d:
एतत्तु ते व्रतमिदं कथितं विधिवन्मया ॥
याश्चरिष्यंति लोकेस्मिन्पुत्रपौत्रसमन्विताः ॥
भुक्त्वा भोगांश्चिरं भूमौ यास्यंति ब्रह्मणः पदम् ॥ 89 ॥
4.102.m: This votive observance has been declared to you by me according to rule. / Those women who will perform it in this world, endowed with sons and grandsons, / having enjoyed pleasures on earth for a long time, will go to the abode of Brahmā.

4.102.s:
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam ..
japatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sāvitrīvratamādarāt .. 4.102.90 ..
4.102.d:
एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं धन्यं दुःस्वप्ननाशनम् ॥
जपतां शृण्वतां चैव सावित्रीव्रतमादरात् ॥ 4.102.90 ॥
4.102.m: This is meritorious, sin-destroying, auspicious, and dispeller of bad dreams / for those who recite and hear with reverence the votive observance of Sāvitrī.

4.102.s:
smṛtyarthavedajananīṃ sahaśaṃbhujāyāṃ saṃpūjayediha trirātrakṛtopavāsā ..
sāvitrivatpitṛkulaṃ ca tathā svabharturuddhārayecca vibhunakti ciraṃ sukhāni .. 91 ..
kārtikakṛttikāvratavarṇanam
4.102.d:
स्मृत्यर्थवेदजननीं सहशंभुजायां संपूजयेदिह त्रिरात्रकृतोपवासा ॥
सावित्रिवत्पितृकुलं च तथा स्वभर्तुरुद्धारयेच्च विभुनक्ति चिरं सुखानि ॥ 91 ॥
कार्तिककृत्तिकाव्रतवर्णनम्
4.102.m:
She who, having fasted for three nights, would worship the mother of the Vedas together with the wife of Śambhu for the purpose of Smṛti, / delivers the family of her father and of her husband like Sāvitrī, and enjoys pleasures for a long time.
Description of the Kārttikakṛttikā Votive Observance

4.103.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pūrvamāsītkṛtayuge kṣatriṇī bahuputriṇī ..
nāmnā kaliṃgabhadreti rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyutā .. 1 ..
4.103.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पूर्वमासीत्कृतयुगे क्षत्रिणी बहुपुत्रिणी ॥
नाम्ना कलिंगभद्रेति रूपलावण्यसंयुता ॥ 1 ॥
4.103.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Formerly in the Kṛta age there was a Kṣatriya woman endowed with many sons, / named Kaliṅgabhadrā, endowed with beauty and charm,

4.103.s:
tuṃgastanī padmanetrā haṃsanāgendragāminī ..
saubhāgyaguṇasaṃpūrṇā caṃdrabiṃbanibhānanā .. 2 ..
4.103.d:
तुंगस्तनी पद्मनेत्रा हंसनागेन्द्रगामिनी ॥
सौभाग्यगुणसंपूर्णा चंद्रबिंबनिभानना ॥ 2 ॥
4.103.m: with prominent breasts, lotus eyes, the gait of a swan or a lordly elephant, / full of auspicious virtues, her face resembling the lunar disc,

4.103.s:
dhanaratnaiśca saṃpūrṇā madhyadeśe vṛṣasthale ..
rājñaḥ patnī tu sā devī dilīpasya mahātmanaḥ ..
kaliṅgabhadrā lalitā mahādevī guṇānvitā .. 3 ..
4.103.d:
धनरत्नैश्च संपूर्णा मध्यदेशे वृषस्थले ॥
राज्ञः पत्नी तु सा देवी दिलीपस्य महात्मनः ॥
कलिङ्गभद्रा ललिता महादेवी गुणान्विता ॥ 3 ॥
4.103.m: and richly endowed with wealth and gems in Vṛṣasthala in the Madhyadeśa. / That queen was the wife of the high-souled king Dilīpa, / Kaliṅgabhadrā, graceful, the chief queen endowed with virtues.

4.103.s:
mahāprasādaṃ manvānā bahumānapurassaram ..
brāhmaṇebhyaśca dānāni prayacchati mahāsatī .. 4 ..
4.103.d:
महाप्रसादं मन्वाना बहुमानपुरस्सरम् ॥
ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च दानानि प्रयच्छति महासती ॥ 4 ॥
4.103.m: Regarding [her gift] as a great grace, accompanied by high esteem, / that greatly virtuous wife gave gifts to the brāhmaṇas.

4.103.s:
tyāgasaṃbhogasaubhāgye dvitīyā naiva tādṛśī ..
nārīṇāṃ tu naraśreṣṭha dilīpasya yathā vidhā .. 5 ..
4.103.d:
त्यागसंभोगसौभाग्ये द्वितीया नैव तादृशी ॥
नारीणां तु नरश्रेष्ठ दिलीपस्य यथा विधा ॥ 5 ॥
4.103.m: In generosity, enjoyment, and good fortune, there was no second woman like her, / O best of men, just as Dilīpa's manner was unique.

4.103.s:
yathā ca kārttike māsi gṛhītaṃ kṣattrayāvratam ..
ṣaṇmāsena vrataṃ yāvadidaṃ saṃcintya cetasi ..
pāritaṃ ca tayā sarvaṃ kiṃcinmātraṃ tu vartate .. 6 ..
4.103.d:
यथा च कार्त्तिके मासि गृहीतं क्षत्त्रयाव्रतम् ॥
षण्मासेन व्रतं यावदिदं संचिन्त्य चेतसि ॥
पारितं च तया सर्वं किंचिन्मात्रं तु वर्तते ॥ 6 ॥
4.103.m: And when the Kṣattrayā-vrata was undertaken in the month of Kārttika, / resolving in her mind upon this vow for six months, / it was almost entirely completed by her, with only a small portion remaining.

4.103.s:
pāraṇepāraṇe vāpi purāṇajñe dvijottame ..
udyāpanaṃ prayacchaṃtī kālaṃ nayati sundarī .. 7 ..
4.103.d:
पारणेपारणे वापि पुराणज्ञे द्विजोत्तमे ॥
उद्यापनं प्रयच्छंती कालं नयति सुन्दरी ॥ 7 ॥
4.103.m: At every fast-breaking, bestowing a concluding rite / upon an excellent twice-born versed in the Purāṇas, the beautiful lady spent her time.

4.103.s:
kadācidardharātre tu suptā bhartrā sahaiva sā ..
daṣṭā sarpeṇa raudreṇa jagāma nidhanaṃ kṣaṇāt .. 8 ..
4.103.d:
कदाचिदर्धरात्रे तु सुप्ता भर्त्रा सहैव सा ॥
दष्टा सर्पेण रौद्रेण जगाम निधनं क्षणात् ॥ 8 ॥
4.103.m: Once at midnight, while she was asleep beside her husband, / bitten by a fierce snake, she met her death in an instant.

4.103.s:
tena doṣeṇa sā bālā ajāyonau hyajāyata ..
vanecarī dharmaparā pūrvajātismarā dṛḍhā..9..
4.103.d:
तेन दोषेण सा बाला अजायोनौ ह्यजायत ॥
वनेचरी धर्मपरा पूर्वजातिस्मरा दृढा॥9॥
4.103.m: Because of that flaw, that young woman was born in the womb of a goat; / roaming in the forest, devoted to dharma, firmly remembering her previous birth.

4.103.s:
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva gṛhītaṃ kṛttikāvratam ..
vyastā yūthaparibhraṣṭā upavāsaparisthitā .. 4.103.10 ..
4.103.d:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव गृहीतं कृत्तिकाव्रतम् ॥
व्यस्ता यूथपरिभ्रष्टा उपवासपरिस्थिता ॥ 4.103.10 ॥
4.103.m: By that very former habit, the Kṛttikā-vrata was undertaken [by her]; / separated and strayed from the herd, she remained steadfast in fasting.

4.103.s:
parakṣetreṇa gacchaṃtī ajā sasyāvamarddanī ..
kārttikyāṃ galake baddhvā grāmyakeṇa cirāgatā .. 11 ..
4.103.d:
परक्षेत्रेण गच्छंती अजा सस्यावमर्द्दनी ॥
कार्त्तिक्यां गलके बद्ध्वा ग्राम्यकेण चिरागता ॥ 11 ॥
4.103.m: Going through another's field, trampling the crops, the goat / was bound by the neck by a villager on the full moon of Kārttika, having come after a long time.

4.103.s:
dṛṣṭātriṇā mahābhāgā pūrvajātismareṇa sā ..
kāraṇaṃ budhya tāṃ buddhvā sahakāliṃdabhadrikām .. .. 12 ..
4.103.d:
दृष्टात्रिणा महाभागा पूर्वजातिस्मरेण सा ॥
कारणं बुध्य तां बुद्ध्वा सहकालिंदभद्रिकाम् ॥ ॥ 12 ॥
4.103.m: That fortunate one was seen by Atri, who remembered previous births; / knowing the cause and recognizing her along with [her identity as] Kaliṅgabhadrā,

4.103.s:
mokṣitā badarībaddhā caraṃtī kṛttikāvratam ..
gopālabaṃdhanātsādhvī anirvedaparā tu sā .. 13 ..
4.103.d:
मोक्षिता बदरीबद्धा चरंती कृत्तिकाव्रतम् ॥
गोपालबंधनात्साध्वी अनिर्वेदपरा तु सा ॥ 13 ॥
4.103.m: tied to a jujube tree while observing the Kṛttikā-vrata, / she was released from the cowherd's bondage, virtuous and free from despondency.

4.103.s:
saṃprāpya badarīpatraṃ pītvā puṣkariṇī payaḥ ..
mametyuktvā hyasaṃbhrāṃtā pārayāmāsa tadvratam ..
tasyai yogaṃ tato dattvā jagāmātristapovanam .. 14 ..
4.103.d:
संप्राप्य बदरीपत्रं पीत्वा पुष्करिणी पयः ॥
ममेत्युक्त्वा ह्यसंभ्रांता पारयामास तद्व्रतम् ॥
तस्यै योगं ततो दत्त्वा जगामात्रिस्तपोवनम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.103.m: Having obtained a jujube leaf and drunk water from a pond, / saying 'It is mine,' undaunted, she broke that fast; / then, having imparted yoga to her, Atri went to his penance grove.

4.103.s:
sāpi yogeśvarī bhūtvā niṃditvā janma cātmanaḥ ..
tatyāja yogātsvānprāṇānprasthitā gautamasya hi ..
ṛṣerbabhūva duhitā hyahalyāgarbhasundarī .. 15 ..
4.103.d:
सापि योगेश्वरी भूत्वा निंदित्वा जन्म चात्मनः ॥
तत्याज योगात्स्वान्प्राणान्प्रस्थिता गौतमस्य हि ॥
ऋषेर्बभूव दुहिता ह्यहल्यागर्भसुन्दरी ॥ 15 ॥
4.103.m: She too, becoming a mistress of yoga, censuring her own birth, / abandoned her life-breaths through yoga, and having departed, / became the daughter of the sage Gautama, beautiful from the womb of Ahalyā.

4.103.s:
yogalakṣmīti nāmnā sā kanyā guṇagaṇairyutā ..
vidyeva dattā sā pitrā śāṃḍilyāya maharṣaye ..
tapodhanāya dāṃtāya nityaṃ sahacarī babhau .. 16 ..
4.103.d:
योगलक्ष्मीति नाम्ना सा कन्या गुणगणैर्युता ॥
विद्येव दत्ता सा पित्रा शांडिल्याय महर्षये ॥
तपोधनाय दांताय नित्यं सहचरी बभौ ॥ 16 ॥
4.103.m: Named Yogalakṣmī, that maiden endowed with a host of virtues / was given by her father like sacred lore to the great sage Śāṇḍilya; / she shone as an eternal companion to that self-controlled ascetic rich in penance.

4.103.s:
brāhmalakṣmyā dīpyamānā sākṣādvedasmṛtiryathā ..
sarasvatī ca svāhā ca śacī cārundhatī yathā .. 17 ..
4.103.d:
ब्राह्मलक्ष्म्या दीप्यमाना साक्षाद्वेदस्मृतिर्यथा ॥
सरस्वती च स्वाहा च शची चारुन्धती यथा ॥ 17 ॥
4.103.m: Radiant with brāhmanical splendour, like the Veda and the Smṛti incarnate, / like Sarasvatī, Svāhā, Śacī, and Arundhatī,

4.103.s:
gaurī rājñī tathā lakṣmīrgāyatrī cottamā satī ..
mahālakṣmīstathā rājañchāṇḍilyasya gṛhe babhau .. 18 ..
4.103.d:
गौरी राज्ञी तथा लक्ष्मीर्गायत्री चोत्तमा सती ॥
महालक्ष्मीस्तथा राजञ्छाण्डिल्यस्य गृहे बभौ ॥ 18 ॥
4.103.m: like Gaurī, the Queen, Lakṣmī, Gāyatrī, and the supreme virtuous wife, / like Mahālakṣmī, O king, she shone in the house of Śāṇḍilya.

4.103.s:
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ nityaṃ śuśrūṣaṇe ratā ..
atha tenātriṇā dṛṣṭā punargarbhavatī gṛhe .. 19 ..
4.103.d:
पितृदेवमनुष्याणां नित्यं शुश्रूषणे रता ॥
अथ तेनात्रिणा दृष्टा पुनर्गर्भवती गृहे ॥ 19 ॥
4.103.m: Constantly devoted to the service of the ancestors, gods, and human beings, / she was then seen by that Atri when she was pregnant again in the house.

4.103.s:
bhaktyā bhikṣāṃ prayacchaṃtī brāhmaṇānāmaniṃditā ..
yogādviditvā tāmūce bhagavānpūrvavacchanaiḥ .. 4.103.20 ..
4.103.d:
भक्त्या भिक्षां प्रयच्छंती ब्राह्मणानामनिंदिता ॥
योगाद्विदित्वा तामूचे भगवान्पूर्ववच्छनैः ॥ 4.103.20 ॥
4.103.m: As she blamelessly offered alms to brāhmaṇas with devotion, / knowing [her] through yoga, the venerable one slowly addressed her as before:

4.103.s:
yogalakṣmi mahābhāge vartaṃte kati kṛttikāḥ ..
sāpi jātismarā prāha bhagavaṃtaṃ mahāsatī ..
ṣaḍvartaṃte mahāyoginnekā paravaśe sthitā .. 21 ..
4.103.d:
योगलक्ष्मि महाभागे वर्तंते कति कृत्तिकाः ॥
सापि जातिस्मरा प्राह भगवंतं महासती ॥
षड्वर्तंते महायोगिन्नेका परवशे स्थिता ॥ 21 ॥
4.103.m:
"O fortunate Yogalakṣmī, how many Kṛttikās exist?"
She too, remembering her past births, the deeply chaste woman said to the Lord:
"Six exist, O great yogin; one remains under another's control."

4.103.s:
tacchrutvāsyai bhagavatā sakāruṇyena cetasā ..
dattaṃ vrataṃ tathā mantro yena svargaṃ jagāma sā .. 22 ..
4.103.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वास्यै भगवता सकारुण्येन चेतसा ॥
दत्तं व्रतं तथा मन्त्रो येन स्वर्गं जगाम सा ॥ 22 ॥
4.103.m:
Having heard that, the Lord, with a mind full of compassion,
gave her a votive observance and also a mantra, by which she went to heaven.

4.103.s:
iha bhuktvā ciraṃ bhogānputrapautraśriyā vṛtā ..
tataḥ sā tatpadaṃ prāptā punarāvṛttidurlabham .. 23 .. ..
4.103.d:
इह भुक्त्वा चिरं भोगान्पुत्रपौत्रश्रिया वृता ॥
ततः सा तत्पदं प्राप्ता पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् ॥ 23 ॥ ॥
4.103.m:
After enjoying pleasures here for a long time, surrounded by the prosperity of sons and grandsons,
she then attained that realm from which rebirth is hard to find.

4.103.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kīdṛśaṃ tadvrataṃ kṛṣṇa maṃtraścāpi janārdana ..
vidhānaṃ kṛttikānāṃ ca taṃ ca kālaṃ vadasva me .. 24 ..
4.103.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कीदृशं तद्व्रतं कृष्ण मंत्रश्चापि जनार्दन ॥
विधानं कृत्तिकानां च तं च कालं वदस्व मे ॥ 24 ॥
4.103.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
What was that votive observance like, O Kṛṣṇa, and the mantra, O Janārdana?
Tell me the procedure regarding the Kṛttikās, and also the time.

4.103.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kṛttikāsu svayaṃ somaḥ kṛttikāsu bṛhaspatiḥ ..
yadā syātsomavāreṇa sā mahākārtikī smṛtā .. 25 ..
4.103.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
कृत्तिकासु स्वयं सोमः कृत्तिकासु बृहस्पतिः ॥
यदा स्यात्सोमवारेण सा महाकार्तिकी स्मृता ॥ 25 ॥
4.103.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
When Soma is himself in the Kṛttikās, and Bṛhaspati is in the Kṛttikās,
and if it should be on a Monday, that is remembered as the Mahākārtikī.

4.103.s:
īdṛśī bahubhirvarṣairbahupuṇyaiśca labhyate ..
tathā sā na vṛthā neyā yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ .. 26 ..
4.103.d:
ईदृशी बहुभिर्वर्षैर्बहुपुण्यैश्च लभ्यते ॥
तथा सा न वृथा नेया यदीच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः ॥ 26 ॥
4.103.m:
Such a day is attained only after many years and by means of much merit;
therefore it should not be spent in vain, if one desires one's own welfare.

4.103.s:
anyāpi kārtikī pārtha samupoṣya vidhānataḥ ..
tasyā vidhānaṃ rājendra śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhava .. 27 ..
4.103.d:
अन्यापि कार्तिकी पार्थ समुपोष्य विधानतः ॥
तस्या विधानं राजेन्द्र शृणुष्वैकमना भव ॥ 27 ॥
4.103.m:
Having fasted according to the rules also on any other Kārtikī, O son of Pṛthā—
hear the procedure for it, O king of kings, and be single-minded.

4.103.s:
kārttike śuklapakṣasya pūrṇamāsyāṃ dinodaye ..
naktāya niyamaṃ kuryāddantadhāvanapūrvakam .. 28 ..
4.103.d:
कार्त्तिके शुक्लपक्षस्य पूर्णमास्यां दिनोदये ॥
नक्ताय नियमं कुर्याद्दन्तधावनपूर्वकम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.103.m:
On the full moon day of the bright fortnight in Kārttika, at daybreak,
one should undertake the vow for a nocturnal meal, preceded by cleaning the teeth,

4.103.s:
upavāsasya vā śaktyā tataḥ snātvā jalāśaye ..
kurukṣetre prayāge vā puṣkare naimiṣe tathā .. 29 ..
4.103.d:
उपवासस्य वा शक्त्या ततः स्नात्वा जलाशये ॥
कुरुक्षेत्रे प्रयागे वा पुष्करे नैमिषे तथा ॥ 29 ॥
4.103.m:
or for a complete fast according to one's capacity; then, having bathed in a reservoir of water,
at Kurukṣetra, or Prayāga, at Puṣkara, or likewise at Naimiṣa,

4.103.s:
śālagrāme kuśāvarte mūlasthāne sakuntale ..
gokarṇe vārbude puṇye'tha vāpyamarakaṃṭake .. 4.103.30 ..
4.103.d:
शालग्रामे कुशावर्ते मूलस्थाने सकुन्तले ॥
गोकर्णे वार्बुदे पुण्येऽथ वाप्यमरकंटके ॥ 4.103.30 ॥
4.103.m:
at Śālagrāma, Kuśāvarta, Mūlasthāna, Śakuntala,
at Gokarṇa, or sacred Arbuda, or else at Amarakaṇṭaka,

4.103.s:
pure vā nagare vāpi grāme ghoṣe'tha pattane ..
yatra vā tatra vā snāyānnaro yoṣidathāpi vā ..
devarṣipitṛpūjāṃ ca kṛtvā homaṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 31 ..
4.103.d:
पुरे वा नगरे वापि ग्रामे घोषेऽथ पत्तने ॥
यत्र वा तत्र वा स्नायान्नरो योषिदथापि वा ॥
देवर्षिपितृपूजां च कृत्वा होमं युधिष्ठिर ॥ 31 ॥
4.103.m:
or in a city, a town, a village, a pastoral hamlet, or a port,
wherever it may be, a man or a woman should bathe,
and having performed the worship of the gods, sages, and ancestors, and the fire offering, O Yudhiṣṭhira,

4.103.s:
tato'stasamaye prāpte pātraṃ gavyasya sarpiṣaḥ ..
kṣīrasya vā susaṃpūrṇaṃ kṛtvā guḍaphalānvitam ..
ṣaṭpramāṇaṃ yathā vyomni kṛttikāśakaṭaṃ nyaset.. 32 ..
4.103.d:
ततोऽस्तसमये प्राप्ते पात्रं गव्यस्य सर्पिषः ॥
क्षीरस्य वा सुसंपूर्णं कृत्वा गुडफलान्वितम् ॥
षट्प्रमाणं यथा व्योम्नि कृत्तिकाशकटं न्यसेत्॥ 32 ॥
4.103.m:
then, when the time of sunset has arrived, having filled a vessel completely with cow's ghee
or milk, furnished with jaggery and fruits,
one should arrange the cart of the Kṛttikās measuring six [units], just as in the sky.

4.103.s:
ṣaṭkṛttikānāṃ biṃbāni svarṇaraupyamayāni ca ..
ratnagarbhāṇi kuryācca svaśaktyā pāṇḍunandana 33 ..
4.103.d:
षट्कृत्तिकानां बिंबानि स्वर्णरौप्यमयानि च ॥
रत्नगर्भाणि कुर्याच्च स्वशक्त्या पाण्डुनन्दन 33 ॥
4.103.m:
One should make images of the six Kṛttikās out of gold and silver,
and filled with gems, according to one's capacity, O son of Pāṇḍu:

4.103.s:
prathamā svarṇaniṣpannā dvitīyā raupyakīkṛtā ..
tṛtīyā ratnaghaṭitā caturthī navanītajā .. 34 ..
4.103.d:
प्रथमा स्वर्णनिष्पन्ना द्वितीया रौप्यकीकृता ॥
तृतीया रत्नघटिता चतुर्थी नवनीतजा ॥ 34 ॥
4.103.m:
The first made of gold, the second fashioned from silver,
the third crafted of gems, the fourth born of fresh butter,

4.103.s:
pañcamī kaṇikānyūnā ṣaṣṭhī piṣṭamayī kṛtā..
ṣaṭ kṛttikāḥ kṛtabiṃbāḥ kṛtvālaktakasūtrikāḥ .. 35 ..
4.103.d:
पञ्चमी कणिकान्यूना षष्ठी पिष्टमयी कृता॥
षट् कृत्तिकाः कृतबिंबाः कृत्वालक्तकसूत्रिकाः ॥ 35 ॥
4.103.m:
the fifth deficient in flour-grains, the sixth made of dough.
Having made the images of the six Kṛttikās, having bound them with threads dyed with red lac,

4.103.s:
ratnagarbhāḥ kuṃkumāktāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ stabakānvitāḥ ..
siṃdūracandanābhyaktā jātīpuṣpai supūjitāḥ ..
maṃtreṇānena rājendra dvijāya pratipādayet .. 36 ..
4.103.d:
रत्नगर्भाः कुंकुमाक्ताः पृष्ठतः स्तबकान्विताः ॥
सिंदूरचन्दनाभ्यक्ता जातीपुष्पै सुपूजिताः ॥
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र द्विजाय प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 36 ॥
4.103.m:
filled with gems, smeared with saffron, furnished with a bunch [of flowers] on the back,
anointed with vermilion and sandalwood, well worshipped with jasmine blossoms,
one should present them to a twice-born with this mantra, O king of kings:

4.103.s:
oṃ saptarṣidārā hyanalasya vallabhā yā brahmaṇā rakṣitayeti yuktāḥ ..
tuṣṭāḥ kumārasya yathārthamātaro mamāpi suprītatarā bhavaṃtu-svāhā .. 37 ..
4.103.d:
ओं सप्तर्षिदारा ह्यनलस्य वल्लभा या ब्रह्मणा रक्षितयेति युक्ताः ॥
तुष्टाः कुमारस्य यथार्थमातरो ममापि सुप्रीततरा भवंतु-स्वाहा ॥ 37 ॥
4.103.m:
"Oṃ. The wives of the seven sages, who are indeed the beloveds of Agni, joined as protected by Brahmā,
who are pleased, the true mothers of Kumāra—may they be exceedingly pleased with me as well. Svāhā."

4.103.s:
evamuccārya viprāya pradeyāḥ kṛttikā nṛpa ..
brāhmaṇopi pratīccheta maṃtreṇāneva pāṃḍava .. 38 ..
4.103.d:
एवमुच्चार्य विप्राय प्रदेयाः कृत्तिका नृप ॥
ब्राह्मणोपि प्रतीच्छेत मंत्रेणानेव पांडव ॥ 38 ॥
4.103.m:
Having spoken thus, the Kṛttikās should be given to a brāhmaṇa, O king.
The brāhmaṇa too should receive them with this mantra, O son of Pāṇḍu:

4.103.s:
dharmadāḥ kāmakāḥ saṃtu imā nakṣatramātaraḥ ..
kṛttikā durgasaṃsārāttārayaṃtvāvayoḥ kulam .. 39 ..
4.103.d:
धर्मदाः कामकाः संतु इमा नक्षत्रमातरः ॥
कृत्तिका दुर्गसंसारात्तारयंत्वावयोः कुलम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.103.m:
"May these mother-stars be grantors of dharma and fulfillers of desires;
may the Kṛttikās deliver our two families from the perilous cycle of worldly existence."

4.103.s:
anena vidhinā dattvā dṛṣṭvā caivāṃbare sthitāḥ ..
visṛjya brāhmaṇānbhaktyā cānuvrajya padāni ṣaṭ ..
nivartya ca kathārthaṃ tu śṛṇuyātphalamāpnuyāt .. 4.103.40 ..
4.103.d:
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा दृष्ट्वा चैवांबरे स्थिताः ॥
विसृज्य ब्राह्मणान्भक्त्या चानुव्रज्य पदानि षट् ॥
निवर्त्य च कथार्थं तु शृणुयात्फलमाप्नुयात् ॥ 4.103.40 ॥
4.103.m:
Having given them according to this procedure, and having gazed at those situated in the sky,
having dismissed the brāhmaṇas with devotion, and followed them for six steps,
one should return and listen to the purpose of the story, and attain the fruit.

4.103.s:
vimānenārkavarṇena gatvā nakṣatramaṃḍalam ..
divyena vapuṣā yuktaḥ srakcaṃdanavibhūṣitaḥ .. 41 ..
4.103.d:
विमानेनार्कवर्णेन गत्वा नक्षत्रमंडलम् ॥
दिव्येन वपुषा युक्तः स्रक्चंदनविभूषितः ॥ 41 ॥
4.103.m:
Having gone to the stellar sphere by means of a celestial chariot resembling the sun in colour,
endowed with a celestial body, adorned with garlands and sandalwood paste,

4.103.s:
divyanārīgaṇavṛtaḥ sukhaṃ bhuṃkte hyanāmayam ..
dodhūyamānaścamarai ratnapaṃktyā virājitaḥ .. 42 ..
4.103.d:
दिव्यनारीगणवृतः सुखं भुंक्ते ह्यनामयम् ॥
दोधूयमानश्चमरै रत्नपंक्त्या विराजितः ॥ 42 ॥
4.103.m:
surrounded by a throng of celestial women, one enjoys painless bliss,
fanned with chowries, radiant with a row of gems,

4.103.s:
pārijātakamaṃdārapuṣpabhāropaśobhitaḥ ..
kṛtārthaḥ paripūrṇāśastiṣṭhedābhūtasaṃplavam .. 43 ..
4.103.d:
पारिजातकमंदारपुष्पभारोपशोभितः ॥
कृतार्थः परिपूर्णाशस्तिष्ठेदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.103.m:
beautified with an abundance of pārijāta and mandāra flowers,
fulfilled in purpose and having all hopes completely realized, one remains until the dissolution of all beings.

4.103.s:
tārāḥ ' kṛtvā vratāṃte vā gatvā svargaṃ sabhartṛkā ..
ramate nirbhayā sādhvī sarvabhogasamanvitā .. 44 ..
4.103.d:
ताराः ' कृत्वा व्रतांते वा गत्वा स्वर्गं सभर्तृका ॥
रमते निर्भया साध्वी सर्वभोगसमन्विता ॥ 44 ॥
4.103.m:
Or having made the stars, at the completion of the votive observance, having gone to heaven together with her husband,
the virtuous woman rejoices without fear, endowed with all enjoyments.

4.103.s:
yaścaitackṛṇuyātpārtha bhaktiyuktaḥ samādhinā ..
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 45 ..
4.103.d:
यश्चैतच्कृणुयात्पार्थ भक्तियुक्तः समाधिना ॥
नारी वा पुरुषो वापि मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ॥ 45 ॥
4.103.m:
And whoever hears this, O son of Pṛthā, endowed with devotion and concentration,
whether a woman or a man, is freed from all sins.

4.103.s:
sauvarṇaraupyamaṇigonavanītasiddhāḥ ṣaṭ kṛttikāḥ kaṇikapiṣṭamayīśca kṛtvā ..
pātre nidhāya kusumākṣatadhūpadīpaiḥ saṃpūjya janmagahanaṃ na viśaṃti martyāḥ .. 46 .. ..
pūrṇamanorathavratavarṇanam
4.103.d:
सौवर्णरौप्यमणिगोनवनीतसिद्धाः षट् कृत्तिकाः कणिकपिष्टमयीश्च कृत्वा ॥
पात्रे निधाय कुसुमाक्षतधूपदीपैः संपूज्य जन्मगहनं न विशंति मर्त्याः ॥ 46 ॥ ॥
पूर्णमनोरथव्रतवर्णनम्
4.103.m:
Having made the six Kṛttikās out of gold, silver, gems, cow-dung, butter, / and dough of fine flour, placed them in a vessel, and worshipped them with flowers, unbroken grains, incense, and lamps, mortals do not enter the abyss of rebirth.
Description of the Pūrṇamanoratha-vrata

4.104.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pañcadaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe phālgunasya narottama ..
pākhaṃḍānpatitāṃścaiva tathaivāntyāvasāyinaḥ .. 1 ..
4.104.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पञ्चदश्यां शुक्लपक्षे फाल्गुनस्य नरोत्तम ॥
पाखंडान्पतितांश्चैव तथैवान्त्यावसायिनः ॥ 1 ॥
4.104.m: The Holy Lord said: / On the fifteenth lunar day in the bright fortnight of Phālguna, O best of men, / one should not converse with heretics, the fallen, and outcastes,

4.104.s:
nāstikānbhinnavṛttāṃśca pāpino naiva cālapet ..
nārāyaṇe gatamanāḥ puruṣo hi jitendriyaḥ ..2 ..
4.104.d:
नास्तिकान्भिन्नवृत्तांश्च पापिनो नैव चालपेत् ॥
नारायणे गतमनाः पुरुषो हि जितेन्द्रियः ॥2 ॥
4.104.m: nor with atheists, people of deviant conduct, or sinners. / Indeed, a man with controlled senses, his mind fixed upon Nārāyaṇa,

4.104.s:
tiṣṭhanvrajanpraskhalanvā bhuṃjānopi janārdanam ..
kīrtayecca kriyākāle saptakṛtvo mahīpate .. 3 ..
4.104.d:
तिष्ठन्व्रजन्प्रस्खलन्वा भुंजानोपि जनार्दनम् ॥
कीर्तयेच्च क्रियाकाले सप्तकृत्वो महीपते ॥ 3 ॥
4.104.m: standing, walking, stumbling, or even eating, / should chant the name of Janārdana seven times at the time of ritual action, O lord of earth.

4.104.s:
lakṣmyā samanvitaṃ devamarcayecca janārdanam ..
saṃdhyādyuparame candrasvarūpaṃ harimīśvaram ..
rātrau ca lakṣmīṃ saṃcintya samyagargheṇa pūjayeta .. 4 ..
4.104.d:
लक्ष्म्या समन्वितं देवमर्चयेच्च जनार्दनम् ॥
संध्याद्युपरमे चन्द्रस्वरूपं हरिमीश्वरम् ॥
रात्रौ च लक्ष्मीं संचिन्त्य सम्यगर्घेण पूजयेत ॥ 4 ॥
4.104.m: One should worship the god Janārdana accompanied by Lakṣmī; / at the end of twilight and other periods, [one should worship] Hari, the Lord, in the form of the moon; / and at night, contemplating Lakṣmī, one should duly worship [them] with an offering of water.

4.104.s:
śrīniśākararūpastvaṃ vāsudeva jagatpate ..
manobhilaṣitaṃ deva pūrayasva namonamaḥ .. 5 ..
4.104.d:
श्रीनिशाकररूपस्त्वं वासुदेव जगत्पते ॥
मनोभिलषितं देव पूरयस्व नमोनमः ॥ 5 ॥
4.104.m: ‘You have the form of the moon endowed with Lakṣmī, O Vāsudeva, Lord of the universe! / Fulfill the desire of my heart, O god! Reverence, reverence to You!’

4.104.s:
maṃtreṇānena dattvārghaṃ devadevasya bhaktitaḥ ..
naktaṃ bhuñjīta na svairaṃ tailakṣāravivarjitam .. 6 ..
4.104.d:
मंत्रेणानेन दत्त्वार्घं देवदेवस्य भक्तितः ॥
नक्तं भुञ्जीत न स्वैरं तैलक्षारविवर्जितम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.104.m: Having offered water to the God of gods with devotion using this mantra, / one should eat a nocturnal meal, not eating as one pleases, free of oil and alkaline substances.

4.104.s:
tathaiva caitre vaiśākhe jyeṣṭhe ca nṛpasattama ..
arcayecca yathāproktaṃ māsimāsi ca taddine .. 7 ..
4.104.d:
तथैव चैत्रे वैशाखे ज्येष्ठे च नृपसत्तम ॥
अर्चयेच्च यथाप्रोक्तं मासिमासि च तद्दिने ॥ 7 ॥
4.104.m: In the same manner in Caitra, Vaiśākha, and Jyeṣṭha, O best of kings, / one should worship as prescribed month after month on that day.

4.104.s:
niṣpāditaṃ bhavedekaṃ pāraṇaṃ pārtha śaktitaḥ ..
dvitīyaṃ cāpi vakṣyāmi pāraṇaṃ te narottama.. 8 ..
4.104.d:
निष्पादितं भवेदेकं पारणं पार्थ शक्तितः ॥
द्वितीयं चापि वक्ष्यामि पारणं ते नरोत्तम॥ 8 ॥
4.104.m: One fast-breaking will thus be accomplished according to one's capacity, O son of Pṛthā; / and I shall declare to you the second fast-breaking, O best of men.

4.104.s:
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe māsi prāpte bhādrapade tathā ..
tathaivāśvayujebhyarcya śrīdharaṃ priyayā saha ..
arghaṃ candramase dattvā bhuñjātātha yathāvidhi. .. 9 ..
4.104.d:
आषाढे श्रावणे मासि प्राप्ते भाद्रपदे तथा ॥
तथैवाश्वयुजेभ्यर्च्य श्रीधरं प्रियया सह ॥
अर्घं चन्द्रमसे दत्त्वा भुञ्जाताथ यथाविधि॥। 9 ॥
4.104.m: In Āṣāḍha, the month of Śrāvaṇa, and likewise when Bhādrapada has arrived, / and similarly in Āśvayuja, having worshipped Śrīdhara together with his beloved, / and given an offering of water to the moon, one should then eat according to the rules.

4.104.s:
dvitīyametadākhyātaṃ tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ śṛṇu ..
kārtikādiṣu māseṣu tathaivābhyarcya keśavam ..
bhūtyā samanvitaṃ dadyācchaśāṃkāya tathā niśi ... .. 4.104.10 ..
4.104.d:
द्वितीयमेतदाख्यातं तृतीयं पारणं शृणु ॥
कार्तिकादिषु मासेषु तथैवाभ्यर्च्य केशवम् ॥
भूत्या समन्वितं दद्याच्छशांकाय तथा निशि ॥॥। 4.104.10 ॥
4.104.m: This has been declared as the second; listen to the third fast-breaking. / In the months beginning with Kārtika, having worshipped Keśava in the same manner, / accompanied by Bhūti, one should likewise make an offering to the moon at night.

4.104.s:
bhuñjīta ca yathākhyātaṃ tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ śṛṇu ..
pratipūjya tato dadyādbrāhmaṇebhyaśca dakṣiṇām ..
pratimāsaṃ ca vakṣyāmi prāśanaṃ kāyaśuddhaye .. .. 11 ..
4.104.d:
भुञ्जीत च यथाख्यातं तृतीयं पारणं शृणु ॥
प्रतिपूज्य ततो दद्याद्ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च दक्षिणाम् ॥
प्रतिमासं च वक्ष्यामि प्राशनं कायशुद्धये ॥ ॥ 11 ॥
4.104.m: And one should eat as described. Listen to the third fast-breaking: / Having worshipped in turn, one should then give a sacrificial fee to brāhmaṇas; / and I shall describe the purifying consumption month by month for cleansing the body.

4.104.s:
caturaḥ prathamānmāsānpañcagavyamudāhṛtam ..
kuśodakaṃ tathaivānyaduktaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam .. 12 ..
4.104.d:
चतुरः प्रथमान्मासान्पञ्चगव्यमुदाहृतम् ॥
कुशोदकं तथैवान्यदुक्तं मासचतुष्टयम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.104.m: For the first four months, the five bovine products are prescribed; / for the next four months, kuśa-grass water is similarly declared;

4.104.s:
sūryāṃśutaptaṃ tadvacca jalaṃ kāyaviśodhanam ..
gītavādyādikaṃ rātrau tathā kṛṣṇakathāṃ śubhām ..
kārayeccaiva devasya pāraṇepāraṇe gate .. 13 ..
4.104.d:
सूर्यांशुतप्तं तद्वच्च जलं कायविशोधनम् ॥
गीतवाद्यादिकं रात्रौ तथा कृष्णकथां शुभाम् ॥
कारयेच्चैव देवस्य पारणेपारणे गते ॥ 13 ॥
4.104.m: and in the same way, water warmed by the rays of the sun cleanses the body. / At night, one should arrange singing, instrumental music, and the auspicious tale of Kṛṣṇa / for the god at each completed fast-breaking.

4.104.s:
janārdanaṃ sapatnīkamarcayetprathamaṃ tataḥ ..
saśrīkaṃ śrīdharaṃ tadvattṛtīye bhūtikeśavau .. 14 ..
4.104.d:
जनार्दनं सपत्नीकमर्चयेत्प्रथमं ततः ॥
सश्रीकं श्रीधरं तद्वत्तृतीये भूतिकेशवौ ॥ 14 ॥
4.104.m: First, one should worship Janārdana along with his wife; / then similarly Śrīdhara endowed with Śrī; in the third, Bhūti and Keśava.

4.104.s:
pratimāsaṃ tu nāmāni kṛṣṇasyaitāni bhārata ..
kṛtopavāsaḥ susnātaḥ pūjayitvā janārdanam ..
uccārayannaro yāti yathālokaṃ yathāsukham .. 15 ..
4.104.d:
प्रतिमासं तु नामानि कृष्णस्यैतानि भारत ॥
कृतोपवासः सुस्नातः पूजयित्वा जनार्दनम् ॥
उच्चारयन्नरो याति यथालोकं यथासुखम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.104.m: These are the names of Kṛṣṇa month by month, O Bhārata. / Having fasted, properly bathed, and worshipped Janārdana, / a man who utters them goes to his proper world in happiness.

4.104.s:
tato viprāya vai dadyādudakuṃbhaṃ sadakṣiṇam ..
upānadvastrayugmaṃ ca cchatraṃ kanakameva ca .. 16 ..
4.104.d:
ततो विप्राय वै दद्यादुदकुंभं सदक्षिणम् ॥
उपानद्वस्त्रयुग्मं च च्छत्रं कनकमेव च ॥ 16 ॥
4.104.m: Then one should indeed give to a brāhmaṇa a water pot with a sacrificial fee, / a pair of sandals and garments, a royal parasol, and gold.

4.104.s:
yadvai māsagataṃ nāma prīyatāmiti kīrtayet ..
keśavaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu pauṣe nārāyaṇaṃ tathā .. 17 ..
4.104.d:
यद्वै मासगतं नाम प्रीयतामिति कीर्तयेत् ॥
केशवं मार्गशीर्षे तु पौषे नारायणं तथा ॥ 17 ॥
4.104.m: Whichever name belongs to that month, one should pronounce: 'May He be pleased!'— / Keśava in Mārgaśīrṣa, and likewise Nārāyaṇa in Pauṣa,

4.104.s:
mādhavaṃ māghamāse tu govindamapi phālgune ..
caitramāse tathā viṣṇuṃ vaiśākhe madhusūdanam .. 18 ..
4.104.d:
माधवं माघमासे तु गोविन्दमपि फाल्गुने ॥
चैत्रमासे तथा विष्णुं वैशाखे मधुसूदनम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.104.m: Mādhava in the month of Māgha, and Govinda in Phālguna; / likewise Viṣṇu in the month of Caitra, and Madhusūdana in Vaiśākha;

4.104.s:
jyeṣṭhe trivikramo jñeyastathāṣāḍhe ca vāmanaḥ ..
śrīdharaḥ śrāvaṇe tadvaddhṛṣīkeśeti cāparam .. 19 ..
4.104.d:
ज्येष्ठे त्रिविक्रमो ज्ञेयस्तथाषाढे च वामनः ॥
श्रीधरः श्रावणे तद्वद्धृषीकेशेति चापरम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.104.m: in Jyeṣṭha, Trivikrama should be known, and likewise Vāmana in Āṣāḍha; / Śrīdhara in Śrāvaṇa, and Hṛṣīkeśa in the other [month, Bhādrapada].

4.104.s:
rāmo bhādrapade māsi gīyate puṇyakāṃkṣibhiḥ ..
padmanābhamāśvayuji dāmodaramataḥ param .. 4.104.20 ..
4.104.d:
रामो भाद्रपदे मासि गीयते पुण्यकांक्षिभिः ॥
पद्मनाभमाश्वयुजि दामोदरमतः परम् ॥ 4.104.20 ॥
4.104.m: Rāma is praised in the month of Bhādrapada by those who desire merit, / Padmanābha in Āśvayuja, and thereafter Dāmodara.

4.104.s:
kārtike devadeveśaṃ stuvaṃstarati durgatim ..
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte pratimāse kramoditam..
yadi dātuṃ na śaknoti dadyāccaivaikahelayā ..21..
4.104.d:
कार्तिके देवदेवेशं स्तुवंस्तरति दुर्गतिम् ॥
एवं संवत्सरस्यांते प्रतिमासे क्रमोदितम्॥
यदि दातुं न शक्नोति दद्याच्चैवैकहेलया ॥21॥
4.104.m: Praising the Lord of the gods of gods in Kārtika, one crosses over misfortune. / Thus, at the end of the year, if one is unable to give [gifts] month by month / as instructed in due order, one may give them all at once.

4.104.s:
viśeṣaścātra kathitaścandraṃ kṛtvā hiraṇmayam..
pūjayitvā phalairvastrairbrāhmaṇāya nivedayet..22..
4.104.d:
विशेषश्चात्र कथितश्चन्द्रं कृत्वा हिरण्मयम्॥
पूजयित्वा फलैर्वस्त्रैर्ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत्॥22॥
4.104.m: And a special rule has been taught here: having fashioned a moon of gold, / and having worshipped it with fruits and garments, one should present it to a brāhmaṇa.

4.104.s:
stuvannevaṃ vidhānena pāraṇe'bhyarcayetprabhum..
tāvaṃti janmānyasukhaṃ nāpnotīṣṭaviyogajam ..23..
4.104.d:
स्तुवन्नेवं विधानेन पारणेऽभ्यर्चयेत्प्रभुम्॥
तावंति जन्मान्यसुखं नाप्नोतीष्टवियोगजम् ॥23॥
4.104.m: Praising [him] thus in accordance with the injunction, one should worship the Lord at the breaking of the fast. / For that many births, one experiences no suffering born from separation from loved ones.

4.104.s:
ihaiva svasthatāṃ prāpya maraṇe smaraṇaṃ tataḥ..
sthānaṃ tu mama saṃprāpya svargaloke mahīyate .. 24 ..
4.104.d:
इहैव स्वस्थतां प्राप्य मरणे स्मरणं ततः॥
स्थानं तु मम संप्राप्य स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥ 24 ॥
4.104.m: Having attained well-being in this very world, and then remembrance [of the Lord] at death, / having reached my abode, one is glorified in heaven.

4.104.s:
tato mānuṣyamāsādya nirātaṃko gatajvaraḥ ..
dhanadhānyavati sphīte janma sādhukulerhati ..25..
4.104.d:
ततो मानुष्यमासाद्य निरातंको गतज्वरः ॥
धनधान्यवति स्फीते जन्म साधुकुलेर्हति ॥25॥
4.104.m: Then, attaining human birth, free from anguish and rid of fever, / one is worthy of birth in an upright family, prosperous and rich in wealth and grain.

4.104.s:
śrīśarvarī madhuni hā bhagavāñchaśāṃkaḥ saṃkalpya candanatilākṣatapuṣpamiśram ..
yacchaṃti ye'rghamanayā nṛpa pūrṇimāyāṃ nūnaṃ bhavaṃti paripūrṇamanorathāste .. 26 ..
4.104.d:
श्रीशर्वरी मधुनि हा भगवाञ्छशांकः संकल्प्य चन्दनतिलाक्षतपुष्पमिश्रम् ॥
यच्छंति येऽर्घमनया नृप पूर्णिमायां नूनं भवंति परिपूर्णमनोरथास्ते ॥ 26 ॥
4.104.m: O king, on the full moon day, those who offer this water-offering combined with sandalwood paste, sesamum seeds, unbroken rice-grains, and flowers, meditating, 'O Lord Moon, destroyer of the night's darkness in the spring,'—their desires indeed become fully accomplished.

4.104.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde pūrṇamanorathavrataṃ nāma caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 104 .. ..
viśokapūrṇimāvratavarṇanam
4.104.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे पूर्णमनोरथव्रतं नाम चतुरधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ॥ 104 ॥ ॥
विशोकपूर्णिमाव्रतवर्णनम्
4.104.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and fourth chapter, named 'The Votive Observance of the Full Accomplishment of Desires,' in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Votive Observance of the Sorrowless Full Moon

4.105.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
aśokapūrṇimāṃ cānyāṃ śṛṇuṣva gadato mama ..
yāmupoṣya narāḥ śokaṃ nāpnuvaṃti kadācana .. 1 ..
4.105.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अशोकपूर्णिमां चान्यां शृणुष्व गदतो मम ॥
यामुपोष्य नराः शोकं नाप्नुवंति कदाचन ॥ 1 ॥
4.105.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hear further from me as I speak of another [votive observance], the Sorrowless Full Moon, / fasting on which mortals never experience grief.

4.105.s:
phālgunāmalapakṣasya paurṇamāsyāṃ narottama ..
mṛjjalena naraḥ snātvā dattvā śirasi vai mṛdam ..
mṛtprāśanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kṛtvā ca sthaṃḍilaṃ mṛdā .. 2 ..
4.105.d:
फाल्गुनामलपक्षस्य पौर्णमास्यां नरोत्तम ॥
मृज्जलेन नरः स्नात्वा दत्त्वा शिरसि वै मृदम् ॥
मृत्प्राशनं ततः कृत्वा कृत्वा च स्थंडिलं मृदा ॥ 2 ॥
4.105.m: On the full moon day of the pure fortnight of Phālguna, O best of men, / a person, having bathed with clay and water, and placed clay upon the head, / should then swallow [a bit of] clay and prepare an altar with clay.

4.105.s:
puṣpaiḥ patraistathābhyarcya bhūdharaṃ nāma nāmataḥ ..
dharaṇīṃ ca tathā devīmaśoketyabhikīrtayet .. 3 ..
4.105.d:
पुष्पैः पत्रैस्तथाभ्यर्च्य भूधरं नाम नामतः ॥
धरणीं च तथा देवीमशोकेत्यभिकीर्तयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
4.105.m: Having worshipped Bhūdhara by name with flowers and leaves, / one should likewise proclaim the goddess Dharaṇī as 'Aśokā' ('Sorrowless'):

4.105.s:
yathā viśokāṃ dharaṇe kṛtavāṃstvāṃ janārdanaḥ ..
tathā māṃ sarvaśokebhyo mocayāśeṣadhāriṇi ..4 ..
4.105.d:
यथा विशोकां धरणे कृतवांस्त्वां जनार्दनः ॥
तथा मां सर्वशोकेभ्यो मोचयाशेषधारिणि ॥4 ॥
4.105.m: 'Just as Janārdana made you sorrowless, O Earth, / so deliver me from all sorrows, O supporter of all things!

4.105.s:
yathā samastabhūtānāmādhārattvaṃ vyavasthitā ..
tathā viśokaṃ kuru māṃ sakalecchāvibhūtibhiḥ .. 5 ..
4.105.d:
यथा समस्तभूतानामाधारत्त्वं व्यवस्थिता ॥
तथा विशोकं कुरु मां सकलेच्छाविभूतिभिः ॥ 5 ॥
4.105.m: Just as you stand as the foundation of all beings, / so make me sorrowless, endowed with all desires and splendours!

4.105.s:
dhyānamātre yathā viṣṇoḥ svāsthyaṃ jānāsi medini ..
tathā manaḥ svasthatāṃ me kuru tvaṃ bhūtadhāriṇi .. 6 ..
4.105.d:
ध्यानमात्रे यथा विष्णोः स्वास्थ्यं जानासि मेदिनि ॥
तथा मनः स्वस्थतां मे कुरु त्वं भूतधारिणि ॥ 6 ॥
4.105.m: Just as you know well-being, O Earth, through the mere contemplation of Viṣṇu, / so bring peace of mind to me, O sustainer of beings!'

4.105.s:
evaṃ stutvā tathābhyarcya candrāyārghyaṃ nivedya ca..
upoṣitavyaṃ naktaṃ vā bhoktavyaṃ tailavarjitam .. 7 ..
4.105.d:
एवं स्तुत्वा तथाभ्यर्च्य चन्द्रायार्घ्यं निवेद्य च॥
उपोषितव्यं नक्तं वा भोक्तव्यं तैलवर्जितम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.105.m: Having praised [her] thus and worshipped her, and having presented a water-offering to the moon, / one must observe a fast, or take a nocturnal meal devoid of oil.

4.105.s:
anenaiva prakāreṇa catvāraḥ phālgunādayaḥ ..
upoṣyā nṛpate māsāḥ prathamaṃ pāraṇaṃ smṛtam .. .. 8 ..
4.105.d:
अनेनैव प्रकारेण चत्वारः फाल्गुनादयः ॥
उपोष्या नृपते मासाः प्रथमं पारणं स्मृतम् ॥ ॥ 8 ॥
4.105.m: In this very manner, four months beginning with Phālguna / are to be observed by fasting, O king; this is taught as the first fast-breaking.

4.105.s:
āṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu tadvatsnānaṃ mṛdaṃbunā ..
tathaiva prāśanaṃ pūjā tadvadiṃdostathārhaṇam .. 9 ..
4.105.d:
आषाढादिषु मासेषु तद्वत्स्नानं मृदंबुना ॥
तथैव प्राशनं पूजा तद्वदिंदोस्तथार्हणम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.105.m: In the months beginning with Āṣāḍha, bathing with clay and water is done in the same way; / so too the ingestion [of clay], the worship, and likewise the offering to the moon.

4.105.s:
caturṣvanyeṣu caivoktaṃ kārtikādiṣu pāraṇam..
pāraṇatritaye caiva cāturmāsikamucyate .. 4.105.10 ..
4.105.d:
चतुर्ष्वन्येषु चैवोक्तं कार्तिकादिषु पारणम्॥
पारणत्रितये चैव चातुर्मासिकमुच्यते ॥ 4.105.10 ॥
4.105.m: And the fast-breaking is prescribed in the other four months beginning with Kārtika; / this triplet of fast-breakings is indeed called the four-month cycle.

4.105.s:
viśeṣapūjā dānaṃ ca tathā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi ..
viśeṣeṇaiva kartavyaṃ pāraṇepāraṇe gate .. 11 ..
4.105.d:
विशेषपूजा दानं च तथा जागरणं निशि ॥
विशेषेणैव कर्तव्यं पारणेपारणे गते ॥ 11 ॥
4.105.m: Special worship, gifting, and likewise vigil at night / are to be performed especially as each fast-breaking arrives.

4.105.s:
prathame dharaṇī nāma tubhyaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam ..
dvitīye medinī vācyā tṛtīye ca vasundharā .. 12 ..
4.105.d:
प्रथमे धरणी नाम तुभ्यं मासचतुष्टयम् ॥
द्वितीये मेदिनी वाच्या तृतीये च वसुन्धरा ॥ 12 ॥
4.105.m: For the first four months, [she is called] by the name Dharaṇī for you; / in the second, she is to be addressed as Medinī; and in the third, as Vasundharā.

4.105.s:
pāraṇepāraṇe pārtha yugmānevārccayeddvijān ..
dharaṇīṃ deva devaṃ ca tattatsthānena keśavam . . 13 ..
4.105.d:
पारणेपारणे पार्थ युग्मानेवार्च्चयेद्द्विजान् ॥
धरणीं देव देवं च तत्तत्स्थानेन केशवम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.105.m: At each fast-breaking, O son of Pṛthā, one should worship pairs of twice-born [brāhmaṇas], / and the Earth, and Keśava, the god of gods, in each respective place.

4.105.s:
vastrābhāve ca sūtreṇa pūjayeddharaṇīṃ tathā ..
ghṛtābhāve tathā kṣīraṃ śastaṃ vā salilaṃ hareḥ . .. 14 . .
4.105.d:
वस्त्राभावे च सूत्रेण पूजयेद्धरणीं तथा ॥
घृताभावे तथा क्षीरं शस्तं वा सलिलं हरेः ॥। 14 ॥
4.105.m: In the absence of a cloth, one may thus worship the Earth with a thread; / in the absence of ghee, milk is commended, or water for Hari.

4.105.s:
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte gauḥ savatsā dvijātaye ..
pradeyā dharaṇī devī vastrālaṃkārasaṃyutā .. 15 ..
4.105.d:
एवं संवत्सरस्यांते गौः सवत्सा द्विजातये ॥
प्रदेया धरणी देवी वस्त्रालंकारसंयुता ॥ 15 ॥
4.105.m: Thus, at the end of the year, a cow along with her calf / and the goddess Earth adorned with garments and ornaments should be given to a twice-born [brāhmaṇa].

4.105.s:
pātālasaṃsthayā devyā cīrṇametanmahāvratam . .
dharaṇyā keśava prītyai tataḥ prāptā samunnatiḥ .. 16 ..
4.105.d:
पातालसंस्थया देव्या चीर्णमेतन्महाव्रतम् ॥
धरण्या केशव प्रीत्यै ततः प्राप्ता समुन्नतिः ॥ 16 ॥
4.105.m: This great votive observance was practiced by the goddess Earth / dwelling in the netherworld for the pleasure of Keśava; thence she attained supreme elevation.

4.105.s:
devena coktā dharaṇī varāhavapuṣā purā ..
upavāsavrataparā samuddhṛtya rasātalāt .. 17 . .
4.105.d:
देवेन चोक्ता धरणी वराहवपुषा पुरा ॥
उपवासव्रतपरा समुद्धृत्य रसातलात् ॥ 17 ॥
4.105.m: And having lifted her up from the netherworld, the god in the form of a boar / formerly spoke to the Earth, who was devoted to the votive fast:

4.105.s:
vratenānena kalyāṇi tvayāhaṃ paritoṣitaḥ ..
tasmātprasādamatulaṃ karomi tava suvate .. 18 ..
4.105.d:
व्रतेनानेन कल्याणि त्वयाहं परितोषितः ॥
तस्मात्प्रसादमतुलं करोमि तव सुवते ॥ 18 ॥
4.105.m: 'O auspicious one, I am thoroughly pleased by you through this votive observance; / therefore, O virtuous lady, I bestow incomparable grace upon you.

4.105.s:
yathaiva kuruṣe bhaktyā pūjāṃ mama suśobhanām . .
tathaiva tava kalyāṇi praṇato yaḥ kariṣyati . . 1 9. .
4.105.d:
यथैव कुरुषे भक्त्या पूजां मम सुशोभनाम् ॥
तथैव तव कल्याणि प्रणतो यः करिष्यति ॥ 1 9॥
4.105.m: Just as you perform my very splendid worship with devotion, / so too, O auspicious one, whoever, bowing down, shall perform yours,

4.105.s:
vratametadupāśritya pāraṇaṃ ca yathāvidhi . .
sarvabādhāvinirmukto janmajanmāṃtarāṇyapi ..
viśokaḥ sarvakalyāṇabhājanaṃ syānna saṃśayaḥ .. 4.105.20 ..
4.105.d:
व्रतमेतदुपाश्रित्य पारणं च यथाविधि ॥
सर्वबाधाविनिर्मुक्तो जन्मजन्मांतराण्यपि ॥
विशोकः सर्वकल्याणभाजनं स्यान्न संशयः ॥ 4.105.20 ॥
4.105.m: relying upon this votive observance and breaking the fast according to rule, / freed from all afflictions across life after life, / shall, free from sorrow, become a vessel of all blessings—there is no doubt.

4.105.s:
yathā tvameva vasudhe saṃprāptā nirvṛteḥ padam . .
tathā sa paramam̐lloke sukhaṃ prāpsyati mānavaḥ . . 21 ..
4.105.d:
यथा त्वमेव वसुधे संप्राप्ता निर्वृतेः पदम् ॥
तथा स परमम्̐ल्लोके सुखं प्राप्स्यति मानवः ॥ 21 ॥
4.105.m: Just as you, O Earth, have reached the abode of bliss, / so that mortal shall attain supreme happiness in the world.'

4.105.s:
evametanmahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraśāṃtidam . .
viśokākhyaṃ vratavaraṃ tatkuruṣva mahāvratam .. 22 ..
4.105.d:
एवमेतन्महापुण्यं सर्वपापप्रशांतिदम् ॥
विशोकाख्यं व्रतवरं तत्कुरुष्व महाव्रतम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.105.m: Thus, this is of great merit and pacifies all sins; / therefore undertake that great votive observance, the excellent observance named Viśoka.

4.105.s:
samyagviśokakaraṇī nṛpapūrṇimā te khyātā mayā manumahendrasamānakīrte ..
evaṃ karoti kurupuṃgava yaḥ prayatnācchoko na tasya bhavatīha kulepi puṃsaḥ .. 23 . .
anantavratavarṇanam
4.105.d:
सम्यग्विशोककरणी नृपपूर्णिमा ते ख्याता मया मनुमहेन्द्रसमानकीर्ते ॥
एवं करोति कुरुपुंगव यः प्रयत्नाच्छोको न तस्य भवतीह कुलेपि पुंसः ॥ 23 ॥
अनन्तव्रतवर्णनम्
4.105.m:
The full moon day that thoroughly brings about freedom from sorrow has been declared to you, O king whose fame equals that of Manu and the chief of gods; / O bull among Kurus, for the man who diligently performs it thus, grief never arises in this world, nor in his family.
Description of the Votive Observance of Ananta

4.106.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca . . ..
sarvakāmānavāpnoti samārādhya janārdanam ..
prakārairbahubhiḥ kṛṣṇa yānyānicchati cetasā .. 1 ..
4.106.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
सर्वकामानवाप्नोति समाराध्य जनार्दनम् ॥
प्रकारैर्बहुभिः कृष्ण यान्यानिच्छति चेतसा ॥ 1 ॥
4.106.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Having propitiated Janārdana in many ways, O Kṛṣṇa, / one obtains all desires, whatever one wishes for in one's heart.

4.106.s:
nṛṇāṃ strīṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ nānyacchokasya kāraṇam ..
apatyādadhikaṃ kiṃcidvidyate hyatra janmani.. .. 2 ..
4.106.d:
नृणां स्त्रीणां च सर्वेषां नान्यच्छोकस्य कारणम् ॥
अपत्यादधिकं किंचिद्विद्यते ह्यत्र जन्मनि॥ ॥ 2 ॥
4.106.m: For all men and women, there is no other cause of grief / greater in this birth than that concerning offspring.

4.106.s:
aputratā mahāduḥkhamatiduḥkhaṃ kuputratā ..
suputraḥ sarvasaukhyānāṃ hetubhūto mato mama .. 3 ..
4.106.d:
अपुत्रता महादुःखमतिदुःखं कुपुत्रता ॥
सुपुत्रः सर्वसौख्यानां हेतुभूतो मतो मम ॥ 3 ॥
4.106.m: Childlessness is great sorrow; having a bad son is extreme sorrow; / a good son, in my opinion, is the cause of all joys.

4.106.s:
dhanyāste ye sutaṃ prāptāḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitam . .
śaktaṃ praśāṃtaṃ balinaṃ parāṃ nirvṛtimāgatam ..4..
4.106.d:
धन्यास्ते ये सुतं प्राप्ताः सर्वदुःखविवर्जितम् ॥
शक्तं प्रशांतं बलिनं परां निर्वृतिमागतम् ॥4॥
4.106.m: Blessed are those who have obtained a son free from all affliction, / capable, peaceful, strong, and arrived at supreme tranquility;

4.106.s:
svakarmābhirataṃ nityaṃ devadvijaparāyaṇam..
śāstrajñaṃ sarvadharmajñaṃ dīnānāthānukaṃpinam .. 5 .. .
4.106.d:
स्वकर्माभिरतं नित्यं देवद्विजपरायणम्॥
शास्त्रज्ञं सर्वधर्मज्ञं दीनानाथानुकंपिनम् ॥ 5 ॥ ।
4.106.m: ever devoted to his own duties, intent upon the gods and the twice-born, / knowledgeable in the sacred texts and in all dharma, compassionate toward the poor and helpless;

4.106.s:
vinirjitārisarvasvaṃ manohṛdayanandanam ..
devānukūlatāyuktaṃ yuktaṃ samyagguṇena ca ..6..
4.106.d:
विनिर्जितारिसर्वस्वं मनोहृदयनन्दनम् ॥
देवानुकूलतायुक्तं युक्तं सम्यग्गुणेन च ॥6॥
4.106.m: who has conquered all possessions of his enemies, who gladdens the mind and heart, / endowed with the favour of the gods, and endowed with complete virtue;

4.106.s:
mitrasvajanasanmānalabdhaṃ nirvāṇamuttamam ..
yaḥ prāpnoti sutaṃ tasmānnānyo dhanyataro bhuvi .. 7 ..
4.106.d:
मित्रस्वजनसन्मानलब्धं निर्वाणमुत्तमम् ॥
यः प्राप्नोति सुतं तस्मान्नान्यो धन्यतरो भुवि ॥ 7 ॥
4.106.m: who has attained the highest bliss through the respect of friends and kin— / than he who obtains [such] a son, there is none more blessed on earth.

4.106.s:
so'hamevaṃvidhaṃ śrotuṃ karmecchāmi mahāmate ..
yenedṛglakṣaṇaḥ putraḥ prāpyate bhuvi mānavaiḥ .. 8 ..
4.106.d:
सोऽहमेवंविधं श्रोतुं कर्मेच्छामि महामते ॥
येनेदृग्लक्षणः पुत्रः प्राप्यते भुवि मानवैः ॥ 8 ॥
4.106.m: Therefore, O highly wise one, I desire to hear of such an act / by which a son with such characteristics is obtained on earth by mortals.

4.106.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
evametanmahābhāga putrāputrasamudbhavam ..
duḥkhaṃ prayātyupaśamaṃ tanayānneha kenacit .. 9 ..
4.106.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
एवमेतन्महाभाग पुत्रापुत्रसमुद्भवम् ॥
दुःखं प्रयात्युपशमं तनयान्नेह केनचित् ॥ 9 ॥
4.106.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Thus it is, O fortunate one: the distress born of having or not having a son / never comes to an end in this world through anyone other than a child.

4.106.s:
atrāpi śrūyatāṃ vṛttaṃ yatpūrvamabhavanmune ..
utpattau kārtavīryasya haihayasya mahātmanaḥ .. 4.106.10 ..
4.106.d:
अत्रापि श्रूयतां वृत्तं यत्पूर्वमभवन्मुने ॥
उत्पत्तौ कार्तवीर्यस्य हैहयस्य महात्मनः ॥ 4.106.10 ॥
4.106.m: In this regard also, hear the account of what occurred in the past, O sage, / at the birth of the great-souled Kārtavīrya the Haihaya.

4.106.s:
kṛtavīryo mahīpālo haihayo nāma vai purā ..
tasya śīladhanā nāma babhūva varavarṇinī .. 11 ..
4.106.d:
कृतवीर्यो महीपालो हैहयो नाम वै पुरा ॥
तस्य शीलधना नाम बभूव वरवर्णिनी ॥ 11 ॥
4.106.m: Long ago there was a king named Kṛtavīrya, a Haihaya. / He had an excellent wife named Śīladhanā,

4.106.s:
patnī sahasrapravarā mahiṣī śīlamaṇḍanā ..
sā tvaputrā mahābhāgā maitreyīṃ paryapṛcchata .. 12 ..
4.106.d:
पत्नी सहस्रप्रवरा महिषी शीलमण्डना ॥
सा त्वपुत्रा महाभागा मैत्रेयीं पर्यपृच्छत ॥ 12 ॥
4.106.m: his queen, foremost among a thousand wives, adorned with good character. / Childless, that fortunate woman questioned Maitreyī,

4.106.s:
guṇavatputralābhāya kṛtāsanaparigraham ..
tayā pṛṣṭātha sā samyaṅmaitreyī brahmavādinī .. 13 ..
4.106.d:
गुणवत्पुत्रलाभाय कृतासनपरिग्रहम् ॥
तया पृष्टाथ सा सम्यङ्मैत्रेयी ब्रह्मवादिनी ॥ 13 ॥
4.106.m: who was seated, in order to obtain a virtuous son. / Questioned by her, that Maitreyī, who expounded the Veda,

4.106.s:
kathayāmāsa paramaṃ nāmnānantavrataṃ mahat ..
sarvakāmaphalāvāptikāraṇaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
tasyāḥ suputralābhāya rājaputryāstapasvinī .. 14 ..
4.106.d:
