कथयामास परमं नाम्नानन्तव्रतं महत् ॥
सर्वकामफलावाप्तिकारणं पापनाशनम् ॥
तस्याः सुपुत्रलाभाय राजपुत्र्यास्तपस्विनी ॥ 14 ॥
4.106.m: duly declared to the princess, for the sake of obtaining a noble son, / the supreme and great votive observance named Anantavrata, / the cause of attaining the fruit of all desires, the destroyer of sins, the ascetic woman [said]:

4.106.s:
.. maitreyyuvāca .. ..
yo yamicchennaraḥ kāmaṃ nārī vā varavarṇinī .. 15 ..
4.106.d:
॥ मैत्रेय्युवाच ॥ ॥
यो यमिच्छेन्नरः कामं नारी वा वरवर्णिनी ॥ 15 ॥
4.106.m: Maitreyī said: / Whatever desire a man, or a woman of fair complexion, may wish,

4.106.s:
sa taṃ samārādhya vibhuṃ samāpnoti janārdanāt ..
mārgaśīrṣe mṛgaśiro bhīmo yasmindine'bhavat ..16..
4.106.d:
स तं समाराध्य विभुं समाप्नोति जनार्दनात् ॥
मार्गशीर्षे मृगशिरो भीमो यस्मिन्दिनेऽभवत् ॥16॥
4.106.m: by propitiating the all-pervading lord Janārdana, one attains it from him. / In Mārgaśīrṣa, on the day when the formidable [constellation] Mṛgaśiras occurs,

4.106.s:
tasminsaṃprāśya gomūtraṃ snāto niyatamānasaḥ ..
puṣpairdhūpaistathā gandhairupavāsaiśca bhaktitaḥ ..
vāmapādamanaṃtasya pūjayedvaravarṇini .. 17 ..
4.106.d:
तस्मिन्संप्राश्य गोमूत्रं स्नातो नियतमानसः ॥
पुष्पैर्धूपैस्तथा गन्धैरुपवासैश्च भक्तितः ॥
वामपादमनंतस्य पूजयेद्वरवर्णिनि ॥ 17 ॥
4.106.m: having consumed cow's urine on that day, bathed, and with mind restrained, / with flowers, incense, perfumes, and fasts, out of devotion, / one should worship the left foot of Ananta, O fair-complexioned lady.

4.106.s:
anaṃtaḥ sarvakāmānāmanaṃtaṃ bhagavānphalam ..
dadātvanantaṃ ca punastadevānyatra janmani .. 18 ..
4.106.d:
अनंतः सर्वकामानामनंतं भगवान्फलम् ॥
ददात्वनन्तं च पुनस्तदेवान्यत्र जन्मनि ॥ 18 ॥
4.106.m: "May the blessed Ananta grant the endless fruit of all desires, / and again grant that which is endless in another birth.

4.106.s:
anaṃtapuṇyopacayamanantaṃ tu mahāvratam ..
yathābhilaṣitāvāptiṃ kuru me puruṣottama .. 19 ..
4.106.d:
अनंतपुण्योपचयमनन्तं तु महाव्रतम् ॥
यथाभिलषितावाप्तिं कुरु मे पुरुषोत्तम ॥ 19 ॥
4.106.m: This is the great observance of Ananta, an accumulation of endless merit; / bring about the attainment of my desired wish, O Puruṣottama!"

4.106.s:
ityuccāryābhipūjyainaṃ yathāvadvidhinā naraḥ ..
samāhitamanā bhūtvā praṇipātapurassaram.. 4.106.20 ..
4.106.d:
इत्युच्चार्याभिपूज्यैनं यथावद्विधिना नरः ॥
समाहितमना भूत्वा प्रणिपातपुरस्सरम्॥ 4.106.20 ॥
4.106.m: Having spoken thus and worshiped him duly according to the rule, / with focused mind, preceded by prostrations,

4.106.s:
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādanaṃtaḥ prīyatāmiti ..
samuccārya tato naktaṃ bhuñjītatailavarjitam .. 21 ..
4.106.d:
विप्राय दक्षिणां दद्यादनंतः प्रीयतामिति ॥
समुच्चार्य ततो नक्तं भुञ्जीततैलवर्जितम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.106.m: one should give a priestly gift to a brāhmaṇa, uttering: "May Ananta be pleased!" / Then, uttering [the mantra], one should eat a nocturnal meal devoid of oil.

4.106.s:
tataśca pauṣe puṣyarkṣe tathaiva bhagavatkaṭim ..
vāmāmabhyarccayedbhaktyā gomūtraprāśanaṃ tataḥ ..22..
4.106.d:
ततश्च पौषे पुष्यर्क्षे तथैव भगवत्कटिम् ॥
वामामभ्यर्च्चयेद्भक्त्या गोमूत्रप्राशनं ततः ॥22॥
4.106.m: Then, in Pauṣa under the Puṣya constellation, in the same manner, / one should worship the left waist of the Lord with devotion, followed by the consumption of cow's urine.

4.106.s:
anaṃtaḥ sarvakāmānā miti coccārayetpunaḥ..
bhojayeta tathā viprānvācayitvā yathāvidhi ..23..
4.106.d:
अनंतः सर्वकामाना मिति चोच्चारयेत्पुनः॥
भोजयेत तथा विप्रान्वाचयित्वा यथाविधि ॥23॥
4.106.m: And one should again utter: "Ananta of all desires..." / Then, having them recite [benedictions] according to rule, one should feed the brāhmaṇas.

4.106.s:
māghe maghāsu tadvacca bāhuṃ devasya pūjayet ..
skandhau ca mama phālgunyoḥ phālgune māsi bhāmini .. 24 ..
4.106.d:
माघे मघासु तद्वच्च बाहुं देवस्य पूजयेत् ॥
स्कन्धौ च मम फाल्गुन्योः फाल्गुने मासि भामिनि ॥ 24 ॥
4.106.m: In Māgha under Maghā, in like manner, one should worship the arm of the deity, / and under the two Phālgunīs in the month of Phālguna, worship my shoulders, O lady.

4.106.s:
caturṣveteṣu gomūtraṃ prāśayennṛpanaṃdini ..
brāhmaṇāya tathā dadyāttilānkanakameva ca .. 25 ..
4.106.d:
चतुर्ष्वेतेषु गोमूत्रं प्राशयेन्नृपनंदिनि ॥
ब्राह्मणाय तथा दद्यात्तिलान्कनकमेव च ॥ 25 ॥
4.106.m: During these four [months], one should consume cow's urine, O princess, / and likewise give sesame seeds and gold to a brāhmaṇa.

4.106.s:
devasya dakṣiṇaṃ skandhaṃ caitre citrāsu pūjayet ..
tathaiva prāśanaṃ cātra pañcagavyamudāhṛtam ..
vipre pravācake dadyādyavānmāsacatuṣṭayam .. 26 ..
4.106.d:
देवस्य दक्षिणं स्कन्धं चैत्रे चित्रासु पूजयेत् ॥
तथैव प्राशनं चात्र पञ्चगव्यमुदाहृतम् ॥
विप्रे प्रवाचके दद्याद्यवान्मासचतुष्टयम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.106.m: In Caitra under Citrā, one should worship the right shoulder of the deity; / and the consumption prescribed here is the five products of the cow; / one should give barley to the reciting brāhmaṇa for four months.

4.106.s:
vaiśākhe ca viśākhāsu bāhuṃ sampūjya dakṣiṇam..
tathaivoktānyavāndadyānnaktaṃ kuryādbhujikriyām .. 27 ..
4.106.d:
वैशाखे च विशाखासु बाहुं सम्पूज्य दक्षिणम्॥
तथैवोक्तान्यवान्दद्यान्नक्तं कुर्याद्भुजिक्रियाम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.106.m: And in Vaiśākha under Viśākhā, having worshiped the right arm, / one should give the barley as stated, and perform the act of eating as a nocturnal meal.

4.106.s:
jyeṣṭhāsu kaṭipūjāṃ ca jyeṣṭhamāsi śubhavrate ..
āṣāḍhāsu tathāṣāḍhe kuryātpādārcanaṃ śubhe .. 28 ..
4.106.d:
ज्येष्ठासु कटिपूजां च ज्येष्ठमासि शुभव्रते ॥
आषाढासु तथाषाढे कुर्यात्पादार्चनं शुभे ॥ 28 ॥
4.106.m: Under Jyeṣṭhā, in the month of Jyeṣṭha, [perform] the worship of the waist, O lady of auspicious vows; / and in Āṣāḍha under the Āṣāḍhās, one should perform the worship of the feet, O auspicious one.

4.106.s:
pādadvayaṃ tu śravaṇe śrāvaṇe māsi pūjayet ..
ghṛtaṃ viprāya dātavyaṃ prāśanīyaṃ yathāvidhi .. 29 ..
4.106.d:
पादद्वयं तु श्रवणे श्रावणे मासि पूजयेत् ॥
घृतं विप्राय दातव्यं प्राशनीयं यथाविधि ॥ 29 ॥
4.106.m: One should worship the two feet under Śravaṇa in the month of Śrāvaṇa; / ghee is to be given to a brāhmaṇa, and consumed according to rule.

4.106.s:
śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu prāśanaṃ dānameva ca ..
etadevaṃ samākhyātaṃ devāṃstadvacca pūjayet .. 4.106.30 ..
4.106.d:
श्रावणादिषु मासेषु प्राशनं दानमेव च ॥
एतदेवं समाख्यातं देवांस्तद्वच्च पूजयेत् ॥ 4.106.30 ॥
4.106.m: In the months beginning with Śrāvaṇa, the consumption and the gift / are thus explained, and in the same way one should worship the deities.

4.106.s:
guhyaṃ proṣṭhapadāyoge māsi bhādrapade'rcayet ..
tadvadāśvayuje pūjyaṃ hṛdayaṃ cāśvinīṣu ca .. 31 ..
4.106.d:
गुह्यं प्रोष्ठपदायोगे मासि भाद्रपदेऽर्चयेत् ॥
तद्वदाश्वयुजे पूज्यं हृदयं चाश्विनीषु च ॥ 31 ॥
4.106.m: One should worship the private parts during the conjunction of Proṣṭhapadā in the month of Bhādrapada; / likewise, in Āśvayuja under the Aśvinīs, the heart is to be worshiped.

4.106.s:
kuryātsamāhitamanāḥ snānaṃ prāśanamarcanam ..
anantaśirasaḥ pūjāṃ kārttike kṛttikāsu ca .. 32 ..
4.106.d:
कुर्यात्समाहितमनाः स्नानं प्राशनमर्चनम् ॥
अनन्तशिरसः पूजां कार्त्तिके कृत्तिकासु च ॥ 32 ॥
4.106.m: With a concentrated mind, one should perform the bath, the consumption, and the worship; / and in Kārttika under the Kṛttikās, the worship of the head of Ananta.

4.106.s:
yasminyasmindine pūjā tatratatra tadā dine ..
nāmānaṃtasya japtavyaṃ kṣutapraskhalitādiṣu ..33..
4.106.d:
यस्मिन्यस्मिन्दिने पूजा तत्रतत्र तदा दिने ॥
नामानंतस्य जप्तव्यं क्षुतप्रस्खलितादिषु ॥33॥
4.106.m: On whatever day the worship takes place, then on that day / the name of Ananta is to be muttered during sneezes, stumbles, and the like.

4.106.s:
ghṛtenānaṃtamuddiśya pūrvaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam ..
kurvīta homaṃ caitrādau śālinā kulanaṃdini .. 34 ..
4.106.d:
घृतेनानंतमुद्दिश्य पूर्वं मासचतुष्टयम् ॥
कुर्वीत होमं चैत्रादौ शालिना कुलनंदिनि ॥ 34 ॥
4.106.m: During the first four months, one should perform the fire oblation with ghee dedicated to Ananta, / and in [the four months] beginning with Caitra, with rice, O delighter of your family.

4.106.s:
kṣīreṇa śrāvaṇādau ca homo māsacatuṣṭayam ..
praśastaṃ sarvamāseṣu haviṣyānnena bhojanam .. 35 ..
4.106.d:
क्षीरेण श्रावणादौ च होमो मासचतुष्टयम् ॥
प्रशस्तं सर्वमासेषु हविष्यान्नेन भोजनम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.106.m: In the four months beginning with Śrāvaṇa, the oblation is with milk; / in all months, eating sacrificial food is praised.

4.106.s:
evaṃ dvādaśabhirmāsaiḥ pāraṇātritayaṃ śubhe ..
vratāvasāne cānantaṃ sauvarṇaṃ kārayecchubham .. 36 ..
4.106.d:
एवं द्वादशभिर्मासैः पारणात्रितयं शुभे ॥
व्रतावसाने चानन्तं सौवर्णं कारयेच्छुभम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.106.m: Thus, over twelve months there are three ritual meal-breakings, O auspicious one. / At the conclusion of the vow, one should have an auspicious golden [image of] Ananta made.

4.106.s:
rājataṃ musalaṃ caiva halaṃ pārśveṣu vinyaset ..
puṣpadhūpādinaivedyaiḥ pūjā kāryā yathāvidhi .. 37 ..
4.106.d:
राजतं मुसलं चैव हलं पार्श्वेषु विन्यसेत् ॥
पुष्पधूपादिनैवेद्यैः पूजा कार्या यथाविधि ॥ 37 ॥
4.106.m: And one should place a silver pestle and a plow at the sides; / worship should be performed according to rule with flowers, incense, food offerings, and so forth,

4.106.s:
tāmrapīṭhopari harermantrairebhiryathākramam ..
namo'stvanaṃtāya śiraḥ pādau sarvātmane namaḥ .. 38 ..
4.106.d:
ताम्रपीठोपरि हरेर्मन्त्रैरेभिर्यथाक्रमम् ॥
नमोऽस्त्वनंताय शिरः पादौ सर्वात्मने नमः ॥ 38 ॥
4.106.m: upon a copper pedestal for Hari, with these mantras in due order: / "Homage to Ananta" for the head; "Homage to the Self of All" for the feet;

4.106.s:
śeṣāya jānuyugalaṃ kāmāyeti kaṭiṃ namaḥ ..
namostu vāsudevāya pārśvaṃ saṃpūjayeddhareḥ .. 39 ..
4.106.d:
शेषाय जानुयुगलं कामायेति कटिं नमः ॥
नमोस्तु वासुदेवाय पार्श्वं संपूजयेद्धरेः ॥ 39 ॥
4.106.m: "To Śeṣa" for the two knees; "Homage to Kāma" for the waist; / "Homage to Vāsudeva": one should worship the side of Hari.

4.106.s:
saṃkarṣaṇāyetyudaraṃ bhujaṃ sarvāsudhāriṇe ..
kaṇṭhaṃ śrīkaṇṭhanāthāya mukhamiṃdumukhāya ca .. 4.106.40 ..
4.106.d:
संकर्षणायेत्युदरं भुजं सर्वासुधारिणे ॥
कण्ठं श्रीकण्ठनाथाय मुखमिंदुमुखाय च ॥ 4.106.40 ॥
4.106.m: "To Saṃkarṣaṇa" for the belly; "To the Holder of All Breaths" for the arm; / "To the Lord Śrīkaṇṭhanātha" for the throat; and "To the Moon-Faced" for the face.

4.106.s:
halaṃ ca musalaṃ caiva svanāmnā pūjayedbudhaḥ ..
evaṃ sampūjya govindaṃ sitavastravibhūṣitam .. 41 ..
4.106.d:
हलं च मुसलं चैव स्वनाम्ना पूजयेद्बुधः ॥
एवं सम्पूज्य गोविन्दं सितवस्त्रविभूषितम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.106.m: The wise person should worship the plow and the pestle with their own names. / Having thus worshiped Govinda, adorned with white garments,

4.106.s:
chatropānatsusaṃyuktaṃ sragdāmālaṃkṛtaṃ tathā ..
nakṣatradevatāḥ pūjyā nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvaśaḥ .. 42 ..
4.106.d:
छत्रोपानत्सुसंयुक्तं स्रग्दामालंकृतं तथा ॥
नक्षत्रदेवताः पूज्या नक्षत्राणि च सर्वशः ॥ 42 ॥
4.106.m: provided with an umbrella and sandals, and decorated with flower garlands, / the asterism deities and the asterisms are to be worshiped in every respect,

4.106.s:
somo nakṣatrarājaśca māsaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ tathā ..
dvādaśātra ghaṭānkuryātsa toyāṃścānnasaṃyutān .. 43 ..
4.106.d:
सोमो नक्षत्रराजश्च मासः संवत्सरं तथा ॥
द्वादशात्र घटान्कुर्यात्स तोयांश्चान्नसंयुतान् ॥ 43 ॥
4.106.m: as well as Soma the king of asterisms, the month, and the year. / Here one should provide twelve water-jars containing water and food.

4.106.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivaddevadevaṃ janārdanam ..
brāhmaṇaṃ pūjayitvā ca vastrairābharaṇaistathā .. 44 ..
4.106.d:
एवं संपूज्य विधिवद्देवदेवं जनार्दनम् ॥
ब्राह्मणं पूजयित्वा च वस्त्रैराभरणैस्तथा ॥ 44 ॥
4.106.m: Having thus worshiped the god of gods, Janārdana, according to rule, / and having worshiped a brāhmaṇa with garments and ornaments,

4.106.s:
karṇāṃgulaiḥ pavitraiśca śāṃtaṃ dāṃtaṃ jitendriyam ..
purāṇajñaṃ dharmanityamavyaṃgaṃ supriyaṃvadam .. 45 ..
4.106.d:
कर्णांगुलैः पवित्रैश्च शांतं दांतं जितेन्द्रियम् ॥
पुराणज्ञं धर्मनित्यमव्यंगं सुप्रियंवदम् ॥ 45 ॥
4.106.m: with earrings, finger-rings, and sacred Kuśa rings—one who is tranquil, self-restrained, possessing conquered senses, / knowledgeable in the Purāṇas, constant in dharma, without physical blemish, and sweet-spoken—

4.106.s:
tasmai deyaṃ samastaṃ tadanantaḥ prīyatāmiti ..
anyeṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca deyaṃ śaktyā yathepsitam .. 46 ..
4.106.d:
तस्मै देयं समस्तं तदनन्तः प्रीयतामिति ॥
अन्येषां ब्राह्मणानां च देयं शक्त्या यथेप्सितम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.106.m: to him all that should be given, saying: "May Ananta be pleased!" / And to other brāhmaṇas, gifts should be given according to capacity, as desired.

4.106.s:
anena vidhinā pārtha vrataṃ caitatsamāpyate ..
pārite ca samāpnoti sarvāneva manorathān .. 47 ..
4.106.d:
अनेन विधिना पार्थ व्रतं चैतत्समाप्यते ॥
पारिते च समाप्नोति सर्वानेव मनोरथान् ॥ 47 ॥
4.106.m: By this procedure, O Pārtha, this votive observance is completed; / and when completed, one obtains all desires.

4.106.s:
putrārthibhirvittakāmairbhṛtyadārānabhīpsubhiḥ ..
prārthayadbhiśca martye'sminnārogyaphalasampadaḥ .. 48 ..
4.106.d:
पुत्रार्थिभिर्वित्तकामैर्भृत्यदारानभीप्सुभिः ॥
प्रार्थयद्भिश्च मर्त्येऽस्मिन्नारोग्यफलसम्पदः ॥ 48 ॥
4.106.m: By those desiring sons, by those seeking wealth, by those longing for servants and a wife, / and by those praying in this mortal world for the prosperity of the fruit of health,

4.106.s:
etadvrataṃ mahābhāge puṇyaṃ svastyayanapradam ..
anaṃtavratasaṃjñaṃ vai sarva pāpapraṇāśanam .. 49 ..
4.106.d:
एतद्व्रतं महाभागे पुण्यं स्वस्त्ययनप्रदम् ॥
अनंतव्रतसंज्ञं वै सर्व पापप्रणाशनम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.106.m: this votive observance, O fortunate one, is meritorious, conferring welfare, / known as the Anantavrata, and destroying all sin.

4.106.s:
tatkuruṣvaiva devi tvaṃ vrataṃ śīladhane param ..
variṣṭhaṃ sarvalokasya yadi putramabhīpsasi .. 4.106.50 ..
4.106.d:
तत्कुरुष्वैव देवि त्वं व्रतं शीलधने परम् ॥
वरिष्ठं सर्वलोकस्य यदि पुत्रमभीप्ससि ॥ 4.106.50 ॥
4.106.m: Therefore, O queen Śīladhanā, perform this supreme votive observance, / the highest in the whole world, if you desire a son.

4.106.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
iti śīladhanā śrutvā maitreyīvacanaṃ śubham ..
cakāraitadvratavaraṃ sā viṣṇvāhitamānasā .. 51 ..
4.106.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
इति शीलधना श्रुत्वा मैत्रेयीवचनं शुभम् ॥
चकारैतद्व्रतवरं सा विष्ण्वाहितमानसा ॥ 51 ॥
4.106.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Having heard these auspicious words of Maitreyī, / Śīladhanā, fixing her mind on Viṣṇu, performed this excellent votive observance.

4.106.s:
putrārthinyāstatastasmādvratenānena suvrata ..
viṣṇustutoṣa tuṣṭe ca viṣṇau sā suṣuve sutam .. 52 ..
4.106.d:
पुत्रार्थिन्यास्ततस्तस्माद्व्रतेनानेन सुव्रत ॥
विष्णुस्तुतोष तुष्टे च विष्णौ सा सुषुवे सुतम् ॥ 52 ॥
4.106.m: Then, because of that votive observance of hers who longed for a son, O you of good vows, / Viṣṇu was pleased, and when Viṣṇu was pleased, she gave birth to a son.

4.106.s:
tasya vai jātamātrasya pravavau cānilaḥ śubham ..
nīrajaskamabhūdvyoma mudaṃ prāpākhilaṃ jagat..53..
4.106.d:
तस्य वै जातमात्रस्य प्रववौ चानिलः शुभम् ॥
नीरजस्कमभूद्व्योम मुदं प्रापाखिलं जगत्॥53॥
4.106.m: As soon as he was born, an auspicious wind blew, / the sky became free of dust, and the entire world experienced joy.

4.106.s:
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca ..
prajagurdevagaṃdharvā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ..54..
4.106.d:
देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात च ॥
प्रजगुर्देवगंधर्वा ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः ॥54॥
4.106.m: Divine drums sounded, and a shower of flowers fell; / celestial Gandharvas sang, and hosts of Apsarases danced.

4.106.s:
dharme manaḥ samastasya pārtha lokasya cābhavat ..
tasya nāma pitā cakre tanayasyārjuneti vai ..55 ..
4.106.d:
धर्मे मनः समस्तस्य पार्थ लोकस्य चाभवत् ॥
तस्य नाम पिता चक्रे तनयस्यार्जुनेति वै ॥55 ॥
4.106.m: And the mind of the entire world turned toward dharma, O Pārtha. / His father gave that son the name Arjuna.

4.106.s:
kṛtavīryasutatvācca kārtavīryo babhūva saḥ ..
tenāpi bhagavānviṣṇurdattātreyasvarūpavān ..
ārādhito'timahatā tapasā pārtha bhūbhṛtā ..56..
4.106.d:
कृतवीर्यसुतत्वाच्च कार्तवीर्यो बभूव सः ॥
तेनापि भगवान्विष्णुर्दत्तात्रेयस्वरूपवान् ॥
आराधितोऽतिमहता तपसा पार्थ भूभृता ॥56॥
4.106.m: And being the son of Kṛtavīrya, he became Kārtavīrya. / By him too, as king, Lord Viṣṇu in the form of Dattātreya / was propitiated with exceedingly great austerity, O Pārtha.

4.106.s:
tasya tuṣṭo jagannāthaścakravartitvamuttamam ..
dadau śauryadhane cāpi sakalānyāyudhāni ca ..
sa vavre ca vadho deva mama tvatto bhavediti ..57..
4.106.d:
तस्य तुष्टो जगन्नाथश्चक्रवर्तित्वमुत्तमम् ॥
ददौ शौर्यधने चापि सकलान्यायुधानि च ॥
स वव्रे च वधो देव मम त्वत्तो भवेदिति ॥57॥
4.106.m: Pleased with him, the Lord of the Universe granted supreme universal sovereignty, / his wealth in valour, and all weapons. / And he chose [a boon]: "O Lord, let my death come from you alone;

4.106.s:
paraṃ tu smaraṇaṃ jñānaṃ bhītānāmārtināśanam ..
smaraṇādupakārittvaṃ jagato'sya jagatpate ..58..
4.106.d:
परं तु स्मरणं ज्ञानं भीतानामार्तिनाशनम् ॥
स्मरणादुपकारित्त्वं जगतोऽस्य जगत्पते ॥58॥
4.106.m: moreover, [grant me] remembering [the past], knowledge, destruction of the distress of those who are afraid, / and benevolence to this world through being remembered, O Lord of the Universe."

4.106.s:
tamāha devadeveśaḥ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ ..
sarvametanmahābhāga tava bhūyo bhaviṣyati .. 59 ..
4.106.d:
तमाह देवदेवेशः पुण्डरीकनिभेक्षणः ॥
सर्वमेतन्महाभाग तव भूयो भविष्यति ॥ 59 ॥
4.106.m: The Lord of the gods of gods, whose eyes resemble a white lotus, said to him: / "All this, O highly fortunate one, shall be yours in abundance.

4.106.s:
yaśca prabhāte rātrau ca tvāṃ naraḥ kīrtayiṣyati ..
namo'stu kārtavīryāyetyabhidhāsyati caiva yaḥ ..
tilaprasthapradānasya naraḥ puṇyamavāpsyati .. 4.106.60 ..
4.106.d:
यश्च प्रभाते रात्रौ च त्वां नरः कीर्तयिष्यति ॥
नमोऽस्तु कार्तवीर्यायेत्यभिधास्यति चैव यः ॥
तिलप्रस्थप्रदानस्य नरः पुण्यमवाप्स्यति ॥ 4.106.60 ॥
4.106.m: And whatever man shall glorify you at dawn and at night, / and shall say, 'Obeisance to Kārtavīrya,' / that man shall obtain the merit of giving a prastha of sesame.

4.106.s:
anaṣṭadravyatā caiva tava nāmānukīrtane..
bhaviṣyati mahīpāletyuktvā taṃ prayayau hariḥ..61..
4.106.d:
अनष्टद्रव्यता चैव तव नामानुकीर्तने॥
भविष्यति महीपालेत्युक्त्वा तं प्रययौ हरिः॥61॥
4.106.m: And also no loss of possessions shall occur upon the proclamation of your name, / O ruler of the earth." Having spoken thus, Hari departed.

4.106.s:
sa cāpi varamāsādya prasannādgaruḍadhvajāt ..
pālayāmāsa bhūpālaḥ saptadvīpāṃ vasuṃdharām .. 62 ..
4.106.d:
स चापि वरमासाद्य प्रसन्नाद्गरुडध्वजात् ॥
पालयामास भूपालः सप्तद्वीपां वसुंधराम् ॥ 62 ॥
4.106.m: And having obtained the boon from the pleased Garuḍa-bannered lord, / that king ruled the earth of seven continents.

4.106.s:
teneṣṭaṃ vividhairyajñaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ ..
jitvārivargamakhilaṃ dharmataḥ pālitāḥ prajāḥ .. 63 ..
4.106.d:
तेनेष्टं विविधैर्यज्ञैः समाप्तवरदक्षिणैः ॥
जित्वारिवर्गमखिलं धर्मतः पालिताः प्रजाः ॥ 63 ॥
4.106.m: He sacrificed with various sacrifices concluding with excellent sacrificial fees; / having conquered the entire host of enemies, he protected his subjects righteously.

4.106.s:
anaṃtavratamāhātmyādāsādya tanayaṃ ca tam ..
pituḥ putrodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsītsvalpamapi prabho .. .. 64 ..
4.106.d:
अनंतव्रतमाहात्म्यादासाद्य तनयं च तम् ॥
पितुः पुत्रोद्भवं दुःखं नासीत्स्वल्पमपि प्रभो ॥ ॥ 64 ॥
4.106.m: And having obtained that son through the majesty of the Ananta votive observance, / there was not even the slightest grief arising from a son for his father, O Lord.

4.106.s:
evametatsamākhyātamanaṃtākhyaṃ vrataṃ tava ..
yatkṛtvā rājapatnī sā kārtavīryamasūyata .. 65 ..
4.106.d:
एवमेतत्समाख्यातमनंताख्यं व्रतं तव ॥
यत्कृत्वा राजपत्नी सा कार्तवीर्यमसूयत ॥ 65 ॥
4.106.m: Thus has this votive observance named Ananta been related to you, / by performing which that king's wife gave birth to Kārtavīrya.

4.106.s:
yaścaitacchṛṇuyājjanma kārtavīryasya mānavaḥ ..
strī vā duḥkhamapatyotthaṃ saptajanmasu nāśnute .. 66 ..
4.106.d:
यश्चैतच्छृणुयाज्जन्म कार्तवीर्यस्य मानवः ॥
स्त्री वा दुःखमपत्योत्थं सप्तजन्मसु नाश्नुते ॥ 66 ॥
4.106.m: Whatever man or woman hears this birth of Kārtavīrya / does not experience grief arising from offspring for seven births.

4.106.s:
aiśvaryamapratihataṃ paramaṃ vivekaṃ putrānamitrahṛdayārtikarānbahūṃśca ..
kṛtvā tvanaṃta iti yadvrata nāmadheyaṃ prāpnotyanaṃtavibhavasya vibhoḥ prasādāt .. 67 .. ..
sāṃbharāyaṇīvratavarṇanam
4.106.d:
ऐश्वर्यमप्रतिहतं परमं विवेकं पुत्रानमित्रहृदयार्तिकरान्बहूंश्च ॥
कृत्वा त्वनंत इति यद्व्रत नामधेयं प्राप्नोत्यनंतविभवस्य विभोः प्रसादात् ॥ 67 ॥ ॥
सांभरायणीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.106.m:
Having performed the votive observance that has the name Ananta, / one obtains unimpeded sovereignty, supreme discernment, and many sons who cause distress to the hearts of enemies, / through the grace of the omnipresent Lord of infinite glory.
Description of the Sāmbharāyaṇī Votive Observance

4.107.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
aprāptairna tathā duḥkhamaiśvaryādyairnarottama ..
yathā manorathaiḥ svaiḥ svairnānāduḥkhaṃ bhavennṛṇām .. 1 ..
4.107.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
अप्राप्तैर्न तथा दुःखमैश्वर्याद्यैर्नरोत्तम ॥
यथा मनोरथैः स्वैः स्वैर्नानादुःखं भवेन्नृणाम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.107.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Grief does not arise for men so much from sovereign power and the like remaining unattained, O best of men, / as various kinds of grief come to men from their own respective desires.

4.107.s:
yathā manorathairlabdhairna syādduḥkhabhayaṃ nṛṇām ..
aiśvaryādvicyuto vāpi saṃtaterdevalokataḥ .. 2 ..
4.107.d:
यथा मनोरथैर्लब्धैर्न स्याद्दुःखभयं नृणाम् ॥
ऐश्वर्याद्विच्युतो वापि संततेर्देवलोकतः ॥ 2 ॥
4.107.m: So that through attained desires fear of grief might not befall men, / whether one has fallen from sovereign power, from offspring, or from the world of the gods,

4.107.s:
abhīṣṭādanyato vāpi yadāghena viniṣkṛtim ..
prāpnoti puruṣo vātha nārī vā puṇyasaṃcayāt ..
tanmamācakṣva bhagavanyena nābhyeti vicyutim .. 3 .. ..
4.107.d:
अभीष्टादन्यतो वापि यदाघेन विनिष्कृतिम् ॥
प्राप्नोति पुरुषो वाथ नारी वा पुण्यसंचयात् ॥
तन्ममाचक्ष्व भगवन्येन नाभ्येति विच्युतिम् ॥ 3 ॥ ॥
4.107.m: or from any other desired thing—by which expiation for sin / a man or woman obtains [relief] through an accumulation of merit, / declare that to me, O Lord, whereby one does not suffer a fall.

4.107.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahābhāga duḥkhaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ .. 4 ..
4.107.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
सत्यमेतन्महाभाग दुःखं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयः ॥ 4 ॥
4.107.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / This is true, O highly fortunate one: doubtlessly one meets with grief,

4.107.s:
aiśvaryodayacittasya baṃdhuvargasukhasya ca ..
tadetacchrūyatāṃ pārtha yathā neṣṭātparicyutiḥ .. 5 ..
4.107.d:
ऐश्वर्योदयचित्तस्य बंधुवर्गसुखस्य च ॥
तदेतच्छ्रूयतां पार्थ यथा नेष्टात्परिच्युतिः ॥ 5 ॥
4.107.m: both of a mind aspiring to rise to sovereign power and of the happiness of a circle of kin. / Therefore hear this, O Pārtha, so that no fall from the desired state,

4.107.s:
svargāderjāyate samyagupavāsavatāṃ satām ..
dvādaśarkṣāṇi rājendra pratimāsaṃ tu yāni vai .. 6 ..
4.107.d:
स्वर्गादेर्जायते सम्यगुपवासवतां सताम् ॥
द्वादशर्क्षाणि राजेन्द्र प्रतिमासं तु यानि वै ॥ 6 ॥
4.107.m: such as heaven, properly arises for virtuous men who undertake fasts. / O king of kings, the twelve asterisms that occur month by month—

4.107.s:
tannāmnā cācyutaṃ teṣu samyaksaṃpūjayennṛpa ..
puṣpairdhūpaistathāṃbhobhirabhīṣṭairaparairapi .. 7 ..
4.107.d:
तन्नाम्ना चाच्युतं तेषु सम्यक्संपूजयेन्नृप ॥
पुष्पैर्धूपैस्तथांभोभिरभीष्टैरपरैरपि ॥ 7 ॥
4.107.m: under their name one should properly worship Acyuta in them, O king, / with flowers, incenses, waters, and other desired [offerings].

4.107.s:
āditaḥ kṛttikāṃ kṛtvā kārttike nṛpasattama ..
kṛśarāmatra naivedyaṃ pūrvaṃ māsa catuṣṭayam ..8..
4.107.d:
आदितः कृत्तिकां कृत्वा कार्त्तिके नृपसत्तम ॥
कृशरामत्र नैवेद्यं पूर्वं मास चतुष्टयम् ॥8॥
4.107.m: Beginning with Kṛttikā in Kārttika, O best of kings, / the food offering here for the first four months is kṛśarā.

4.107.s:
nivedayetphālgunādi saṃyāvaṃ ca tataḥ param ..
āṣāḍhādiṣu devāya pāyasaṃ vinivedayet .. 9 ..
4.107.d:
निवेदयेत्फाल्गुनादि संयावं च ततः परम् ॥
आषाढादिषु देवाय पायसं विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 9 ॥
4.107.m: From Phālguna onwards one should offer saṃyāva, and after that, / in Āṣāḍha and following [months], one should offer pāyasa to the God.

4.107.s:
tenaivānnena rājendra brāhmaṇānbhojayedbudhaḥ ..
pañcagavyajalasnānaṃ tasyaiva prāśanācchuciḥ .. 4.107.10 ..
4.107.d:
तेनैवान्नेन राजेन्द्र ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेद्बुधः ॥
पञ्चगव्यजलस्नानं तस्यैव प्राशनाच्छुचिः ॥ 4.107.10 ॥
4.107.m: With that very food, O king of kings, the wise person should feed brāhmaṇas; / one is purified by bathing with water mixed with the five products of the cow and drinking it.

4.107.s:
samyaksaṃpūjya rājendra tameva puruṣottamam ..
praṇamya prārthayedviṣṇuṃ śuciḥ snāto yathāvidhi ..11..
4.107.d:
सम्यक्संपूज्य राजेन्द्र तमेव पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥
प्रणम्य प्रार्थयेद्विष्णुं शुचिः स्नातो यथाविधि ॥11॥
4.107.m: Having properly worshipped that very Supreme Puruṣa, O king of kings, / and having bowed down, one, pure and bathed according to rule, should pray to Viṣṇu:

4.107.s:
namonamaste'cyuta me kṣayostu pāpasya vṛddhiṃ samupaitu puṇyam ..
aiśvaryavittādi tathā'kṣayaṃ mekṣayaṃ ca mā saṃtatirabhyupaitu .. 12 ..
4.107.d:
नमोनमस्तेऽच्युत मे क्षयोस्तु पापस्य वृद्धिं समुपैतु पुण्यम् ॥
ऐश्वर्यवित्तादि तथाऽक्षयं मेक्षयं च मा संततिरभ्युपैतु ॥ 12 ॥
4.107.m: "Obeisance, obeisance to you, O Acyuta! Let there be destruction of my sin; let merit increase! / Likewise, let my sovereign power, wealth, and the like be imperishable, and let my lineage not come to ruin!

4.107.s:
yathācyutastvaṃ parataḥ parasmātsa brahmabhūtaḥ parataḥ parātmā ..
tathācyutaṃ me kuru vāṃchitaṃ tvaṃ harasva pāpaṃ ca tathāprameya .. 13 ..
4.107.d:
यथाच्युतस्त्वं परतः परस्मात्स ब्रह्मभूतः परतः परात्मा ॥
तथाच्युतं मे कुरु वांछितं त्वं हरस्व पापं च तथाप्रमेय ॥ 13 ॥
4.107.m: Just as you, O Acyuta, are higher than the highest, one who has become Brahman, the supreme self beyond the beyond, / so make my wish unfailing, and take away my sin, O immeasurable one!

4.107.s:
acyutānaṃta govinda prasīda yadabhīpsitam ..
tadakṣayamameyātmankuruṣva puruṣottama .. 14 ..
4.107.d:
अच्युतानंत गोविन्द प्रसीद यदभीप्सितम् ॥
तदक्षयममेयात्मन्कुरुष्व पुरुषोत्तम ॥ 14 ॥
4.107.m: O Acyuta, O Ananta, O Govinda, be gracious! Whatever is desired, / make that imperishable, O immeasurable-souled one, O Supreme Puruṣa!"

4.107.s:
evamevaṃ samabhyarcya prārthayitvā tathā śivam ..
naivedyaṃ svayamaśnīyānnaktaṃ saṃpūjitecyute .. 15 ..
4.107.d:
एवमेवं समभ्यर्च्य प्रार्थयित्वा तथा शिवम् ॥
नैवेद्यं स्वयमश्नीयान्नक्तं संपूजितेच्युते ॥ 15 ॥
4.107.m: Having thus worshipped and likewise prayed for what is auspicious, / one should eat the food offering oneself at night, once Acyuta has been worshipped.

4.107.s:
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte sukhasuptotthite'cyute ..
ghṛtapūrṇaṃ tāmrapātraṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..16..
4.107.d:
ततः संवत्सरस्यांते सुखसुप्तोत्थितेऽच्युते ॥
घृतपूर्णं ताम्रपात्रं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥16॥
4.107.m: Then, at the end of the year, when Acyuta has arisen from his pleasant sleep, / one should present a copper vessel filled with ghee to a brāhmaṇa.

4.107.s:
śaktito dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādacyutaḥ prīyatāmiti ..
tatastu saptame varṣe kuryādudyāpanaṃ budhaḥ .. 17 ..
4.107.d:
शक्तितो दक्षिणां दद्यादच्युतः प्रीयतामिति ॥
ततस्तु सप्तमे वर्षे कुर्यादुद्यापनं बुधः ॥ 17 ॥
4.107.m: According to one's capacity, one should give a sacrificial fee, saying: "May Acyuta be pleased." / Then, in the seventh year, the wise person should perform the concluding rite.

4.107.s:
kāryā caivācyutasyārcā śaktyā svarṇamayī nṛpa ..
tadagre brāhmaṇī sthāpyā sthavirā sāṃbharāyaṇī .. 18 ..
4.107.d:
कार्या चैवाच्युतस्यार्चा शक्त्या स्वर्णमयी नृप ॥
तदग्रे ब्राह्मणी स्थाप्या स्थविरा सांभरायणी ॥ 18 ॥
4.107.m: An image of Acyuta should be made of gold according to one's means, O king. / In front of it should be placed the aged brāhmaṇa woman Sāmbharāyaṇī,

4.107.s:
mahāsatī raupyamayī samānārhā sadevatā ..
tatastau pūjayitvā ca mālyavastravilepanaiḥ .. 19 ..
4.107.d:
महासती रौप्यमयी समानार्हा सदेवता ॥
ततस्तौ पूजयित्वा च माल्यवस्त्रविलेपनैः ॥ 19 ॥
4.107.m: the great virtuous wife, made of silver, of equal honour, accompanied by the deity. / Then, having worshipped the two of them with garlands, garments, and ointments,

4.107.s:
maṃtreṇānena rājendra praṇipatya vidhānataḥ ..
prativarṣaṃ ca dattaṃ cettāmraṃ pātraṃ dvijātaye .. 4.107.20 ..
4.107.d:
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र प्रणिपत्य विधानतः ॥
प्रतिवर्षं च दत्तं चेत्ताम्रं पात्रं द्विजातये ॥ 4.107.20 ॥
4.107.m: and having bowed down according to rule with this mantra, O king of kings: / if a copper vessel has been given to a twice-born every year,

4.107.s:
tadevahelayā dadyātsahiraṇyāśvasaṃyutam ..
gāśca pradadyātsaṃ pūjya savatsāḥ kāṃsyadohanāḥ .. 21 ..
4.107.d:
तदेवहेलया दद्यात्सहिरण्याश्वसंयुतम् ॥
गाश्च प्रदद्यात्सं पूज्य सवत्साः कांस्यदोहनाः ॥ 21 ॥
4.107.m: one should give that without disrespect, accompanied by gold and a horse. / And having worshipped cows along with their calves and bell-metal milking pails, one should give them;

4.107.s:
ekāṃ vā śaktito dadyādbhaktyā tuṣyati keśavaḥ ..
ghaṭāḥ satpātranirdiṣṭāḥ sānnāḥ pūrṇajalojjvalāḥ ..22..
4.107.d:
एकां वा शक्तितो दद्याद्भक्त्या तुष्यति केशवः ॥
घटाः सत्पात्रनिर्दिष्टाः सान्नाः पूर्णजलोज्ज्वलाः ॥22॥
4.107.m: or one should give one according to one's capacity; Keśava is pleased by devotion. / Jars designated for worthy recipients, accompanied by food and bright with full water,

4.107.s:
chatropānadyugaiḥ sārdhamevaṃ dattvā visarjayet ..
śayyāṃ satūlikāṃ dadyādgṛhaṃ copaskaraiḥ saha .. 23 ..
4.107.d:
छत्रोपानद्युगैः सार्धमेवं दत्त्वा विसर्जयेत् ॥
शय्यां सतूलिकां दद्याद्गृहं चोपस्करैः सह ॥ 23 ॥
4.107.m: along with royal parasols and pairs of shoes—having given these in this manner, one should dismiss [the rite]. / One should give a bed with a cotton mattress, and a house along with household utensils.

4.107.s:
śriyā ca saha viṣṇuṃ ca pūjayedbhūṣayetprabhum ..
vastrairābharaṇaiścaiva praṇipatya kṣamāpayet .. 24 ..
4.107.d:
श्रिया च सह विष्णुं च पूजयेद्भूषयेत्प्रभुम् ॥
वस्त्रैराभरणैश्चैव प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ॥ 24 ॥
4.107.m: And one should worship Viṣṇu along with Śrī, adorning the Lord / with garments and ornaments, and having bowed down, ask for forgiveness.

4.107.s:
kṛtenānena rājendra cyutiṃ nāpnoti mānavaḥ ..
saṃtateḥ svargavittāderaiśvaryasya tathaiva ca ..
yadvābhimatamanyacca tato na cyavate naraḥ .. 25 ..
4.107.d:
कृतेनानेन राजेन्द्र च्युतिं नाप्नोति मानवः ॥
संततेः स्वर्गवित्तादेरैश्वर्यस्य तथैव च ॥
यद्वाभिमतमन्यच्च ततो न च्यवते नरः ॥ 25 ॥
4.107.m: By performing this, O king of kings, a man suffers no fall / from lineage, heaven, wealth, and likewise sovereign power; / or whatever else he desires, from that a man does not fall.

4.107.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena māsanakṣatrapūjanaiḥ ..
yajetākṣayakāmastu sadaiva puruṣottamam .. 26 ..
4.107.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन मासनक्षत्रपूजनैः ॥
यजेताक्षयकामस्तु सदैव पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.107.m: Therefore, with every effort, through worship on the asterism of each month, / one who desires imperishable [fruits] should always worship Puruṣottama.

4.107.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
atrāpi śrūyate kācitsiddhā svarge mahāvratā ..
nārī tapodhanā bhūtvā prakhyātā sāṃbharāyaṇī ..
samastasaṃdehaharā sadāsvargau kasāṃ hi sā .. 27 ..
4.107.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अत्रापि श्रूयते काचित्सिद्धा स्वर्गे महाव्रता ॥
नारी तपोधना भूत्वा प्रख्याता सांभरायणी ॥
समस्तसंदेहहरा सदास्वर्गौ कसां हि सा ॥ 27 ॥
4.107.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In this regard too is heard of a certain perfected woman in heaven, observing great vows, / who, having become rich in austerity, is renowned as Sāṃbharāyaṇī; / she indeed constantly dispels all doubts for the dwellers of heaven.

4.107.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ ..
pūrvendracaritaṃ rājanpapracchedaṃ bṛhaspatim .. 28 ..
4.107.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य देवराजः शतक्रतुः ॥
पूर्वेन्द्रचरितं राजन्पप्रच्छेदं बृहस्पतिम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.107.m: Now, at a certain time, Śatakratu, the king of the gods, / asked Bṛhaspati about the deeds of former Indras, O king:

4.107.s:
pūrvendrātparataḥ pūrve ye babhūvuḥ sureśvarāḥ ..
teṣāṃ caritamicchāmi śrotumaṃgirasāṃ vara .. 29 ..
4.107.d:
पूर्वेन्द्रात्परतः पूर्वे ये बभूवुः सुरेश्वराः ॥
तेषां चरितमिच्छामि श्रोतुमंगिरसां वर ॥ 29 ॥
4.107.m: “O best of the Āṅgirasas, I wish to hear the deeds / of those lords of the gods who came before the former Indra and even earlier than that.”

4.107.s:
evamuktastadā tena devendreṇāmaladyutiḥ ..
prāha dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ paramarṣirbṛhaspatiḥ .. 4.107.30 ..
4.107.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन देवेन्द्रेणामलद्युतिः ॥
प्राह धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठः परमर्षिर्बृहस्पतिः ॥ 4.107.30 ॥
4.107.m: Addressed thus by the lord of the gods, Bṛhaspati, of spotless splendour, / the supreme sage and foremost of upholders of dharma, said:

4.107.s:
nāhaṃ ciraṃtanānvedmi devarāja sureśvarān ..
ātmanaḥ samakālīnamavehi ca sureśvara .. 31 ..
4.107.d:
नाहं चिरंतनान्वेद्मि देवराज सुरेश्वरान् ॥
आत्मनः समकालीनमवेहि च सुरेश्वर ॥ 31 ॥
4.107.m: “O king of the gods, I do not know the ancient lords of the gods. / O lord of the gods, know me to be contemporary with yourself.”

4.107.s:
tataḥ papraccha devendraḥ kosmābhirmunipuṃgavaḥ ..
praṣṭavyo'tra mahābhāga kṛtādivasatirdivi .. 32 ..
4.107.d:
ततः पप्रच्छ देवेन्द्रः कोस्माभिर्मुनिपुंगवः ॥
प्रष्टव्योऽत्र महाभाग कृतादिवसतिर्दिवि ॥ 32 ॥
4.107.m: Then the lord of the gods asked: “O illustrious one, who among the foremost sages / dwelling in heaven since the Kṛta age or earlier should be questioned here by us?”

4.107.s:
bṛhaspatiściraṃ dhyātvā tataḥ prāha śacīpatim ..
tapasvinīṃ mahābhāgāṃ pṛcchaitāṃ sāṃbharāyaṇīm .. 33 ..
4.107.d:
बृहस्पतिश्चिरं ध्यात्वा ततः प्राह शचीपतिम् ॥
तपस्विनीं महाभागां पृच्छैतां सांभरायणीम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.107.m: Bṛhaspati, having reflected for a long time, then said to Śacī's husband: / “Ask this illustrious female ascetic Sāṃbharāyaṇī.”

4.107.s:
ityuktastena devendraḥ kautūhalasamanvitaḥ ..
yayau yatra mahābhāgā samyagāste tapasvinī .. 34 ..
4.107.d:
इत्युक्तस्तेन देवेन्द्रः कौतूहलसमन्वितः ॥
ययौ यत्र महाभागा सम्यगास्ते तपस्विनी ॥ 34 ॥
4.107.m: Addressed thus by him, the lord of the gods, filled with curiosity, / went to where the illustrious female ascetic properly resided.

4.107.s:
sā tau dṛṣṭvā samāyāṃtau devarājabṛhaspatī ..
samyagarghyeṇa saṃpūjya praṇipatyāha suvratā .. 35 ...
4.107.d:
सा तौ दृष्ट्वा समायांतौ देवराजबृहस्पती ॥
सम्यगर्घ्येण संपूज्य प्रणिपत्याह सुव्रता ॥ 35 ॥।
4.107.m: Seeing the king of the gods and Bṛhaspati arriving together, / properly honouring them with arghya and bowing down, the woman of excellent vows said:

4.107.s:
namo'stu devarājāya tathaivāṅgirase namaḥ ..
yadvāṃ kāryaṃ mahābhāgau sakalaṃ tadihocyatām..36..
4.107.d:
नमोऽस्तु देवराजाय तथैवाङ्गिरसे नमः ॥
यद्वां कार्यं महाभागौ सकलं तदिहोच्यताम्॥36॥
4.107.m: “Homage to the king of the gods, and likewise homage to the descendant of Aṅgiras! / Whatever purpose you two illustrious ones have, let all of it be spoken here.

4.107.s: yadi kartuṃ mayā śakyaṃ tatkariṣye vimṛśya ca ..37... ..
4.107.d: यदि कर्तुं मया शक्यं तत्करिष्ये विमृश्य च ॥37॥॥।
4.107.m: If it can be done by me, having considered it, I will do it.”

4.107.s:
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca.. ..
āvāmabhyāgatau praṣṭuṃ tvāmatrātivivekinīm ..
yacca kāryaṃ mahābhāge pṛṣṭaṃ tatkathayasva naḥ ..38..
4.107.d:
॥ बृहस्पतिरुवाच॥ ॥
आवामभ्यागतौ प्रष्टुं त्वामत्रातिविवेकिनीम् ॥
यच्च कार्यं महाभागे पृष्टं तत्कथयस्व नः ॥38॥
4.107.m: Bṛhaspati said: / “We two have come here to question you, who are exceedingly discerning. / And what our purpose is, O illustrious one, being asked, relate that to us.

4.107.s:
yadi smarasi kalyāṇi pūrvendracaritāni vai ..
tadākhyāhi mahābhāge devendrasya kutūhalam .. 39 ..
4.107.d:
यदि स्मरसि कल्याणि पूर्वेन्द्रचरितानि वै ॥
तदाख्याहि महाभागे देवेन्द्रस्य कुतूहलम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.107.m: If you remember the deeds of former Indras, O blessed one, / then tell them, O illustrious one, for the curiosity of the lord of the gods.”

4.107.s:
.. sāṃbharāyaṇyuvāca .. ..
yo vai pūrvaṃ sureṃdrasya tataśca prathamo hi yaḥ..
tasmātpūrvataro yasya tasyāpi prathamaśca yaḥ .. 4.107.40 ..
4.107.d:
॥ सांभरायण्युवाच ॥ ॥
यो वै पूर्वं सुरेंद्रस्य ततश्च प्रथमो हि यः॥
तस्मात्पूर्वतरो यस्य तस्यापि प्रथमश्च यः ॥ 4.107.40 ॥
4.107.m: Sāṃbharāyaṇī said: / “He who was prior to the lord of the gods, and indeed he who was first after that, / and he who was earlier than him, and he who was also the first before him,

4.107.s:
teṣāṃ pūrvatarā ye ca vedmi tānakhilānaham ..
teṣāṃ ca caritaṃ kṛtsnaṃ jānāmyagirasāṃ vara ..41..
4.107.d:
तेषां पूर्वतरा ये च वेद्मि तानखिलानहम् ॥
तेषां च चरितं कृत्स्नं जानाम्यगिरसां वर ॥41॥
4.107.m: and those who were even earlier than them—I know all of them; / and I know their entire deeds, O best of the Āṅgirasas.

4.107.s:
manvaṃtarāṇyanekāni sṛṣṭīśca tridivaukasām ..
saptarṣīnsubahūnvedmi manūnāṃ ca sutānnṛpān .. 42 ..
4.107.d:
मन्वंतराण्यनेकानि सृष्टीश्च त्रिदिवौकसाम् ॥
सप्तर्षीन्सुबहून्वेद्मि मनूनां च सुतान्नृपान् ॥ 42 ॥
4.107.m: I know many manvantaras, and the creations of the dwellers of heaven, / very many of the Seven Sages, and the kings who were sons of the Manus.”

4.107.s:
evamuktvā tatastābhyāṃ suhṛṣṭā sāṃbharāyaṇī ..
yathāvadācaṣṭa tayoḥ pūrvendracaritaṃ mahat .. 43 ..
4.107.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततस्ताभ्यां सुहृष्टा सांभरायणी ॥
यथावदाचष्ट तयोः पूर्वेन्द्रचरितं महत् ॥ 43 ॥
4.107.m: Having spoken thus, Sāṃbharāyaṇī, exceedingly delighted, / then accurately related to the two of them the great deeds of former Indras:

4.107.s:
svāyaṃbhuve yastu manau manau svārociṣe ca yaḥ ..
uttame tāmase caiva raivate cākṣuṣe tathā .. 44 ..
4.107.d:
स्वायंभुवे यस्तु मनौ मनौ स्वारोचिषे च यः ॥
उत्तमे तामसे चैव रैवते चाक्षुषे तथा ॥ 44 ॥
4.107.m: “He who was [Indra] in the Svāyambhuva Manu, and he who was in the Svārociṣa Manu, / and in the Uttama, Tāmasa, Raivata, and likewise Cākṣuṣa [Manus]—

4.107.s:
ye babhūvurhi devendrāstasya tasya tapasvinī ..
tadā jagāda caritaṃ yathāvatsāṃbharāyaṇī .. 45 ..
4.107.d:
ये बभूवुर्हि देवेन्द्रास्तस्य तस्य तपस्विनी ॥
तदा जगाद चरितं यथावत्सांभरायणी ॥ 45 ॥
4.107.m: those who were indeed the lords of the gods, the female ascetic Sāṃbharāyaṇī / then accurately recounted the deeds of each and every one.

4.107.s: kathayāmāsa cāścaryaṃ taccāpi kathayāmi te ..46 ..
4.107.d: कथयामास चाश्चर्यं तच्चापि कथयामि ते ॥46 ॥
4.107.m: And she related a wonder; I shall relate that to you as well:

4.107.s:
śaṃkukarṇastadā daityo babhūvātyaṃtadurjayaḥ ..
sa lokapālānsamare vijitya saha daivataiḥ ..
indrasyāsādya bhavanaṃ praviveśa sunirbhayaḥ .. 47 ..
4.107.d:
शंकुकर्णस्तदा दैत्यो बभूवात्यंतदुर्जयः ॥
स लोकपालान्समरे विजित्य सह दैवतैः ॥
इन्द्रस्यासाद्य भवनं प्रविवेश सुनिर्भयः ॥ 47 ॥
4.107.m: At that time there was a Daitya named Śaṅkukarṇa, exceedingly difficult to conquer. / Having vanquished the world protectors along with the gods in battle, / he approached Indra's dwelling and entered it, completely fearless.

4.107.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā prāptaṃ śakraḥ śayyātale'luṭhat ..
jugopa sahasātmānaṃ śaṃkukarṇabhayārditaḥ ..48..
4.107.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा सहसा प्राप्तं शक्रः शय्यातलेऽलुठत् ॥
जुगोप सहसात्मानं शंकुकर्णभयार्दितः ॥48॥
4.107.m: Seeing him suddenly arrived, Śakra rolled under his bed; / afflicted by fear of Śaṅkukarṇa, he hastily hid himself.

4.107.s:
dānavaḥ śakraśayane tasminnupaviveśa ha ..
indrāṇyapi tathā bhītā gatā vācaspatergṛham .. 49 ..
4.107.d:
दानवः शक्रशयने तस्मिन्नुपविवेश ह ॥
इन्द्राण्यपि तथा भीता गता वाचस्पतेर्गृहम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.107.m: The Dānava sat down upon that very bed of Śakra. / Indrāṇī too, terrified, fled to the house of Vācaspati.

4.107.s:
atha devāḥ samājagmurbhayāddraṣṭuṃ suradviṣam ..
āsīnaṃ śakraśayane praṇipātapurassarāḥ .. 4.107.50 ..
4.107.d:
अथ देवाः समाजग्मुर्भयाद्द्रष्टुं सुरद्विषम् ॥
आसीनं शक्रशयने प्रणिपातपुरस्सराः ॥ 4.107.50 ॥
4.107.m: Then the gods, out of fear, came to see the enemy of the gods / seated upon Śakra's bed, bowing down before him.

4.107.s:
vāsudevo'pi tatrāgāttaṃ draṣṭuṃ devakaṃṭakam ..
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇamanuprāptaṃ dānavaḥ prāha harṣitaḥ .. 51 ..
4.107.d:
वासुदेवोऽपि तत्रागात्तं द्रष्टुं देवकंटकम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णमनुप्राप्तं दानवः प्राह हर्षितः ॥ 51 ॥
4.107.m: Vāsudeva too went there to see that thorn to the gods. / Seeing Kṛṣṇa arrived, the Dānava said, delighted:

4.107.s:
dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyohaṃ yasya me garuḍadhvajaḥ ..
śakraśayyāsanasthasya draṣṭumabhyeti keśavaḥ .. 52 ..
4.107.d:
धन्योऽहं कृतकृत्योहं यस्य मे गरुडध्वजः ॥
शक्रशय्यासनस्थस्य द्रष्टुमभ्येति केशवः ॥ 52 ॥
4.107.m: ‘Blessed am I, my purpose accomplished am I, to see whom, / seated upon Śakra's bed, Keśava, whose banner bears Garuḍa, approaches!’

4.107.s:
tataḥ kare samālaṃbya śayanābhyāśamānayat ..
cakāra kaṃṭhagrahaṇaṃ bāṃdhavasyeva harṣita .. 53 ..
4.107.d:
ततः करे समालंब्य शयनाभ्याशमानयत् ॥
चकार कंठग्रहणं बांधवस्येव हर्षित ॥ 53 ॥
4.107.m: Then, clasping him by the hand, he led him near the bed / and embraced him around the neck, delighted, as if he were a relative.

4.107.s:
tataḥ kṛṣṇastu sahasā gṛhya dorbhyāṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ..
pīḍayāmāsa vihasannadaṃtaṃ bhairavānravān ..
mamāra dānavendro'sau balādbhagnāsthipañjaraḥ .. 54 ..
4.107.d:
ततः कृष्णस्तु सहसा गृह्य दोर्भ्यां शनैः शनैः ॥
पीडयामास विहसन्नदंतं भैरवान्रवान् ॥
ममार दानवेन्द्रोऽसौ बलाद्भग्नास्थिपञ्जरः ॥ 54 ॥
4.107.m: Then Kṛṣṇa, seizing him suddenly with his arms, slowly and steadily / crushed him, smiling, while he roared with terrible cries; / that lord of the Dānavas died by force, his skeletal cage shattered.

4.107.s:
nirjagāma tataḥ śakraḥ śayyāmūlādavākchirāḥ ..
tuṣṭāva harimāsīnaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam .. 59 ..
4.107.d:
निर्जगाम ततः शक्रः शय्यामूलादवाक्छिराः ॥
तुष्टाव हरिमासीनं शंखचक्रगदाधरम् ॥ 59 ॥
4.107.m: Then Śakra came out from under the bed with his head downcast; / he praised Hari, who was seated, bearing the conch, discus, and mace.

4.107.s: etaddṛṣṭaṃ mayā śakra vasaṃtyā surasadmani .. 56 ..
4.107.d: एतद्दृष्टं मया शक्र वसंत्या सुरसद्मनि ॥ 56 ॥
4.107.m: This was seen by me, O Śakra, while dwelling in the abode of the gods.”

4.107.s:
tataḥ kutūhalaparo devarāṭ tāṃ tapasvinīm ..
uvāca jānāsi kathaṃ tvametānsāṃbharāyaṇi ..57..
4.107.d:
ततः कुतूहलपरो देवराट् तां तपस्विनीम् ॥
उवाच जानासि कथं त्वमेतान्सांभरायणि ॥57॥
4.107.m: Then the king of the gods, filled with curiosity, said to that female ascetic: / “How do you know these [matters], O Sāṃbharāyaṇī?”

4.107.s:
.. sāṃbharāyaṇyuvāca .. ..
sarva eva hi devendrāḥ svargasthā yemareśvarāḥ..
babhūvurete caritameteṣāṃ vedmi tena vai ..
caritaṃ ca mayā teṣāṃ śrutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tathaiva ca ..58..
4.107.d:
॥ सांभरायण्युवाच ॥ ॥
सर्व एव हि देवेन्द्राः स्वर्गस्था येमरेश्वराः॥
बभूवुरेते चरितमेतेषां वेद्मि तेन वै ॥
चरितं च मया तेषां श्रुतं दृष्टं तथैव च ॥58॥
4.107.m: Sāṃbharāyaṇī said: / “All the lords of the gods, lords of the immortals who dwelt in heaven, / existed; therefore I indeed know their deeds. / And their deeds have been heard as well as seen by me.”

4.107.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
kiṃ kṛtaṃ vada dharmajñe tvayā yeneyamakṣayā ..
svarloke vasatiḥ prāptā yathā nānyena kenacit .. 59 ..
4.107.d:
॥ इन्द्र उवाच ॥ ॥
किं कृतं वद धर्मज्ञे त्वया येनेयमक्षया ॥
स्वर्लोके वसतिः प्राप्ता यथा नान्येन केनचित् ॥ 59 ॥
4.107.m: Indra said: / “Tell me, O knower of dharma, what was done by you, by which this imperishable / dwelling in the heavenly world was obtained, such as by no one else?

4.107.s:
aho sarvavratānāṃ tu hyupoṣitamathādbhutam ..
pradhānataramatyaṃtaṃ svargavāsapradaṃ matam .. 4.107.60 ..
4.107.d:
अहो सर्वव्रतानां तु ह्युपोषितमथाद्भुतम् ॥
प्रधानतरमत्यंतं स्वर्गवासप्रदं मतम् ॥ 4.107.60 ॥
4.107.m: Ah, what wonderful fast among all votive observances, / considered most eminent, granting an eternal dwelling in heaven, [was observed]?”

4.107.s:
evamuktā tatastena devendreṇa tapasvinīṃ ..
pratyuvāca mahābhāgā yathāvatsāṃbharāyaṇī .. 61 ..
4.107.d:
एवमुक्ता ततस्तेन देवेन्द्रेण तपस्विनीं ॥
प्रत्युवाच महाभागा यथावत्सांभरायणी ॥ 61 ॥
4.107.m: Addressed thus by the lord of the gods, the female ascetic, / the illustrious Sāṃbharāyaṇī, replied properly:

4.107.s:
māsarkṣe hyacyuto devaḥ pratimāsaṃ sureśvara ..
yathoktavratayā samyaksaptavarṣāṇi pūjitaḥ .. 62..
4.107.d:
मासर्क्षे ह्यच्युतो देवः प्रतिमासं सुरेश्वर ॥
यथोक्तव्रतया सम्यक्सप्तवर्षाणि पूजितः ॥ 62॥
4.107.m: “On the asterism of each month, O lord of the gods, the imperishable God / was properly worshipped by me for seven years with the prescribed votive observance.

4.107.s:
tasyeyaṃ karmaṇo vyuṣṭiracyutārādhanasya me ..
devalokādabhimatā devarājapadacyutiḥ .. 63 ..
4.107.d:
तस्येयं कर्मणो व्युष्टिरच्युताराधनस्य मे ॥
देवलोकादभिमता देवराजपदच्युतिः ॥ 63 ॥
4.107.m: This is the reward of that action of mine, of the propitiation of Acyuta: / immunity from falling from the status of king of the gods or from the realm of the gods, as desired.

4.107.s:
svargendravibhavaiśvaryaṃ saṃtatiṃ yāti cācyutim ..
naro vāñchati tenetthaṃ toṣaṇīyastataḥ prabhuḥ .. 64 ..
4.107.d:
स्वर्गेन्द्रविभवैश्वर्यं संततिं याति चाच्युतिम् ॥
नरो वाञ्छति तेनेत्थं तोषणीयस्ततः प्रभुः ॥ 64 ॥
4.107.m: A man desires the wealth and sovereignty of the lord of heaven, lineage, and permanence; / therefore the Lord should be pleased in this manner.

4.107.s:
etatte pūrvadevendracaritaṃ sakalaṃ mayā ..
svargavāsākṣayatvaṃ ca māsarkṣācyutapūjanāt ..
yathāvatkathitaṃ deva pṛcchatastridaśeśvara .. 65 ..
4.107.d:
एतत्ते पूर्वदेवेन्द्रचरितं सकलं मया ॥
स्वर्गवासाक्षयत्वं च मासर्क्षाच्युतपूजनात् ॥
यथावत्कथितं देव पृच्छतस्त्रिदशेश्वर ॥ 65 ॥
4.107.m: This entire deed of former lords of the gods, / and the imperishability of dwelling in heaven through the worship of Acyuta on the monthly asterism, / has been told to you properly, O god, lord of the thirty [gods], as you asked.

4.107.s:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca vāñchitā vibudhādhipa ..
viṣṇorārādhanādanyatparamaṃ siddhikāraṇam .. 66 ..
4.107.d:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाश्च वाञ्छिता विबुधाधिप ॥
विष्णोराराधनादन्यत्परमं सिद्धिकारणम् ॥ 66 ॥
4.107.m: And dharma, wealth, pleasure, and liberation are desired, O lord of the gods; / there is no other supreme cause of attainment than the propitiation of Viṣṇu.”

4.107.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā devarājabṛhaspatī ..
tattathetyūcatuḥ sādhvīṃ ceratuścāpi tadvratam .. 67 ..
4.107.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवराजबृहस्पती ॥
तत्तथेत्यूचतुः साध्वीं चेरतुश्चापि तद्व्रतम् ॥ 67 ॥
4.107.m:
Hearing her words, the king of the gods and Bṛhaspati
said, “So be it,” to the virtuous woman, and they too performed that votive observance.

4.107.s:
tasmātpārtha prayatnena pratimāsaṃ samāhitaḥ ..
māsarkṣācyutapūjāyāṃ bhavethāstanmanāḥ sadā ..68..
4.107.d:
तस्मात्पार्थ प्रयत्नेन प्रतिमासं समाहितः ॥
मासर्क्षाच्युतपूजायां भवेथास्तन्मनाः सदा ॥68॥
4.107.m:
Therefore, O son of Pṛthā, with effort and collected mind each month,
remain ever intent upon the worship of Acyuta through the constellations of the months.

4.107.s:
ye sāṃbharāyaṇikathācaritavratesminvarṣāṇi sapta vidhinā sudhiyo nayaṃti ..
te svagarlokamabhigamya kṛtādhivāsāḥ kalpāyutāyutaśatairapi na cyavaṃte .. 69 ..
nakṣatrapuruṣavratavarṇanam
4.107.d:
ये सांभरायणिकथाचरितव्रतेस्मिन्वर्षाणि सप्त विधिना सुधियो नयंति ॥
ते स्वगर्लोकमभिगम्य कृताधिवासाः कल्पायुतायुतशतैरपि न च्यवंते ॥ 69 ॥
नक्षत्रपुरुषव्रतवर्णनम्
4.107.m:
Those wise people who spend seven years according to rule in this votive observance of the story and practice of Sāṃbharāyaṇī,
having reached the heavenly realm and made their abode there, do not fall even after hundreds of tens of thousands of kalpas.
Description of the Nakṣatrapuruṣa Vrata

4.108.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
surūpatā manuṣyāṇāṃ strīṇāṃ ca yadusattama ..
karmaṇā jāyate kena tanmamākhyātumarhasi .. 1 ..
4.108.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
सुरूपता मनुष्याणां स्त्रीणां च यदुसत्तम ॥
कर्मणा जायते केन तन्ममाख्यातुमर्हसि ॥ 1 ॥
4.108.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
O best of the Yadus, by what action does beauty of form arise
for men and for women? You should relate that to me.

4.108.s:
surūpāṇāṃ sugātrāṇāṃ suveṣāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ..
nyūnaṃ tathādhikaṃ cāpi yathā nāṅgaṃ prajāyate ..2..
4.108.d:
सुरूपाणां सुगात्राणां सुवेषाणां तथैव च ॥
न्यूनं तथाधिकं चापि यथा नाङ्गं प्रजायते ॥2॥
4.108.m:
[By what action does it arise] for people of handsome form, fair limbs, and fine attire,
and in such a way that no limb is born deficient or redundant?

4.108.s:
samastaiḥ śobhanairaṃgairnarāḥ kecidyadūttama ..
kāṇāḥ kubjāṃśca jāyaṃte truṭitaśravaṇāstathā ..3..
4.108.d:
समस्तैः शोभनैरंगैर्नराः केचिद्यदूत्तम ॥
काणाः कुब्जांश्च जायंते त्रुटितश्रवणास्तथा ॥3॥
4.108.m:
O best of the Yadus, some men [are born] with all limbs handsome,
while [others] are born one-eyed, hunchbacked, and with damaged ears.

4.108.s:
narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ caiva samastāṅgaḥ surūpatā ..
karmaṇā yena bhavati tatpūrvaṃ kathayāmala .. 4 ..
4.108.d:
नराणां योषितां चैव समस्ताङ्गः सुरूपता ॥
कर्मणा येन भवति तत्पूर्वं कथयामल ॥ 4 ॥
4.108.m:
By what action does complete-limbed beauty of form come about
for men and for women? Relate that first, O faultless one.

4.108.s:
lāvaṇyagativākyāni sati rūpe mahāmate ..
kurvaṃtyabhyadhikāṃ śobhāṃ samastāḥ paramā guṇāḥ .. 5 ..
4.108.d:
लावण्यगतिवाक्यानि सति रूपे महामते ॥
कुर्वंत्यभ्यधिकां शोभां समस्ताः परमा गुणाः ॥ 5 ॥
4.108.m:
When beauty of form is present, O highly intelligent one, grace, gait, and speech,
and all supreme qualities, produce an even greater splendour.

4.108.s:
vākyalāvaṇyasaṃskāravilāsalalitā gatiḥ ..
viḍaṃbanā kurūpāṇāṃ kevalā sā hi jāyate .. 6 ..
4.108.d:
वाक्यलावण्यसंस्कारविलासललिता गतिः ॥
विडंबना कुरूपाणां केवला सा हि जायते ॥ 6 ॥
4.108.m:
Speech, grace, culture, and a gait charming with playful charm—
all that becomes a mere mockery in the deformed.

4.108.s:
rūpakāraṇabhūtāya karmaṇā prayato bhavet ..
tasmāttanme samācakṣva karma yaccāru rūpadam ..7..
4.108.d:
रूपकारणभूताय कर्मणा प्रयतो भवेत् ॥
तस्मात्तन्मे समाचक्ष्व कर्म यच्चारु रूपदम् ॥7॥
4.108.m:
One should strive through action toward that which is the cause of beauty.
Therefore explain to me that action which grants lovely beauty of form.

4.108.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
samyakpṛṣṭaṃ tvayā hīdamupavāsāśritaṃ nṛpa ..
kathayāmi yathāproktaṃ variṣṭhena mahātmanā .. 8 ..
4.108.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
सम्यक्पृष्टं त्वया हीदमुपवासाश्रितं नृप ॥
कथयामि यथाप्रोक्तं वरिष्ठेन महात्मना ॥ 8 ॥
4.108.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Indeed, this question based on fasting has been asked well by you, O king.
I shall tell it just as it was declared by the high-souled, most eminent one.

4.108.s:
vaśiṣṭhamṛṣimāsīnaṃ saptarṣipravaraṃ dvijam ..
papracchārundhatī pṛṣṭā yadetadbhavatā vayam ..9..
4.108.d:
वशिष्ठमृषिमासीनं सप्तर्षिप्रवरं द्विजम् ॥
पप्रच्छारुन्धती पृष्टा यदेतद्भवता वयम् ॥9॥
4.108.m:
Arundhatī asked the sage Vasiṣṭha, the twice-born foremost of the seven seers, as he was seated,
precisely what has now been asked of us by you.

4.108.s:
tasyāstu paripṛcchantyā jagāda munisattamaḥ ..
yattacchṛṇuṣva kauṃteya mamedaṃ vadato'khilam .. 4.108.10 ..
4.108.d:
तस्यास्तु परिपृच्छन्त्या जगाद मुनिसत्तमः ॥
यत्तच्छृणुष्व कौंतेय ममेदं वदतोऽखिलम् ॥ 4.108.10 ॥
4.108.m:
And what that best of sages declared to her as she inquired,
listen to all of it, O son of Kuntī, as I speak it.

4.108.s:
.. vaśiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
śrūyatāṃ yadahaṃ pṛṣṭastvayaitadvaravarṇini ..
surūpatā nṛṇāṃ yena yoṣitāṃ copajāyate .. 11 ..
4.108.d:
॥ वशिष्ठ उवाच ॥ ॥
श्रूयतां यदहं पृष्टस्त्वयैतद्वरवर्णिनि ॥
सुरूपता नृणां येन योषितां चोपजायते ॥ 11 ॥
4.108.m:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Listen, O fair-complexioned one, to that which I was asked by you,
whereby beauty of form arises for men and for women.

4.108.s:
anabhyarcya tu goviṃdamanārādhya ca keśavam ..
rūpādikā guṇāḥ kena prāpyaṃte'nyena karmaṇā .. 12 ..
4.108.d:
अनभ्यर्च्य तु गोविंदमनाराध्य च केशवम् ॥
रूपादिका गुणाः केन प्राप्यंतेऽन्येन कर्मणा ॥ 12 ॥
4.108.m:
Without revering Govinda and without propitiating Keśava,
by what other action are qualities such as beauty attained?

4.108.s:
tasmādārādhanīyo'gre viṣṇureva yaśasvini ..
pāratryaṃ prāptukāmena rūpasaṃpatsutādikam .. 13 ..
4.108.d:
तस्मादाराधनीयोऽग्रे विष्णुरेव यशस्विनि ॥
पारत्र्यं प्राप्तुकामेन रूपसंपत्सुतादिकम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.108.m:
Therefore, O glorious lady, by one desiring to attain the other world,
beauty, wealth, sons, and the like, Viṣṇu alone must be propitiated first.

4.108.s:
yastu vāñchati dharmajñe rūpaṃ sarvāṃgasundaram ..
nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ bhadre jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ .. 14 ..
4.108.d:
यस्तु वाञ्छति धर्मज्ञे रूपं सर्वांगसुन्दरम् ॥
नक्षत्रपुरुषं भद्रे जितक्रोधो जितेंद्रियः ॥ 14 ॥
4.108.m:
Whoever desires beauty charming in all limbs, O knower of righteousness,
with anger conquered and senses subdued, O auspicious one,

4.108.s:
susnātaḥ prayatāhāraḥ saṃpūjayati yo'cyutam ..
bhaktyā yoṣinnaro vāpi surūpāṃgaḥ prajāyate .. 15 ..
4.108.d:
सुस्नातः प्रयताहारः संपूजयति योऽच्युतम् ॥
भक्त्या योषिन्नरो वापि सुरूपांगः प्रजायते ॥ 15 ॥
4.108.m:
well-bathed, with restrained diet, and worships Acyuta
as the Nakṣatrapuruṣa with devotion, woman or man, is born with limbs of fair form.

4.108.s:
yoṣitā hi paraṃ rūpamicchantyā jagataḥ patiḥ ..
sa evārādhanīyo'gre nakṣatrāṃgo janārdanaḥ .. 16 ..
4.108.d:
योषिता हि परं रूपमिच्छन्त्या जगतः पतिः ॥
स एवाराधनीयोऽग्रे नक्षत्रांगो जनार्दनः ॥ 16 ॥
4.108.m:
Indeed, by a woman desiring supreme beauty, the Lord of the world,
Janārdana, whose limbs are the asterisms, must be propitiated first.

4.108.s:
.. arundhatyuvāca .. ..
nakṣatrarūpī bhagavānpūjyate puruṣottamaḥ ..
mune yena vidhānena tanmamākhyātumarhasi .. 17 ..
4.108.d:
॥ अरुन्धत्युवाच ॥ ॥
नक्षत्ररूपी भगवान्पूज्यते पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
मुने येन विधानेन तन्ममाख्यातुमर्हसि ॥ 17 ॥
4.108.m:
Arundhatī said:
By what rite, O sage, is the Blessed One, the Supreme Person,
worshipped as the Nakṣatrapuruṣa? You should relate that to me.

4.108.s:
.. vaśiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
caitramāsātsamārabhya viṣṇoḥ pādābhipūjanam ..
yathā kurvīta rūpārthaṃ tanniśāmaya tattvataḥ .. 18 ..
4.108.d:
॥ वशिष्ठ उवाच ॥ ॥
चैत्रमासात्समारभ्य विष्णोः पादाभिपूजनम् ॥
यथा कुर्वीत रूपार्थं तन्निशामय तत्त्वतः ॥ 18 ॥
4.108.m:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Beginning from the month of Caitra, how one should perform
the worship of Viṣṇu's feet for the sake of beauty, hear that in truth.

4.108.s:
nakṣatramekamekaṃ vai snātaḥ samyagupoṣitaḥ ..
nakṣatrapuruṣasyāṃgaṃ pūjayecca vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 19 ..
4.108.d:
नक्षत्रमेकमेकं वै स्नातः सम्यगुपोषितः ॥
नक्षत्रपुरुषस्यांगं पूजयेच्च विचक्षणः ॥ 19 ॥
4.108.m:
Under each single asterism, bathed and properly fasted,
the discerning person should worship a limb of the Nakṣatrapuruṣa.

4.108.s:
mūle pādau tathā jaṃghe rohiṇyāmarcayecchubhe ..
jānunī cāśvinīyoge āṣāḍhe corusaṃjñite .. 4.108.20 ..
4.108.d:
मूले पादौ तथा जंघे रोहिण्यामर्चयेच्छुभे ॥
जानुनी चाश्विनीयोगे आषाढे चोरुसंज्ञिते ॥ 4.108.20 ॥
4.108.m:
Under Mūla he should worship the two feet, and under Rohiṇī the two shanks, O auspicious lady;
and the two knees at the conjunction of Aśvinī, and under Āṣāḍha those named the two thighs;

4.108.s:
phālgunīdvitaye guhyaṃ kṛttikāsu tathā kaṭim ..
pārśve bhādrapadā gulphe dve kukṣī revatīṣu ca .. 21 ..
4.108.d:
फाल्गुनीद्वितये गुह्यं कृत्तिकासु तथा कटिम् ॥
पार्श्वे भाद्रपदा गुल्फे द्वे कुक्षी रेवतीषु च ॥ 21 ॥
4.108.m:
under the pair of Phālgunīs the private parts, and likewise the waist under the Kṛttikās;
under the Bhādrapadās the two sides, the ankles under [Puṣya], and the two sides of the belly under the Revatīs;

4.108.s:
anurādhāsūraḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ dhaniṣṭhāsvabhipūjayet ..
bhujayugmaṃ viśākhāsu haste caiva karadvayam .. 22 ..
4.108.d:
अनुराधासूरः पृष्ठं धनिष्ठास्वभिपूजयेत् ॥
भुजयुग्मं विशाखासु हस्ते चैव करद्वयम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.108.m:
under the Anurādhās the breast, and one should worship the back under the Dhaniṣṭhās;
the pair of arms under the Viśākhās, and the two hands under Hasta;

4.108.s:
punarvasāvaṃgulīśca āśleṣāsu tathā nakhān ..
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ pūjayedgrīvāṃ śravaṇe śravaṇe tathā .. 23 ..
4.108.d:
पुनर्वसावंगुलीश्च आश्लेषासु तथा नखान् ॥
ज्येष्ठायां पूजयेद्ग्रीवां श्रवणे श्रवणे तथा ॥ 23 ॥
4.108.m:
and the fingers under Punarvasu, and likewise the nails under the Āśleṣās;
under Jyeṣṭhā he should worship the neck, and under Śravaṇa the two ears;

4.108.s:
puṣye mukhaṃ tathā svātau daśanānabhipūjayet ..
āsyaṃ śatabhiṣagyoge maghāyoge ca nāsikām .. 24 ..
4.108.d:
पुष्ये मुखं तथा स्वातौ दशनानभिपूजयेत् ॥
आस्यं शतभिषग्योगे मघायोगे च नासिकाम् ॥ 24 ॥
4.108.m:
under Puṣya the face, and under Svāti he should worship the teeth;
the mouth at the conjunction of Śatabhiṣaj, and the nose at the conjunction of Maghā;

4.108.s:
mṛgottamāṃge nayane pūjayedbhaktitaḥ śubhe ..
citrāyoge lalāṭaṃ ca bharaṇīṣu tathā śiraḥ .. 25 ..
4.108.d:
मृगोत्तमांगे नयने पूजयेद्भक्तितः शुभे ॥
चित्रायोगे ललाटं च भरणीषु तथा शिरः ॥ 25 ॥
4.108.m:
he should devotedly worship the two eyes under Mṛga, O auspicious lady;
and the forehead at the conjunction of Citrā, and the head under the Bharaṇīs;

4.108.s:
saṃpūjanīyā vidvadbhirārdrāyāṃ ca śiroruhāḥ ..
upoṣito naro bhadre snānamabhyaṃgapūrvakam .. 26 ..
4.108.d:
संपूजनीया विद्वद्भिरार्द्रायां च शिरोरुहाः ॥
उपोषितो नरो भद्रे स्नानमभ्यंगपूर्वकम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.108.m:
and the hair of the head should be worshipped by the wise under Ārdrā.
Having fasted, O auspicious one, a man [must note that] bathing preceded by oil-massage

4.108.s:
varjanīyaṃ prayatnena rūpaghnaṃ tadvinirdiśet ..
pūjayettacca nakṣatraṃ nakṣatrasya ca daivatam .. 27 ..
4.108.d:
वर्जनीयं प्रयत्नेन रूपघ्नं तद्विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
पूजयेत्तच्च नक्षत्रं नक्षत्रस्य च दैवतम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.108.m:
must be avoided with care; one should point it out as destructive of beauty.
He should worship that asterism and the deity of the asterism.

4.108.s:
somaṃ nakṣatrarājānaṃ svamantrairarcayedbudhaḥ ..
pratinakṣatrayoge ca bhojanīyā dvijottamāḥ .. 28 ..
4.108.d:
सोमं नक्षत्रराजानं स्वमन्त्रैरर्चयेद्बुधः ॥
प्रतिनक्षत्रयोगे च भोजनीया द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 28 ॥
4.108.m:
The wise person should worship Soma, the king of the asterisms, with his own mantras,
and at the conjunction of each asterism the best of the twice-born are to be fed.

4.108.s:
nakṣatrajñāya viprāya dānaṃ dadyācca śaktitaḥ ..
antarāye samutpanne sūtakāśaucakārite .. 29 ..
4.108.d:
नक्षत्रज्ञाय विप्राय दानं दद्याच्च शक्तितः ॥
अन्तराये समुत्पन्ने सूतकाशौचकारिते ॥ 29 ॥
4.108.m:
And he should give a gift according to his means to a Brahmin who knows the asterisms.
If an obstacle arises caused by the impurity of childbirth,

4.108.s:
upoṣya vācopa viśennakṣatramaparaṃ punaḥ ..
evaṃ māghāvasāne tu vratapāraḥ samāpyate .. 4.108.30 ..
4.108.d:
उपोष्य वाचोप विशेन्नक्षत्रमपरं पुनः ॥
एवं माघावसाने तु व्रतपारः समाप्यते ॥ 4.108.30 ॥
4.108.m:
he should fast and enter upon the next asterism again.
In this way, at the end of Māgha, the completion of the observance is concluded.

4.108.s:
samāpte tu vrate dadyācchaktyā sopaskarānvitam ..
nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ haimaṃ pūjaye ttatra śaktitaḥ .. 31 ..
4.108.d:
समाप्ते तु व्रते दद्याच्छक्त्या सोपस्करान्वितम् ॥
नक्षत्रपुरुषं हैमं पूजये त्तत्र शक्तितः ॥ 31 ॥
4.108.m:
When the votive observance is finished, he should give according to his means a golden Nakṣatrapuruṣa
accompanied by furnishings, and he should worship it there according to his means.

4.108.s:
brāhmaṇaṃ brāhmaṇīṃ caiva vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
śayyāyāṃ tu samāsannaṃ gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 32 ..
4.108.d:
ब्राह्मणं ब्राह्मणीं चैव वस्त्रालंकारभूषणैः ॥
शय्यायां तु समासन्नं गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥ 32 ॥
4.108.m:
[He should honour] a Brahmin man and a Brahmin woman with garments and ornaments,
seated upon a bed, with perfumes, garlands, and unguents,

4.108.s:
saptadhānyaṃ yathālābhaṃ gāṃ savatsāṃ payasvinīm ..
chatropānadyugaṃ caiva ghṛtapātraṃ tathaiva ca..33..
4.108.d:
सप्तधान्यं यथालाभं गां सवत्सां पयस्विनीम् ॥
छत्रोपानद्युगं चैव घृतपात्रं तथैव च॥33॥
4.108.m:
the seven grains as obtainable, a milch cow with her calf,
a pair of a parasol and sandals, and likewise a vessel of ghee.

4.108.s:
maṃtreṇānena viprāya suśīlāya nivedayet ..
yathā na viṣṇubhaktānāṃ vṛjinaṃ jāyate kvacita ..
tathā surūpatārogya sukhasaṃpadihāstu me .. 34 ..
4.108.d:
मंत्रेणानेन विप्राय सुशीलाय निवेदयेत् ॥
यथा न विष्णुभक्तानां वृजिनं जायते क्वचित ॥
तथा सुरूपतारोग्य सुखसंपदिहास्तु मे ॥ 34 ॥
4.108.m:
He should present them to a virtuous Brahmin with this mantra:
“Just as no misery ever befalls the devotees of Viṣṇu,
so let beauty of form, health, happiness, and prosperity be mine in this world.

4.108.s:
yathā na lakṣmyā śayanaṃ tava śūnyaṃ janārdana ..
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā janmani janmani .. 35 ..
4.108.d:
यथा न लक्ष्म्या शयनं तव शून्यं जनार्दन ॥
शय्या ममाप्यशून्यास्तु तथा जन्मनि जन्मनि ॥ 35 ॥
4.108.m:
Just as your couch is never empty of Lakṣmī, O Janārdana,
so let my bed also not be empty in birth after birth.”

4.108.s:
evaṃ nivedya tatsarvaṃ praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ..
śaktihīnastu gāṃ dadyād ghṛtapātrasamanvitām .. 36 ..
4.108.d:
एवं निवेद्य तत्सर्वं प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ॥
शक्तिहीनस्तु गां दद्याद् घृतपात्रसमन्विताम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.108.m:
Having presented all that in this way, he should bow down and ask for forgiveness.
One lacking means should give a cow accompanied by a vessel of ghee.

4.108.s:
nakṣatrapuruṣākhyo'yaṃ yathāvatkathitastava ..
pāpāpanodaṃ kurute samyakchraddhāvatāṃ satām .. 37 ..
4.108.d:
नक्षत्रपुरुषाख्योऽयं यथावत्कथितस्तव ॥
पापापनोदं कुरुते सम्यक्छ्रद्धावतां सताम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.108.m:
This [observance] named Nakṣatrapuruṣa has been described to you as it truly is;
it brings about the removal of sins for the good who have proper faith.

4.108.s:
aṅgopāṅgāni caivāsya pādādīni yaśasvini ..
surūpāṇyabhijāyaṃte sadā janmāntarāṇi ve .. 38 ..
4.108.d:
अङ्गोपाङ्गानि चैवास्य पादादीनि यशस्विनि ॥
सुरूपाण्यभिजायंते सदा जन्मान्तराणि वे ॥ 38 ॥
4.108.m:
And for him, O glorious lady, the major and minor limbs, beginning with the feet,
always become handsome in other births.

4.108.s:
gātrāṇi caiva bhadrāṇi śarīrārogyamuttamam ..
saṃtatiṃ manasaḥ prītiṃ rūpaṃ cātīva śobhanam .. 39 ..
4.108.d:
गात्राणि चैव भद्राणि शरीरारोग्यमुत्तमम् ॥
संततिं मनसः प्रीतिं रूपं चातीव शोभनम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.108.m: And auspicious limbs, excellent bodily health, / offspring, mental delight, and exceedingly lovely beauty,

4.108.s:
vāṅmādhuryaṃ tathā kāṃtiṃ yaccānyadapi vāṃchitam ..
dadāti nakṣatrapumānpūjitaśca janārdanaḥ .. 4.108.40 ..
4.108.d:
वाङ्माधुर्यं तथा कांतिं यच्चान्यदपि वांछितम् ॥
ददाति नक्षत्रपुमान्पूजितश्च जनार्दनः ॥ 4.108.40 ॥
4.108.m: sweetness of speech, radiance, and whatever else is desired— / [all these] the Constellation-Man, Janārdana, gives when worshipped.

4.108.s:
vaśiṣṭhena yathākhyātaṃ sarvaṃ tatte niveditam ..
nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ nāma vratānāmuttamottamam .. 41 ..
4.108.d:
वशिष्ठेन यथाख्यातं सर्वं तत्ते निवेदितम् ॥
नक्षत्रपुरुषं नाम व्रतानामुत्तमोत्तमम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.108.m: All that was spoken by Vasiṣṭha has been related to you: / the votive observance called the Constellation-Man, highest of the highest of votive observances.

4.108.s:
hṛdbāhujānunayanorunitaṃbabhāgaṃ dakṣaiḥ prakalpya sutanuṃ puruṣottamasya ..
ye pūjayaṃti jitakopamanovikārāḥ kauṃteya te nanu bhavaṃti surūpadehā .. 42 ..
nakṣatrākhyavratavarṇanam
4.108.d:
हृद्बाहुजानुनयनोरुनितंबभागं दक्षैः प्रकल्प्य सुतनुं पुरुषोत्तमस्य ॥
ये पूजयंति जितकोपमनोविकाराः कौंतेय ते ननु भवंति सुरूपदेहा ॥ 42 ॥
नक्षत्राख्यव्रतवर्णनम्
4.108.m:
Those who, having arranged the fine body of Puruṣottama by its parts—heart, arms, knees, eyes, thighs, and buttocks—with skill, / worship him with anger and mental afflictions conquered, O son of Kuntī, they surely become endowed with handsome bodies.
Description of the Votive Observance named Constellation

4.109.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
upavāseṣvaśaktasya tadaiva phalamicchataḥ ..
anabhyāsena yogādvā kimiṣṭaṃ vratamucyate .. 1 ..
4.109.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
उपवासेष्वशक्तस्य तदैव फलमिच्छतः ॥
अनभ्यासेन योगाद्वा किमिष्टं व्रतमुच्यते ॥ 1 ॥
4.109.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / For one incapable of fasting, who yet desires that very fruit, / what beloved votive observance is proclaimed through disuse [of austerities] or through yoga?

4.109.s:
śivasyopari yasya syādbhaktiḥ sūryasya saṃbhavet ..
nakṣatrākhyaṃ vrataṃ tena kathaṃ kāryaṃ vadasva me .. 2..
4.109.d:
शिवस्योपरि यस्य स्याद्भक्तिः सूर्यस्य संभवेत् ॥
नक्षत्राख्यं व्रतं तेन कथं कार्यं वदस्व मे ॥ 2॥
4.109.m: One who has devotion towards Śiva, or in whom [devotion] to Sūrya should arise— / tell me, how should the votive observance named Constellation be performed by him?

4.109.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
upavāseṣvaśaktānāṃ naktaṃ bhojanamiṣyate ..
asminvrate tadapyatra śrūyatāmakṣayaṃ mahat .. 3 ..
4.109.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
उपवासेष्वशक्तानां नक्तं भोजनमिष्यते ॥
अस्मिन्व्रते तदप्यत्र श्रूयतामक्षयं महत् ॥ 3 ॥
4.109.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / For those incapable of fasting, a nocturnal meal is prescribed. / In this votive observance, hear now of that great, imperishable [fruit].

4.109.s:
śivanakṣatrapuruṣaṃ śivabhaktipradāyakam ..
yasminnakṣatrayoge tu purāṇajñāḥ pracakṣate .. 4 ..
4.109.d:
शिवनक्षत्रपुरुषं शिवभक्तिप्रदायकम् ॥
यस्मिन्नक्षत्रयोगे तु पुराणज्ञाः प्रचक्षते ॥ 4 ॥
4.109.m: The Śiva-Constellation-Man, who bestows devotion to Śiva, / on which asterism-conjunction the knowers of the Purāṇas declare [him to be worshipped]:

4.109.s:
phālgunasyāmale pakṣe yadā hastaḥ prajāyate ..
tadā grāhyaṃ vrataṃ caiva naktena śivapūjanam .. 5 ..
4.109.d:
फाल्गुनस्यामले पक्षे यदा हस्तः प्रजायते ॥
तदा ग्राह्यं व्रतं चैव नक्तेन शिवपूजनम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.109.m: When Hasta occurs in the bright fortnight of Phālguna, / then the votive observance is to be undertaken, worshipping Śiva with a nocturnal meal.

4.109.s:
śivā yeti ca hastena pādau pūjyatamau smṛtau ..
śaṃkarāya namo gulphau pūjyau citrāsu pāṃḍava .. 6 ..
4.109.d:
शिवा येति च हस्तेन पादौ पूज्यतमौ स्मृतौ ॥
शंकराय नमो गुल्फौ पूज्यौ चित्रासु पांडव ॥ 6 ॥
4.109.m: With Hasta, the two feet are traditionally known as most worthy of worship, with “To Śiva”; / the two ankles are to be worshipped under Citrā with “Homage to Śaṅkara,” O Pāṇḍava.

4.109.s:
bhīmāyeti ca svātīṣu pūjayetpuruṣarṣabha ..
ūru ddvayaṃ viśākhāsu trinetrāyati pūjayet .. 7 ..
4.109.d:
भीमायेति च स्वातीषु पूजयेत्पुरुषर्षभ ॥
ऊरु द्द्वयं विशाखासु त्रिनेत्रायति पूजयेत् ॥ 7 ॥
4.109.m: Under Svātī one should worship with “To Bhīma,” O bull among men; / under Viśākhā one should worship the two thighs with “To the Three-Eyed.”

4.109.s:
meḍhraṃ caivānurādhāsu anaṅgāṅgaharāya ca ..
kaṭiṃ jyeṣṭhāsu ca tathā surajyeṣṭheti cārcayet .. .. 8 ..
4.109.d:
मेढ्रं चैवानुराधासु अनङ्गाङ्गहराय च ॥
कटिं ज्येष्ठासु च तथा सुरज्येष्ठेति चार्चयेत् ॥ ॥ 8 ॥
4.109.m: Under Anurādhā, the penis [should be worshipped] with “And to the destroyer of the body of the Bodiless [Kāma]”; / and under Jyeṣṭhā one should worship the waist with “To the Eldest of the gods.”

4.109.s:
dānākhyāya namo nābhiḥ pūjyā mūlena śūlinaḥ ..
pūrvottarāṣāḍhayuge pārśve vai pārvatīpatiḥ .. 9 ..
4.109.d:
दानाख्याय नमो नाभिः पूज्या मूलेन शूलिनः ॥
पूर्वोत्तराषाढयुगे पार्श्वे वै पार्वतीपतिः ॥ 9 ॥
4.109.m: Under Mūla, the navel of the Trident-bearer is to be worshipped with “Homage to the one called Bestower”; / under the pair of Pūrvāṣāḍhā and Uttarāṣāḍhā, the lord of Pārvatī [is worshipped] in the two flanks.

4.109.s:
śravaṇena tathā kukṣī pūjye kapālineti ca ..
vakṣaḥsthalaṃ dhaniṣṭhāsu sadyojāteti nāma ca .. 4.109.10 ..
4.109.d:
श्रवणेन तथा कुक्षी पूज्ये कपालिनेति च ॥
वक्षःस्थलं धनिष्ठासु सद्योजातेति नाम च ॥ 4.109.10 ॥
4.109.m: Under Śravaṇa, the two sides of the belly are to be worshipped with “To the Skull-bearer”; / under Dhaniṣṭhā, the chest with the name “To Sadyojāta.”

4.109.s:
vāmeti pūjayetpārtha hṛdayaṃ śatabhiṣāsu ca ..
pūrvottarāyuge bāhū namaḥ khaṭvāṃgadhāriṇe .. 11 ..
4.109.d:
वामेति पूजयेत्पार्थ हृदयं शतभिषासु च ॥
पूर्वोत्तरायुगे बाहू नमः खट्वांगधारिणे ॥ 11 ॥
4.109.m: Under Śatabhiṣaj, one should worship the heart with “To Vāma,” O son of Pṛthā; / under the pair of [Pūrvabhādrapadā and Uttarabhādrapadā], the two arms with “Homage to the bearer of the skull-topped staff.”

4.109.s:
pūjyaṃ rudrāya ca tathā revatīṣu karadvayam ..
nakhaḥ pūjyo'śvinīyoge namaḥ khaṇḍendudhāriṇe .. 12 ..
4.109.d:
पूज्यं रुद्राय च तथा रेवतीषु करद्वयम् ॥
नखः पूज्योऽश्विनीयोगे नमः खण्डेन्दुधारिणे ॥ 12 ॥
4.109.m: Under Revatī, the two hands are to be worshipped with “To Rudra”; / under the conjunction of Aśvinī, the nails are to be worshipped with “Homage to the bearer of the crescent moon.”

4.109.s:
bharaṇīṣu tataḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ vṛṣāṃkāya namo'stu te ..
kṛttivāsāya ca tathā kṛttikāsu kṛkāṭikām .. 13 ..
4.109.d:
भरणीषु ततः पृष्ठं वृषांकाय नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
कृत्तिवासाय च तथा कृत्तिकासु कृकाटिकाम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.109.m: Then under Bharaṇī, the back with “Homage be to you whose emblem is the bull”; / and under Kṛttikā, the nape of the neck with “To the one clad in skins.”

4.109.s:
vākpūjyā rohiṇīyoge namo vācaspateti ca ..
mṛgottamāṃge daśanānbhairavāyeti vai namaḥ .. 14 ..
4.109.d:
वाक्पूज्या रोहिणीयोगे नमो वाचस्पतेति च ॥
मृगोत्तमांगे दशनान्भैरवायेति वै नमः ॥ 14 ॥
4.109.m: Under the conjunction of Rohiṇī, speech is to be worshipped with “Homage to the Lord of Speech”; / under the head of Mṛga[śiras], the teeth indeed with “Homage to Bhairava.”

4.109.s:
ārdrāsu pūjyāvadharau sthāṇaveti yudhiṣṭhira ..
nāsā punarvasau pūjyā pūṣadaṃtavināśine .. .. 15 ..
4.109.d:
आर्द्रासु पूज्यावधरौ स्थाणवेति युधिष्ठिर ॥
नासा पुनर्वसौ पूज्या पूषदंतविनाशिने ॥ ॥ 15 ॥
4.109.m: Under Ārdrā, the two lips are to be worshipped with “To Sthāṇu,” O Yudhiṣṭhira; / under Punarvasu, the nose is to be worshipped with “To the destroyer of the teeth of Pūṣan.”

4.109.s:
puṣye netratrayaṃ pūjyaṃ namaste sarvadarśine ..
āśleṣāyāṃ lalāṭaṃ ca tryambakāya namonamaḥ .. 16 ..
4.109.d:
पुष्ये नेत्रत्रयं पूज्यं नमस्ते सर्वदर्शिने ॥
आश्लेषायां ललाटं च त्र्यम्बकाय नमोनमः ॥ 16 ॥
4.109.m: Under Puṣya, the triad of eyes is to be worshipped with “Homage to you, the All-seeing”; / under Āśleṣā, the forehead with “Homage, homage to the Three-Eyed.”

4.109.s:
maghāsu ca jaṭājūṭaṃ pūjayedaṃdhakāraye ..
pūrvāphālgunikāyugme śravaṇe somadhāriṇe .. 17 ..
4.109.d:
मघासु च जटाजूटं पूजयेदंधकारये ॥
पूर्वाफाल्गुनिकायुग्मे श्रवणे सोमधारिणे ॥ 17 ॥
4.109.m: Under Maghā, one should worship the matted crest with “To the enemy of Andhaka”; / under the pair of Pūrvaphālgunī [and Uttaraphālgunī], the two ears with “To the bearer of the moon.”

4.109.s:
namo'stu pāśāṃkuśapadmaśūlakapālasarpendudhanurddharāya ..
gajāsurānaṃgadhurāṃdhakādivināśamūlāya namaḥ śivāya .. 18 ..
4.109.d:
नमोऽस्तु पाशांकुशपद्मशूलकपालसर्पेन्दुधनुर्द्धराय ॥
गजासुरानंगधुरांधकादिविनाशमूलाय नमः शिवाय ॥ 18 ॥
4.109.m: “Homage be to the bearer of the noose, the goad, the lotus, the trident, the skull, the serpent, the moon, and the bow; / homage to Śiva, the root of the destruction of Gajāsura, the Bodiless [Kāma], Dhurā, Andhaka, and others.”

4.109.s:
śiraḥ sampūjayeddadyāttato dhūpavilepanam ..
tatastu rātrau bhoktavyaṃ tailakṣāravivarjitam .. 19 ..
4.109.d:
शिरः सम्पूजयेद्दद्यात्ततो धूपविलेपनम् ॥
ततस्तु रात्रौ भोक्तव्यं तैलक्षारविवर्जितम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.109.m: One should fully worship the head and then offer incense and anointing unguent; / then at night one should eat, avoiding oil and alkaline food.

4.109.s:
śālitaṇḍulakaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam ..
dadyātsarveṣu nakteṣu brāhmaṇāya nṛpottama .. 4.109.20 ..
4.109.d:
शालितण्डुलकप्रस्थं घृतपात्रेण संयुतम् ॥
दद्यात्सर्वेषु नक्तेषु ब्राह्मणाय नृपोत्तम ॥ 4.109.20 ॥
4.109.m: A prastha of winter rice accompanied by a vessel of clarified butter / one should give to a brāhmaṇa at every nocturnal meal, O best of kings.

4.109.s:
śaktyabhāve na doṣaḥ syādadhike cādhikaṃ phalam ..
nakṣatrayugale prāpte naktayugmaṃ samācaret .. 21 ..
4.109.d:
शक्त्यभावे न दोषः स्यादधिके चाधिकं फलम् ॥
नक्षत्रयुगले प्राप्ते नक्तयुग्मं समाचरेत् ॥ 21 ॥
4.109.m: In the absence of capacity there is no fault, and with more there is greater fruit. / When a pair of asterisms is reached, one should observe a pair of nocturnal meals.

4.109.s:
sūtakāśaucadoṣe tu punaranyadupoṣayet ..
evaṃ krameṇa saṃprāpte pāraṇe pāṃḍavādike .. 22 ..
4.109.d:
सूतकाशौचदोषे तु पुनरन्यदुपोषयेत् ॥
एवं क्रमेण संप्राप्ते पारणे पांडवादिके ॥ 22 ॥
4.109.m: If there is the fault of impurity from birth or death, one should fast anew. / When the breaking of the fast is reached in this sequence, O descendant of Pāṇḍu and others,

4.109.s:
brāhmaṇānbhojayedbhaktyā guḍakṣīra ghṛtādibhiḥ..
kāṃcanaṃ kārayeddevamumayā saha śaṃkaram .. 23 ..
4.109.d:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेद्भक्त्या गुडक्षीर घृतादिभिः॥
कांचनं कारयेद्देवमुमया सह शंकरम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.109.m: one should feed brāhmaṇas with devotion, with jaggery, milk, clarified butter, and the like; / one should have a golden god, Śaṅkara together with Umā, made.

4.109.s:
śayyāṃ sulakṣaṇāṃ kṛtvā viruddhagraṃthivarjitām ..
sopadhānakaviśrāmāṃ svāstarāvaraṇāṃ śubhām .. 24 ..
4.109.d:
शय्यां सुलक्षणां कृत्वा विरुद्धग्रंथिवर्जिताम् ॥
सोपधानकविश्रामां स्वास्तरावरणां शुभाम् ॥ 24 ॥
4.109.m: Having prepared an auspicious bed of good characteristics, devoid of inauspicious knots, / with a pillow and headrest, well spread and covered, auspicious,

4.109.s:
bhājanopānahacchatracāmarāsanadarpaṇaiḥ ..
bhūṣaṇairapi saṃyuktāṃ phalavastrānulepanaiḥ .. 25 ..
4.109.d:
भाजनोपानहच्छत्रचामरासनदर्पणैः ॥
भूषणैरपि संयुक्तां फलवस्त्रानुलेपनैः ॥ 25 ॥
4.109.m: furnished with utensils, shoes, a royal parasol, a chowrie, a seat, and a mirror, / and with ornaments, fruits, garments, and unguents,

4.109.s:
tasyāṃ nidhāya taṃ devamalaṃkṛtya guṇānvitam ..
kapilāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ śuciśīlāṃ payasvinīm .. 26 ..
4.109.d:
तस्यां निधाय तं देवमलंकृत्य गुणान्वितम् ॥
कपिलां वस्त्रसंवीतां शुचिशीलां पयस्विनीम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.109.m: placing that god upon it, adorning him, endowed with virtues, / [and taking] a brown cow covered in cloth, of pure disposition, giving milk,

4.109.s:
suvarṇaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām ..
dadyānmaṃtreṇa pūrvāhne na kālamabhilaṃghayet .. 27 ..
4.109.d:
सुवर्णशृंगीं रौप्यखुरां सवत्सां कांस्यदोहनाम् ॥
दद्यान्मंत्रेण पूर्वाह्ने न कालमभिलंघयेत् ॥ 27 ॥
4.109.m: with golden horns, silver hooves, with her calf, accompanied by a bronze milking vessel, / one should give [them] with the mantra in the morning; one should not let the time pass:

4.109.s:
yathā na devaśayanaṃ tava parvatajātayā ..
śūnyaṃ vṛttyātha saṃtatyā tathā me saṃtu siddhayaḥ .. 28 ..
4.109.d:
यथा न देवशयनं तव पर्वतजातया ॥
शून्यं वृत्त्याथ संतत्या तथा मे संतु सिद्धयः ॥ 28 ॥
4.109.m: “Just as your divine bed is never empty of the daughter of the mountain / in conduct or in offspring, so may my accomplishments be.

4.109.s:
yathā deva na śreyo'rthastvadanyo vidyate kvacit ..
tathā māmuddharāśeṣaduḥkhasaṃsārasāgarāt .. 29 ..
4.109.d:
यथा देव न श्रेयोऽर्थस्त्वदन्यो विद्यते क्वचित् ॥
तथा मामुद्धराशेषदुःखसंसारसागरात् ॥ 29 ॥
4.109.m: Just as no goal of welfare other than you exists anywhere, O god, / so deliver me from the ocean of worldly existence filled with endless sorrow.”

4.109.s:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇipatya visarjayet ..
śayyāgavāditatsarvaṃ dvijasya bhavanaṃ nayet .. 4.109.30 ..
4.109.d:
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ॥
शय्यागवादितत्सर्वं द्विजस्य भवनं नयेत् ॥ 4.109.30 ॥
4.109.m: Then, having circumambulated him and bowed down, one should dismiss him; / one should take the bed, the cow, and all the rest to the house of the twice-born.

4.109.s:
naitadviśīlāya na dāṃbhikāya kutarkaduṣṭāya viniṃdakāya ..
prakāśanīyaṃ vratamindumauleryaścāpi lobhopahatāṃtarātmā .. 31 ..
4.109.d:
नैतद्विशीलाय न दांभिकाय कुतर्कदुष्टाय विनिंदकाय ॥
प्रकाशनीयं व्रतमिन्दुमौलेर्यश्चापि लोभोपहतांतरात्मा ॥ 31 ॥
4.109.m: This votive observance of the Moon-crested God must not be disclosed to one of bad character, nor to a hypocrite, / nor to one corrupted by faulty logic, nor to a reviler, nor to one whose inner self is afflicted by greed.

4.109.s:
bhaktāya dāṃtāya guṇānvitāya pradeyametacchivabhaktiyuktaiḥ ..
idaṃ mahāpātakakṛnnarāṇāmapyakṣayaṃ vedavido vadaṃti .. 32 ..
4.109.d:
भक्ताय दांताय गुणान्विताय प्रदेयमेतच्छिवभक्तियुक्तैः ॥
इदं महापातककृन्नराणामप्यक्षयं वेदविदो वदंति ॥ 32 ॥
4.109.m: It should be imparted to a devotee, self-controlled and endowed with virtues, by those possessed of devotion to Śiva. / The knowers of the Vedas declare this to be imperishable even for men who have committed the great sins.

4.109.s:
yā vātha nārī kurute'tibhaktyā bhartāramāśritya śubhaṃ guruṃ vā ..
na baṃdhuputrairna dhanairviyogamāpnoti duḥkhaṃ na suhṛtsamuttham .. 33 ..
4.109.d:
या वाथ नारी कुरुतेऽतिभक्त्या भर्तारमाश्रित्य शुभं गुरुं वा ॥
न बंधुपुत्रैर्न धनैर्वियोगमाप्नोति दुःखं न सुहृत्समुत्थम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.109.m: Or whatever woman performs it with great devotion, relying on her husband or an auspicious guru, / she suffers no separation from kinsmen, sons, or wealth, nor grief arising from friends.

4.109.s:
idaṃ vaśiṣṭhena purā'rjunena kṛtaṃ kubereṇa puraṃdareṇa ..
yatkīrtanādapyakhilānyaghāni vighnaṃ samāyāṃti na saṃśayotra .. 34 ..
4.109.d:
इदं वशिष्ठेन पुराऽर्जुनेन कृतं कुबेरेण पुरंदरेण ॥
यत्कीर्तनादप्यखिलान्यघानि विघ्नं समायांति न संशयोत्र ॥ 34 ॥
4.109.m: This was performed of old by Vasiṣṭha, by Arjuna, by Kubera, and by Purandara. / From the mere recitation of it, all sins meet with impediment; there is no doubt here.

4.109.s:
iti paṭhati śṛṇoti vā ya itthaṃ śivapuruṣaṃ puruhūtavallabhaḥ syāt ..
api narakagatānpitṝnaśeṣāñcchivabhavanaṃ nayatīha yaḥ karoti .. 35 ..
sampūrṇavratavarṇanam
4.109.d:
इति पठति शृणोति वा य इत्थं शिवपुरुषं पुरुहूतवल्लभः स्यात् ॥
अपि नरकगतान्पितॄनशेषाञ्च्छिवभवनं नयतीह यः करोति ॥ 35 ॥
सम्पूर्णव्रतवर्णनम्
4.109.m:
Whoever thus reads or hears of the Śiva-Man becomes beloved of Indra; / and whoever performs it here leads all ancestors who have gone to hell to the abode of Śiva.
Description of the Complete Votive Observance

4.110.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
yadi kartuṃ na śaknoti vrataṃ nakṣatrapauruṣam ..
gṛhītaṃ rabhasā kṛṣṇa hyanyadvā vratamuttamam .. 1 ..
4.110.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
यदि कर्तुं न शक्नोति व्रतं नक्षत्रपौरुषम् ॥
गृहीतं रभसा कृष्ण ह्यन्यद्वा व्रतमुत्तमम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.110.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
If one is unable to perform the Nakṣatrapauruṣa votive observance / or another excellent votive observance undertaken rashly, O Kṛṣṇa,

4.110.s:
saṃpūrṇaṃ jāyate yena yadacīrṇaṃ purā sthitam ..
kuru prasādaṃ guhyārthametanme vaktumarhasi .. . 2 ..
4.110.d:
संपूर्णं जायते येन यदचीर्णं पुरा स्थितम् ॥
कुरु प्रसादं गुह्यार्थमेतन्मे वक्तुमर्हसि ॥ । 2 ॥
4.110.m: by which that which remained unperformed in the past becomes complete— / please show favour; you ought to tell me this secret matter.

4.110.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
sādhusādhu mahābāho kururāja yudhiṣṭhira ..
rahasyānāṃ rahasyaṃ te kathayāmi vratottamam .. 3 ..
4.110.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
साधुसाधु महाबाहो कुरुराज युधिष्ठिर ॥
रहस्यानां रहस्यं ते कथयामि व्रतोत्तमम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.110.m:
The blessed Kṛṣṇa said:
Very good, very good, O mighty-armed Yudhiṣṭhira, king of the Kurus! / I shall tell you the secret of secrets, an excellent votive observance.

4.110.s:
sampūrṇaṃ nāma taccāpi vrataṃ samyakphalapradam ..
yaccīrṇaṃ naranārībhirbhavetsaṃpūrṇakārakam .. 4 ..
4.110.d:
सम्पूर्णं नाम तच्चापि व्रतं सम्यक्फलप्रदम् ॥
यच्चीर्णं नरनारीभिर्भवेत्संपूर्णकारकम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.110.m: It is named the Saṃpūrṇa votive observance, and it grants complete fruits; / when performed by men or women, it brings about completeness.

4.110.s:
avaśyaṃ tacca kartavyamakṣīṇaphalakāṃkṣibhiḥ ..
kiñcidbhagnaṃ pramādena yadgataṃ vratināṃ sthitam ..
tatsaṃpūrṇaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ vratenānena pāṇḍava .. 5 ..
4.110.d:
अवश्यं तच्च कर्तव्यमक्षीणफलकांक्षिभिः ॥
किञ्चिद्भग्नं प्रमादेन यद्गतं व्रतिनां स्थितम् ॥
तत्संपूर्णं भवेत्सर्वं व्रतेनानेन पाण्डव ॥ 5 ॥
4.110.m: And it must certainly be performed by those desiring unexhausted fruits. / If something broken through negligence has occurred, standing [unresolved] for the observers of vows, / all that becomes complete through this votive observance, O son of Pāṇḍu.

4.110.s:
upadravairbahuvidhairmadānmohācca pārthiva ..
yadbhagnaṃ kiñcideva syādvrataṃ vipravināyakaiḥ ..
tatsaṃpūrṇaṃ bhavetpārtha satyaṃsatyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 6 ..
4.110.d:
उपद्रवैर्बहुविधैर्मदान्मोहाच्च पार्थिव ॥
यद्भग्नं किञ्चिदेव स्याद्व्रतं विप्रविनायकैः ॥
तत्संपूर्णं भवेत्पार्थ सत्यंसत्यं न संशयः ॥ 6 ॥
4.110.m: If any votive observance whatsoever should be broken due to various troubles, / or out of pride and delusion, O king, or by brahmins and vināyakas, / all that becomes complete, O son of Pṛthā; it is true, it is true, there is no doubt.

4.110.s:
kāṃcanaṃ raupyakaṃ rūpaṃ śilpinā taddhaṭāpayet ..
bhagnavrate tu yo devastatsvarūpaṃ sunirmitam .. 7 ..
4.110.d:
कांचनं रौप्यकं रूपं शिल्पिना तद्धटापयेत् ॥
भग्नव्रते तु यो देवस्तत्स्वरूपं सुनिर्मितम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.110.m: One should have an artisan fashion an image of gold or of silver: / the well-made form of whichever deity belonged to the broken votive observance,

4.110.s:
rūpaṃ strīpuṃsayorvāpi prārabdhaṃ yadvrate kila ..
