navaniṣpāditaṃ kiñciddaivātsarvaṃ tathotthitam .. 8 ..
4.110.d:
रूपं स्त्रीपुंसयोर्वापि प्रारब्धं यद्व्रते किल ॥
नवनिष्पादितं किञ्चिद्दैवात्सर्वं तथोत्थितम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.110.m: or an image of a woman or a man, whichever had indeed been begun in the votive observance. / If something newly made has all turned out thus by chance,

4.110.s:
dvibhujaṃ paṅkajārūḍhaṃ saumyaprahasitānanam ..
niṣpāditaṃ śilpabhāvāttasminneva dinedine .. 9 ..
4.110.d:
द्विभुजं पङ्कजारूढं सौम्यप्रहसिताननम् ॥
निष्पादितं शिल्पभावात्तस्मिन्नेव दिनेदिने ॥ 9 ॥
4.110.m: two-armed, seated on a lotus, with a gentle, smiling face, / completed day by day by the skill of the artisan—

4.110.s:
tanmāse ca punaḥ prāpte brāhmaṇo vidhinā gṛhe ..
snāpayetpayasā dadhnā ghṛtakṣīrarasāṃbubhiḥ .. 4.110.10 ..
4.110.d:
तन्मासे च पुनः प्राप्ते ब्राह्मणो विधिना गृहे ॥
स्नापयेत्पयसा दध्ना घृतक्षीररसांबुभिः ॥ 4.110.10 ॥
4.110.m: then, when that month has arrived once again, a brahmin should, in accordance with the rule, / bathe it in his house with milk, curds, ghee, condensed milk, juice, and water.

4.110.s:
gaṃdhacaṃdanapuṣpaiśca carcayetkuṃkumādinā ..
toyapūrṇasya kumbhasya pṛthvyāṃ vinyasya caṃdanaiḥ .. 11 ..
4.110.d:
गंधचंदनपुष्पैश्च चर्चयेत्कुंकुमादिना ॥
तोयपूर्णस्य कुम्भस्य पृथ्व्यां विन्यस्य चंदनैः ॥ 11 ॥
4.110.m: And he should anoint it with perfumes, sandal-paste, flowers, saffron, and the like. / Having placed on the ground, with sandal-pastes, a water-pot filled with water,

4.110.s:
dhūpadīpākṣatairvastrai ratnairapyupahārakaiḥ ..
arghyaṃ dadyācca tannāmnā maṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava .. 12 ..
4.110.d:
धूपदीपाक्षतैर्वस्त्रै रत्नैरप्युपहारकैः ॥
अर्घ्यं दद्याच्च तन्नाम्ना मंत्रेणानेन पांडव ॥ 12 ॥
4.110.m: and with incense, lamps, unbroken grains, garments, jewels, and offerings, / he should offer arghya in that deity's name with this mantra, O son of Pāṇḍu:

4.110.s:
upasannasya dīnasya prāyaścittakṛtāñjaleḥ ..
śaraṇaṃ ca prapannasya kuruṣvādya dayāṃ prabho .. 13 ..
4.110.d:
उपसन्नस्य दीनस्य प्रायश्चित्तकृताञ्जलेः ॥
शरणं च प्रपन्नस्य कुरुष्वाद्य दयां प्रभो ॥ 13 ॥
4.110.m: “To me who have approached, wretched, with folded hands in expiation, / and who have taken refuge, extend your compassion today, O Lord!

4.110.s:
paratra bhayabhītasya bhagnakhaṇḍavratasya ca ..
kuru prasādaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ vrataṃ saṃpūrṇamastu me .. 14 ..
4.110.d:
परत्र भयभीतस्य भग्नखण्डव्रतस्य च ॥
कुरु प्रसादं संपूर्णं व्रतं संपूर्णमस्तु मे ॥ 14 ॥
4.110.m: To me who am terrified of the next world, whose votive observance is broken and incomplete, / grant your grace so that it becomes complete; may my votive observance be complete!

4.110.s:
tapaśchidraṃ vratacchidraṃ yacchidraṃ bhagnake vrate ..
tava prasādāddeveśa sarvamacchidramastu naḥ .. svāhā .. 15 .. (amukadevāya namaḥ ..)
4.110.d:
तपश्छिद्रं व्रतच्छिद्रं यच्छिद्रं भग्नके व्रते ॥
तव प्रसादाद्देवेश सर्वमच्छिद्रमस्तु नः ॥ स्वाहा ॥ 15 ॥ (अमुकदेवाय नमः ॥)
4.110.m: Whatever flaw there is in austerity, whatever flaw in the votive observance, whatever flaw in the broken votive observance, / by your grace, O Lord of the gods, may all of it be without flaw for us! Svāhā!” (Salutations to such-and-such deity!)

4.110.s:
pūrvato dakṣiṇataḥ paścimata uttarataḥ ..
vidikṣu coparyyadhastāddikpālebhyo namonamaḥ .. 16 ..
4.110.d:
पूर्वतो दक्षिणतः पश्चिमत उत्तरतः ॥
विदिक्षु चोपर्य्यधस्ताद्दिक्पालेभ्यो नमोनमः ॥ 16 ॥
4.110.m: “To the east, to the south, to the west, to the north, / in the intermediate directions, above, and below, salutations, salutations to the guardians of the directions!

4.110.s:
idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ naivedyaṃ te namonamaḥ ..
evaṃ procya tataḥ pādau jānunī kaṭiśīrṣake .. 17 ..
4.110.d:
इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यं नैवेद्यं ते नमोनमः ॥
एवं प्रोच्य ततः पादौ जानुनी कटिशीर्षके ॥ 17 ॥
4.110.m: This is arghya, this is pādya, this is the food offering for you; salutations, salutations!” / Having spoken thus, he should then worship the feet, the knees, the hips, the head,

4.110.s:
vakṣaḥkukṣidṛṣṭipṛṣṭhabāhvaṃsāṃkaśiroruhān ..
pūjayettasya devasya tataḥ paścātkṣamāpayet .. 18 ..
4.110.d:
वक्षःकुक्षिदृष्टिपृष्ठबाह्वंसांकशिरोरुहान् ॥
पूजयेत्तस्य देवस्य ततः पश्चात्क्षमापयेत् ॥ 18 ॥
4.110.m: the chest, the belly, the eyes, the back, the arms, the shoulders, the lap, and the hair / of that deity; thereafter he should ask for forgiveness:

4.110.s:
pūjitastvaṃ yathāśaktyā namaste'stu surottama ..
aihikāmuṣmikīṃ nātha kāryasiddhiṃ diśasva me .. 19 ..
4.110.d:
पूजितस्त्वं यथाशक्त्या नमस्तेऽस्तु सुरोत्तम ॥
ऐहिकामुष्मिकीं नाथ कार्यसिद्धिं दिशस्व मे ॥ 19 ॥
4.110.m: “You have been worshipped according to my ability; may there be salutations to you, O best of gods! / Bestow upon me, O Lord, success in my undertakings in this world and the next.”

4.110.s:
evaṃ kṣamāpayitvā tu devarūpaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
tato dvijasya kaunteya vidhijñasyopapādayet .. 4.110.20 ..
4.110.d:
एवं क्षमापयित्वा तु देवरूपं विधानतः ॥
ततो द्विजस्य कौन्तेय विधिज्ञस्योपपादयेत् ॥ 4.110.20 ॥
4.110.m: Having thus asked forgiveness of the deity's image in accordance with the rule, / he should then present it, O son of Kuntī, to a twice-born who knows the rules.

4.110.s:
sthitvā pūrvamukho vipro gṛhṇīyāddarbhapāṇinā ..
viprasya haste yacchecca dātā vai cottarāmukhaḥ ..
maṃtreṇānena kauṃteya sopavāsaḥ prayatnataḥ 21 ..
4.110.d:
स्थित्वा पूर्वमुखो विप्रो गृह्णीयाद्दर्भपाणिना ॥
विप्रस्य हस्ते यच्छेच्च दाता वै चोत्तरामुखः ॥
मंत्रेणानेन कौंतेय सोपवासः प्रयत्नतः 21 ॥
4.110.m: Standing facing east, the brahmin should take it with darbha grass in his hand, / and the giver, facing north, fasting, should diligently place it / in the hand of the brahmin with this mantra, O son of Kuntī:

4.110.s:
idaṃ vrataṃ mayā khaṃḍaṃ kṛtamāsītpurā dvija ..
bhagavaṃstvaprasādena saṃpūrṇaṃ tadihāstu me .. 22 ..
4.110.d:
इदं व्रतं मया खंडं कृतमासीत्पुरा द्विज ॥
भगवंस्त्वप्रसादेन संपूर्णं तदिहास्तु मे ॥ 22 ॥
4.110.m: “This votive observance was left incomplete by me in the past, O twice-born; / O venerable one, through your grace, may that become complete for me here!”

4.110.s:
brāhmaṇo'pi pratīcchettu maṃtreṇānena tadvratam ..
vāksaṃpūrṇaṃ manaḥpūrṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ kāyavratena te..
saṃpūrṇasya prasādena bhava pūrṇamanorathaḥ ..23..
4.110.d:
ब्राह्मणोऽपि प्रतीच्छेत्तु मंत्रेणानेन तद्व्रतम् ॥
वाक्संपूर्णं मनःपूर्णं पूर्णं कायव्रतेन ते॥
संपूर्णस्य प्रसादेन भव पूर्णमनोरथः ॥23॥
4.110.m: The brahmin also should accept that votive observance with this mantra: / “Complete in speech, complete in mind, complete through the bodily votive observance for you; / by the grace of the Complete One, may your wishes be fulfilled!”

4.110.s:
brāhmaṇā yatprabhāṣaṃte hyanumodaṃti devatāḥ ..
sarvadevamayā viprā naitadvacanamanyathā .. 24 ..
4.110.d:
ब्राह्मणा यत्प्रभाषंते ह्यनुमोदंति देवताः ॥
सर्वदेवमया विप्रा नैतद्वचनमन्यथा ॥ 24 ॥
4.110.m: Whatever brahmins speak, the deities indeed approve; / brahmins embody all the gods; this word does not prove false.

4.110.s:
jaladhiḥ kṣāratāṃ nītaḥ pāvakaḥ sarvabhakṣatām ..
sahasranetraḥ śakro'pi kṛto viprairmahātmabhiḥ .. 25 ..
4.110.d:
जलधिः क्षारतां नीतः पावकः सर्वभक्षताम् ॥
सहस्रनेत्रः शक्रोऽपि कृतो विप्रैर्महात्मभिः ॥ 25 ॥
4.110.m: The ocean was reduced to saltiness, fire made an all-devourer, / and Indra himself was made thousand-eyed by high-souled brahmins.

4.110.s:
brāhmaṇānāṃ tu vacanādbrahmahatyā praṇaśyati ..
aśvamedhaphalaṃ sāgraṃ prāpyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 26 ..
4.110.d:
ब्राह्मणानां तु वचनाद्ब्रह्महत्या प्रणश्यति ॥
अश्वमेधफलं साग्रं प्राप्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ 26 ॥
4.110.m: By the word of brahmins, the murder of a brahmin is destroyed, / and the complete fruit of a horse sacrifice is obtained; of this there is no doubt.

4.110.s: vyāsavālmīkivacanādbrāhmaṇavacanācca gargagautama parāśaradhaumyāṃgirasavāṣṭhināradādimunivacanātsaṃpūrṇaṃ bhavatu te vratam .. 27 ..
4.110.d: व्यासवाल्मीकिवचनाद्ब्राह्मणवचनाच्च गर्गगौतम पराशरधौम्यांगिरसवाष्ठिनारदादिमुनिवचनात्संपूर्णं भवतु ते व्रतम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.110.m: “By the word of Vyāsa and Vālmīki, by the word of brahmins, / and by the word of the sages beginning with Garga, Gautama, Parāśara, Dhaumya, Aṅgiras, Vāṣṭhi, and Nārada, may your votive observance be complete!”

4.110.s:
evaṃvidhavidhānena gṛhītvā brāhmaṇo vrajet ..
taddānaṃ preṣayetsa brāhmaṇasya gṛhe svayam ..
tataḥ paṃca mahāyajñānnirvapedbhojanādi ca .. 28 ..
4.110.d:
एवंविधविधानेन गृहीत्वा ब्राह्मणो व्रजेत् ॥
तद्दानं प्रेषयेत्स ब्राह्मणस्य गृहे स्वयम् ॥
ततः पंच महायज्ञान्निर्वपेद्भोजनादि च ॥ 28 ॥
4.110.m: Having accepted [it] in accordance with such a rule, the brahmin should depart. / The giver should himself send that gift to the brahmin's house; / then he should offer the five great sacrifices, take his meal, and so forth.

4.110.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā vratametatsakṛttathā ..
tasya saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti tadvrataṃ yatpurā sthitam .. 29
4.110.d:
एवं यः कुरुते भक्त्या व्रतमेतत्सकृत्तथा ॥
तस्य संपूर्णतां याति तद्व्रतं यत्पुरा स्थितम् ॥ 29
4.110.m: Whoever thus performs this votive observance even once with devotion, / for him that votive observance which stood [incomplete] in the past attains completeness.

4.110.s:
khaṃḍaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti prasanne vratadaivate ..
saṃpūrṇaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā saṃpūrṇāṃgo bhavedvratī .. 4.110.30 ..
4.110.d:
खंडं संपूर्णतां याति प्रसन्ने व्रतदैवते ॥
संपूर्णं च ततः कृत्वा संपूर्णांगो भवेद्व्रती ॥ 4.110.30 ॥
4.110.m: The incomplete attains completeness when the deity of the votive observance is pleased; / and having then made it complete, the observer of vows becomes whole in every limb,

4.110.s:
bhogī bhavyo lasatkīrtiḥ sva saṃpūrṇamanorathaḥ ..
sthitvā varṣaśataṃ martye tataḥ svarge'maro bhavet.. 31 ..
4.110.d:
भोगी भव्यो लसत्कीर्तिः स्व संपूर्णमनोरथः ॥
स्थित्वा वर्षशतं मर्त्ये ततः स्वर्गेऽमरो भवेत्॥ 31 ॥
4.110.m: enjoying pleasures, auspicious, of shining fame, having all his wishes fulfilled. / Having remained in the mortal realm for a hundred years, he then becomes an immortal in heaven.

4.110.s:
yatheṣṭaceṣṭācārī ca brahmaviṣṇvindrapūjitaḥ ..
svargaloke ciraṃ sthitvā punarmokṣamavāpnuyāt .. 32 ..
4.110.d:
यथेष्टचेष्टाचारी च ब्रह्मविष्ण्विन्द्रपूजितः ॥
स्वर्गलोके चिरं स्थित्वा पुनर्मोक्षमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 32 ॥
4.110.m: Moving and acting wherever he wishes, worshipped by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Indra, / after residing in the heavenly world for a long time, he subsequently attains liberation.

4.110.s:
prāyaścittamidaṃ proktaṃ purā gargeṇa me prabho ..
gokule gokulākīrṇe mayā bālye'pyupoṣitam .. 33 ..
4.110.d:
प्रायश्चित्तमिदं प्रोक्तं पुरा गर्गेण मे प्रभो ॥
गोकुले गोकुलाकीर्णे मया बाल्येऽप्युपोषितम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.110.m: This expiation was declared to me in the past by Garga, O Lord; / even in my childhood I observed the fast [for it] in Gokula teeming with cowherds.

4.110.s: evaṃ tvamapi kauṃteya cara saṃpūrṇakaṃ vratam .. 34 ..
4.110.d: एवं त्वमपि कौंतेय चर संपूर्णकं व्रतम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.110.m: In this way you too, O son of Kuntī, perform the Saṃpūrṇaka votive observance.

4.110.s:
bhagnāni yāni madamohavaśādgṛhītvā janmāntareṣvapi nareṇa samatsareṇa ..
saṃpūrṇapūjanaparasya puro bhavaṃti sarvavratāni paripūrṇaphalapradāni .. 35 ..
kāmadānaveśyāvratavarṇanam
4.110.d:
भग्नानि यानि मदमोहवशाद्गृहीत्वा जन्मान्तरेष्वपि नरेण समत्सरेण ॥
संपूर्णपूजनपरस्य पुरो भवंति सर्वव्रतानि परिपूर्णफलप्रदानि ॥ 35 ॥
कामदानवेश्याव्रतवर्णनम्
4.110.m:
Whatever [vows] undertaken have been broken under the sway of pride and delusion, / even across other births, by an envious man— / for one intent on the Saṃpūrṇa worship, all those votive observances / stand before him yielding their full fruits.
Description of the Kāmadāna Prostitute Votive Observance

4.111.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
varṇāśramāṇāṃ prabhavaḥ purāṇeṣu mayā śrutaḥ ..
paṇyastrīṇāṃ samācāraṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ .. 1 ..
4.111.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
वर्णाश्रमाणां प्रभवः पुराणेषु मया श्रुतः ॥
पण्यस्त्रीणां समाचारं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥ 1 ॥
4.111.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
The origin of the social classes and life-stages has been heard by me in the Purāṇas; / I wish to hear in truth about the proper conduct of prostitutes.

4.111.s:
kā hyāsāṃ devatā kṛṣṇa kiṃ vrataṃ kimupoṣitam ..
kena dharmeṇa caivetāḥ svargamāpsyaṃtyanuttamam .. 2 ..
4.111.d:
का ह्यासां देवता कृष्ण किं व्रतं किमुपोषितम् ॥
केन धर्मेण चैवेताः स्वर्गमाप्स्यंत्यनुत्तमम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.111.m: For who is their deity, O Kṛṣṇa? What is their votive observance? What is their fast? / And by what religious duty will these women attain the unsurpassed heaven?

4.111.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
mama patnīsahasrāṇi saṃti pāṃḍava ṣoḍaśa ..
rūpaudāryaguṇopetā manmathāyatanāḥ śubhāḥ .. 3 ..
4.111.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
मम पत्नीसहस्राणि संति पांडव षोडश ॥
रूपौदार्यगुणोपेता मन्मथायतनाः शुभाः ॥ 3 ॥
4.111.m:
The blessed Kṛṣṇa said:
I have sixteen thousand wives, O son of Pāṇḍu, / endowed with beauty, nobility, and good qualities, abodes of love, and auspicious.

4.111.s:
tābhirvasaṃtasamaye kokilālikulākule ..
puṣpitopavanotphullakahlārasarasastaṭe ..
nirbharāpānagoṣṭhīṣu prasaktābhiralaṃkṛte .. 4 ..
4.111.d:
ताभिर्वसंतसमये कोकिलालिकुलाकुले ॥
पुष्पितोपवनोत्फुल्लकह्लारसरसस्तटे ॥
निर्भरापानगोष्ठीषु प्रसक्ताभिरलंकृते ॥ 4 ॥
4.111.m: In the spring season, filled with flocks of cuckoos and swarms of bees, / on the bank of a lake of blossoming red water-lilies in a flowering park, / adorned by them engrossed in lavish drinking gatherings,

4.111.s:
kuraṃganayanaḥ śrīmānmālatīkṛtaśekharaḥ ..
gacchansamīpe mārgeṇa sāṃbaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ .. 5 ..
4.111.d:
कुरंगनयनः श्रीमान्मालतीकृतशेखरः ॥
गच्छन्समीपे मार्गेण सांबः परपुरंजयः ॥ 5 ॥
4.111.m: the glorious Sāmba, conqueror of enemies' cities, / with eyes like a deer and a crest of mālatī flowers, / was passing nearby along the path.

4.111.s:
sākṣātkaṃdarparūpeṇa sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ..
anaṃgaśarataptābhiḥ sābhilāṣamavekṣitaḥ .. 6 ..
4.111.d:
साक्षात्कंदर्परूपेण सर्वाभरणभूषितः ॥
अनंगशरतप्ताभिः साभिलाषमवेक्षितः ॥ 6 ॥
4.111.m: Adorned with all ornaments in the visible form of the God of Love himself, / he was gazed upon with longing by those women, inflamed by the arrows of the Bodiless One.

4.111.s:
pravṛddho manmathastāsāṃ sarvāṅgakṣobhadāyakaḥ ..
nirīkṣya tamahaṃ sarvaṃ vikāraṃ jñānacakṣuṣā .. 7 ..
4.111.d:
प्रवृद्धो मन्मथस्तासां सर्वाङ्गक्षोभदायकः ॥
निरीक्ष्य तमहं सर्वं विकारं ज्ञानचक्षुषा ॥ 7 ॥
4.111.m: Passion swelled within them, agitating their entire bodies. / Seeing all that perturbation with the eye of knowledge,

4.111.s:
aśeṣe ruṣitaḥ sarvā hariṣyaṃtīha dasyavaḥ ..
mayi svargamanuprāpte bhavatīḥ kāmamohitāḥ .. 8 ..
4.111.d:
अशेषे रुषितः सर्वा हरिष्यंतीह दस्यवः ॥
मयि स्वर्गमनुप्राप्ते भवतीः काममोहिताः ॥ 8 ॥
4.111.m: angered at all of them without exception, [I said:] "Bandits here will carry off / all of you, deluded by passion, once I have attained heaven."

4.111.s:
etadvākyamupaśrutya bāṣparyākulekṣaṇāḥ ..
māmūcurvada govinda kathametadbhaviṣyati .. 9 ..
4.111.d:
एतद्वाक्यमुपश्रुत्य बाष्पर्याकुलेक्षणाः ॥
मामूचुर्वद गोविन्द कथमेतद्भविष्यति ॥ 9 ॥
4.111.m: Hearing these words, their eyes troubled with tears, / they spoke to me: "Tell [us], Govinda, how can this come to pass?

4.111.s:
bhartāraṃ jagatāmīśaṃ bhavaṃtamaparā jitam..
divyānubhāvāṃ ca purīṃ ratnavaṃti gṛhāṇi ca .. 4.111.10 ..
4.111.d:
भर्तारं जगतामीशं भवंतमपरा जितम्॥
दिव्यानुभावां च पुरीं रत्नवंति गृहाणि च ॥ 4.111.10 ॥
4.111.m: Having you, the undefeated lord of the worlds, as our husband, / and this city of divine power, and these gem-filled houses,

4.111.s:
dvārikāvāsinaḥ sarvāndevarūpānkumārakān ..
bhagavansarvalokasya kathaṃ bhogyā bhavāmahe .. 11 ..
4.111.d:
द्वारिकावासिनः सर्वान्देवरूपान्कुमारकान् ॥
भगवन्सर्वलोकस्य कथं भोग्या भवामहे ॥ 11 ॥
4.111.m: and all the residents of Dvārikā, youths with the forms of gods, / O Lord, how shall we become objects of enjoyment for common people?

4.111.s:
dāsabhāvamanuprāpya bhaviṣyāmaḥ kathaṃ punaḥ ..
ko dharmaḥ kaḥ samācāraḥ kathaṃ vṛttirbhaviṣyati .. 12 ..
4.111.d:
दासभावमनुप्राप्य भविष्यामः कथं पुनः ॥
को धर्मः कः समाचारः कथं वृत्तिर्भविष्यति ॥ 12 ॥
4.111.m: Having fallen into servitude, what then shall we become? / What dharma, what conduct, and what livelihood will there be [for us]?"

4.111.s:
tathā lālapyamānāstā vāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇāḥ ..
mayā proktā yuvatyastāḥ saṃtāpastyajyatāmayam .. 13 ..
4.111.d:
तथा लालप्यमानास्ता वाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणाः ॥
मया प्रोक्ता युवत्यस्ताः संतापस्त्यज्यतामयम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.111.m: To those young women who were thus lamenting, their eyes troubled with tears, / it was said by me: "Let this distress be cast away.

4.111.s:
jalakrīḍāvihāreṣu purā sarasi mānase ..
bhavatīnāṃ sagarvāṇāṃ nārado'bhyāśamāgataḥ .. 14 ..
4.111.d:
जलक्रीडाविहारेषु पुरा सरसि मानसे ॥
भवतीनां सगर्वाणां नारदोऽभ्याशमागतः ॥ 14 ॥
4.111.m: Long ago, during your water-sports and pleasures in Lake Mānasa, / Nārada approached you while you were full of pride.

4.111.s:
hutāśanasutāḥ sarvā bhavatyo'psarasaḥ purā ..
apraṇamyāvalepena paripṛṣṭaḥ sa yogavit .. 15 ..
4.111.d:
हुताशनसुताः सर्वा भवत्योऽप्सरसः पुरा ॥
अप्रणम्यावलेपेन परिपृष्टः स योगवित् ॥ 15 ॥
4.111.m: Formerly you were all apsarases, daughters of the Fire God. / Without bowing down out of haughtiness, that knower of yoga was asked:

4.111.s:
kathaṃ nārā yaṇo'smākaṃ bhartā syādityupādiśa ..
tasmādvratapradānaṃ ca śāpadānamabhūtpurā .. 16 ..
4.111.d:
कथं नारा यणोऽस्माकं भर्ता स्यादित्युपादिश ॥
तस्माद्व्रतप्रदानं च शापदानमभूत्पुरा ॥ 16 ॥
4.111.m: "Instruct [us] how Nārāyaṇa may become our husband." / For that reason there was both the bestowal of a vow and the bestowal of a curse long ago.

4.111.s:
śayyādvayapradānena madhumādhavamāsayoḥ ..
suvarṇopaskarotsargāddvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ ..
bhartā nārāyaṇo nūnaṃ bhaviṣyatyanyajanmani.. 17 ..
4.111.d:
शय्याद्वयप्रदानेन मधुमाधवमासयोः ॥
सुवर्णोपस्करोत्सर्गाद्द्वादश्यां शुक्लपक्षतः ॥
भर्ता नारायणो नूनं भविष्यत्यन्यजन्मनि॥ 17 ॥
4.111.m: "By the gift of two beds in the months of Madhu and Mādhava, / by dedicating golden utensils on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight, / Nārāyaṇa shall indeed be your husband in another birth.

4.111.s:
na kṛto yatpraṇāmo me rūpasaubhāgyamatsarāt ..
paraṃ pṛṣṭo'smi tenāśu viyogo vo bhaviṣyati ..
caurairapahṛtāḥ sarvā veśyātvaṃ samavāpsyatha .. 18 ..
4.111.d:
न कृतो यत्प्रणामो मे रूपसौभाग्यमत्सरात् ॥
परं पृष्टोऽस्मि तेनाशु वियोगो वो भविष्यति ॥
चौरैरपहृताः सर्वा वेश्यात्वं समवाप्स्यथ ॥ 18 ॥
4.111.m: Because no obeisance was made to me out of jealousy for beauty and fortune, / and I was questioned insolently, by that you will quickly have separation [from him]. / Carried away by thieves, all of you will attain the status of courtesans."

4.111.s:
evaṃ nāradaśāpena macchāpena ca sāṃpratam..
na kāryaḥ saṃbhramaḥ kaściddāsītvaṃ vo bhaviṣyati .. 19 ..
4.111.d:
एवं नारदशापेन मच्छापेन च सांप्रतम्॥
न कार्यः संभ्रमः कश्चिद्दासीत्वं वो भविष्यति ॥ 19 ॥
4.111.m: Thus by Nārada's curse and now by my curse, / no agitation should be felt; the state of female servants will be yours.

4.111.s:
idānīmapi yadvakṣye tacchraṇudhvaṃ varānanāḥ ..
purā devāsure yuddhe hateṣu śataśaḥ punaḥ ..
dānavāsurasainyeṣu rākṣaseṣu tatastataḥ .. 4.111.20 ..
4.111.d:
इदानीमपि यद्वक्ष्ये तच्छ्रणुध्वं वराननाः ॥
पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे हतेषु शतशः पुनः ॥
दानवासुरसैन्येषु राक्षसेषु ततस्ततः ॥ 4.111.20 ॥
4.111.m: Now listen also to what I shall say, O fair-faced ones! / Formerly, in the war between gods and asuras, when hundreds / of the dānava and asura armies and rākṣasas were slain on every side,

4.111.s:
teṣāṃ nārīsahasrāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ..
pariṇītāni yāni syurbalādbhuktāni yāni vai .. 21 ..
4.111.d:
तेषां नारीसहस्राणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥
परिणीतानि यानि स्युर्बलाद्भुक्तानि यानि वै ॥ 21 ॥
4.111.m: their women, in hundreds and thousands, / who were married or who were enjoyed by force,

4.111.s:
tāni sarvāṇi deveśaḥ provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ ..
veśyādharmeṇa vartadhvamadhunā nṛpamaṃdire .. .22 ..
bhaktimatyo varārohāstadā devakuleṣu ca ..
rājānaḥ svāminaḥ stutyā brāhmaṇāśca bahuśrutāḥ .. 23 ..
4.111.d:
तानि सर्वाणि देवेशः प्रोवाच वदतां वरः ॥
वेश्याधर्मेण वर्तध्वमधुना नृपमंदिरे ॥ .22 ॥
भक्तिमत्यो वरारोहास्तदा देवकुलेषु च ॥
राजानः स्वामिनः स्तुत्या ब्राह्मणाश्च बहुश्रुताः ॥ 23 ॥
4.111.m: to all of them the Lord of the Gods, best of speakers, declared: / "Abide now in royal palaces according to the conduct of courtesans, / and full of devotion in temples, O women of lovely hips! / Kings are your masters, to be praised, and learned brāhmaṇas.

4.111.s:
teṣāṃ gṛheṣu tiṣṭhadhvaṃ sūtakaṃ cāpi tatsamam ..
bhaviṣyati ca saubhāgyaṃ sarvāsāmapi śaktitaḥ ..24...
4.111.d:
तेषां गृहेषु तिष्ठध्वं सूतकं चापि तत्समम् ॥
भविष्यति च सौभाग्यं सर्वासामपि शक्तितः ॥24॥।
4.111.m: Dwell in their houses; their impurity [of birth and death] is your own. / And good fortune will come to all according to their capacity.

4.111.s:
na caikasminratiḥ kāryā puruṣe dhanavarjite ..
anumānyaḥ prasādyaśca śulkado devavatsadā .. 25 ..
4.111.d:
न चैकस्मिन्रतिः कार्या पुरुषे धनवर्जिते ॥
अनुमान्यः प्रसाद्यश्च शुल्कदो देववत्सदा ॥ 25 ॥
4.111.m: Love must not be placed in a single man devoid of wealth. / The one who pays the fee should always be respected and gratified like a god.

4.111.s:
surūpo vā virūpo vā dravyaṃ tatra prayojanam ..
na tadvyatikramaḥ kāryo brahmahatyāmavāpnuyāt ..
na cāpi madyapābhiśca bhāvyaṃ kauṭilyabuddhibhiḥ ..26..
4.111.d:
सुरूपो वा विरूपो वा द्रव्यं तत्र प्रयोजनम् ॥
न तद्व्यतिक्रमः कार्यो ब्रह्महत्यामवाप्नुयात् ॥
न चापि मद्यपाभिश्च भाव्यं कौटिल्यबुद्धिभिः ॥26॥
4.111.m: Handsome or ugly, money is the purpose there. / There should be no violation of that, [otherwise] one would incur [the sin of] killing a brāhmaṇa. / And you must not drink alcohol or have crooked minds.

4.111.s:
yaḥ kaścicchulkamādāya gṛhameṣyati vaḥ sadā ..
niśchadmanaivāpahāryaṃ tatsarvaṃ daṃbhavarjitam .. 27 ..
4.111.d:
यः कश्चिच्छुल्कमादाय गृहमेष्यति वः सदा ॥
निश्छद्मनैवापहार्यं तत्सर्वं दंभवर्जितम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.111.m: Whoever will always come to your house offering a fee, / all that must be taken from him without deceit, free from hypocrisy.

4.111.s:
vyabhicāro na kartavyaḥ svāminā saha karhicit..
rūpayauvanadarpeṇa dhanalobhena vā punaḥ .28..
4.111.d:
व्यभिचारो न कर्तव्यः स्वामिना सह कर्हिचित्॥
रूपयौवनदर्पेण धनलोभेन वा पुनः .28॥
4.111.m: Transgression must never be committed against the master, / through the pride of beauty and youth, or through greed for wealth.

4.111.s:
dāsī bhūtvā ca yā kācidvyabhicāraṃ karoti ca ..
patinā saha pāpiṣṭhā pāpiṣṭhāṃ yātyadhogatim..29..
4.111.d:
दासी भूत्वा च या काचिद्व्यभिचारं करोति च ॥
पतिना सह पापिष्ठा पापिष्ठां यात्यधोगतिम्॥29॥
4.111.m: Having become a female servant, whichever woman commits adultery / against her master, the very sinful one goes to the most sinful low destiny.

4.111.s:
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca puṇye'hni samupasthite ..
gobhūhiraṇyadhānyāni pradeyāni ca śaktitaḥ..4.111.30..
4.111.d:
देवतानां पितॄणां च पुण्येऽह्नि समुपस्थिते ॥
गोभूहिरण्यधान्यानि प्रदेयानि च शक्तितः॥4.111.30॥
4.111.m: When a sacred day for the gods and the ancestors arrives, / cattle, land, gold, and grain should be given according to one's means,

4.111.s:
brāhmaṇebhyo varārohāḥ kāryāṇi vacanāni ca ..
yaccāpyanyadvrataṃ samyagupadekṣyāmi tattvataḥ. 31 ..
4.111.d:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो वरारोहाः कार्याणि वचनानि च ॥
यच्चाप्यन्यद्व्रतं सम्यगुपदेक्ष्यामि तत्त्वतः। 31 ॥
4.111.m: to brāhmaṇas, O women of lovely hips, and their words are to be obeyed. / And as for the other votive observance, I shall properly instruct [you] in its true nature.

4.111.s:
avicāreṇa sarvābhiranuṣṭheyaṃ ca tatpunaḥ ..
saṃsārottāraṇāyālametadvedavido viduḥ .. 32 ..
yadā sūryadine prāpte puṣyo vā sa punarvasuḥ ..31..
4.111.d:
अविचारेण सर्वाभिरनुष्ठेयं च तत्पुनः ॥
संसारोत्तारणायालमेतद्वेदविदो विदुः ॥ 32 ॥
यदा सूर्यदिने प्राप्ते पुष्यो वा स पुनर्वसुः ॥31॥
4.111.m:
And that should be performed again without hesitation by all [of you]. / The knowers of the Vedas know this to be sufficient for crossing over saṃsāra.
When Sunday has arrived, with Puṣya or Punarvasu [nakṣatra],

4.111.s: bhavetsarvauṣadhisnānaṃ samyaṅnārī samācaret .. 33 ..
4.111.d: भवेत्सर्वौषधिस्नानं सम्यङ्नारी समाचरेत् ॥ 33 ॥
4.111.m: the woman should properly perform a bath with all herbs.

4.111.s:
tadā pañcaśarasyāpi saṃnidhātṛtvameṣyati ..
arcayetpuṇḍarīkākṣamanaṅgasyāpi kīrtanam..34...
4.111.d:
तदा पञ्चशरस्यापि संनिधातृत्वमेष्यति ॥
अर्चयेत्पुण्डरीकाक्षमनङ्गस्यापि कीर्तनम्॥34॥।
4.111.m: Then the presence of the Five-Arrowed One will also arrive. / She should worship the Lotus-Eyed One, reciting also [the names] of the Bodiless One.

4.111.s:
kāmāya pādau saṃpūjya jaṃghe vai mohakāriṇe..
meḍhraṃ kadarpanidhaye kaṭiṃ prītiyuje namaḥ .. 35 ..
4.111.d:
कामाय पादौ संपूज्य जंघे वै मोहकारिणे॥
मेढ्रं कदर्पनिधये कटिं प्रीतियुजे नमः ॥ 35 ॥
4.111.m: Having worshipped the feet for Kāma, the shanks indeed for the Deluder, / the male organ for the Store of Love, the waist [with] "Homage to the One United with Delight!"

4.111.s:
nābhiṃ saukhyasamudrāya vāmanāya tathodaram..
hṛdayaṃ hṛdayeśāya stanāvāhlādakāriṇe .. 36 ..
4.111.d:
नाभिं सौख्यसमुद्राय वामनाय तथोदरम्॥
हृदयं हृदयेशाय स्तनावाह्लादकारिणे ॥ 36 ॥
4.111.m: The navel for the Ocean of Happiness, the belly likewise for the Dwarf, / the heart for the Lord of the Heart, the breasts for the Delighter,

4.111.s:
utkaṃṭhāyeti vai kaṃṭhamāsyamānandajāya ca..
vāmāṃsaṃ puṣpacāpāya puṣpabāṇāya dakṣiṇam .. 37 ..
4.111.d:
उत्कंठायेति वै कंठमास्यमानन्दजाय च॥
वामांसं पुष्पचापाय पुष्पबाणाय दक्षिणम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.111.m: the throat [with] "For Longing!", the mouth for the One Born of Bliss, / the left shoulder for the Flower-Bowed, the right for the Flower-Arrowed,

4.111.s:
namo'nantāya vai mauliṃ vilolāyeti ca dhvajam..
sarvātmane śirastadvaddevasya pūjayet..38..
4.111.d:
नमोऽनन्ताय वै मौलिं विलोलायेति च ध्वजम्॥
सर्वात्मने शिरस्तद्वद्देवस्य पूजयेत्॥38॥
4.111.m: the diadem with "Homage to Ananta!", and the banner with "To the Trembling One!", / similarly she should worship the head for the Universal Soul of the god.

4.111.s:
namaḥ śrīpataye tārkṣyadhvajāṃkuśadharāya ca..
gadine pītavastrāya śaṃkhine cakriṇe namaḥ..
namo nārāyaṇāyeti kāmadevātmane namaḥ ..39..
4.111.d:
नमः श्रीपतये तार्क्ष्यध्वजांकुशधराय च॥
गदिने पीतवस्त्राय शंखिने चक्रिणे नमः॥
नमो नारायणायेति कामदेवात्मने नमः ॥39॥
4.111.m: "Homage to the Lord of Śrī, the bearer of the Garuḍa banner and the goad, / to the mace-bearer, the one clad in yellow garments, the conch-bearer, the discus-bearer, homage! / Homage to Nārāyaṇa, homage to the soul of the God of Love!"

4.111.s:
namaḥ śāṃtyai namaḥ prītyai namo ratyai namaḥ śriye ..
namaḥ puṣṭyai namastuṣṭyai namaḥ sarvārthadāya ca .. 4.111.40 ..
4.111.d:
नमः शांत्यै नमः प्रीत्यै नमो रत्यै नमः श्रिये ॥
नमः पुष्ट्यै नमस्तुष्ट्यै नमः सर्वार्थदाय च ॥ 4.111.40 ॥
4.111.m: "Homage to Peace, homage to Affection, homage to Pleasure, homage to Fortune, / homage to Nourishment, homage to Contentment, and homage to the Giver of All Goals!"

4.111.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya govindamanaṃgātmakamīśvaram ..
gaṃdhairmālyaistathā dhūpairnaivedyaiścaiva bhāminī .. 41 ..
4.111.d:
एवं संपूज्य गोविन्दमनंगात्मकमीश्वरम् ॥
गंधैर्माल्यैस्तथा धूपैर्नैवेद्यैश्चैव भामिनी ॥ 41 ॥
4.111.m: Having thus worshipped Govinda, the lord who is the Bodiless One himself, / with scents, garlands, incenses, and food offerings, the passionate woman,

4.111.s:
atra cāhūya dharmajñaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam ..
avyaṃgāvayavaṃ pūjya gaṃdhapuṣpādibhistathā .. 42 ..
4.111.d:
अत्र चाहूय धर्मज्ञं ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम् ॥
अव्यंगावयवं पूज्य गंधपुष्पादिभिस्तथा ॥ 42 ॥
4.111.m: summoning here a brāhmaṇa who knows dharma, is versed in the Vedas, / and has unimpaired limbs, having worshipped [him] with scents, flowers, and the like,

4.111.s:
śāleyataṃḍulaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam ..
tasmai viprāya sā dadyān mādhavaḥ prīyatāmiti .. 43 ..
4.111.d:
शालेयतंडुलप्रस्थं घृतपात्रेण संयुतम् ॥
तस्मै विप्राय सा दद्यान् माधवः प्रीयतामिति ॥ 43 ॥
4.111.m: she should give to that vipra a prastha of rice grains along with a vessel of ghee, / saying, "May Mādhava be pleased!"

4.111.s:
yatheṣṭāhārabhuktaṃ ca tameva dvijasattamam ..
ratyarthaṃ kāmadevo'yamiti citte'vadhārya ca .. 44 ..
4.111.d:
यथेष्टाहारभुक्तं च तमेव द्विजसत्तमम् ॥
रत्यर्थं कामदेवोऽयमिति चित्तेऽवधार्य च ॥ 44 ॥
4.111.m: And when that best of the twice-born has eaten food to his desire, / fixing in her mind: "This is the God of Love for the sake of delight,"

4.111.s:
yadyadicchati viprendrastattatkuryādvilāsinī ..
sarvabhāvena cātmānamarpayetsmitabhāṣiṇī .. 45 ..
4.111.d:
यद्यदिच्छति विप्रेन्द्रस्तत्तत्कुर्याद्विलासिनी ॥
सर्वभावेन चात्मानमर्पयेत्स्मितभाषिणी ॥ 45 ॥
4.111.m: whatever the lord of vipras desires, the charming woman should do all that, / and, speaking with a smile, she should surrender herself with her whole heart.

4.111.s:
evamādityavāreṇa sadā tadvratamācaret ..
taṃḍulaprasthadānaṃ ca yāvanmāsāṃstu dvādaśa .. 46 ..
4.111.d:
एवमादित्यवारेण सदा तद्व्रतमाचरेत् ॥
तंडुलप्रस्थदानं च यावन्मासांस्तु द्वादश ॥ 46 ॥
4.111.m: In this way she should always perform that votive observance on Sunday, / and the gift of a prastha of rice grains, for twelve months.

4.111.s:
tatastrayodaśe māsi saṃprāpte tasya bhāminī ..
viprasyopaskarairyuktāṃ śayyāṃ dadyādvilakṣaṇām .. 47 ..
4.111.d:
ततस्त्रयोदशे मासि संप्राप्ते तस्य भामिनी ॥
विप्रस्योपस्करैर्युक्तां शय्यां दद्याद्विलक्षणाम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.111.m: Then, when the thirteenth month has arrived, that lovely woman / should give to the brāhmaṇa an extraordinary bed equipped with furnishings,

4.111.s:
sopadhānakaviśrāmāṃ svāstarāvaraṇāṃ śubhām ..
dīpikopānahacchatrapādukāsanasaṃyutām .. 48 ..
4.111.d:
सोपधानकविश्रामां स्वास्तरावरणां शुभाम् ॥
दीपिकोपानहच्छत्रपादुकासनसंयुताम् ॥ 48 ॥
4.111.m: providing rest with pillows, having a fine mattress and covers, auspicious, / accompanied by a lamp, shoes, royal parasol, wooden sandals, and a seat;

4.111.s:
sapatnīkamalaṃkṛtya hemasūtrāṅgulīyakaiḥ ..
sūkṣmavastraiḥ sakaṭakairdhūpamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 49 ..
4.111.d:
सपत्नीकमलंकृत्य हेमसूत्राङ्गुलीयकैः ॥
सूक्ष्मवस्त्रैः सकटकैर्धूपमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥ 49 ॥
4.111.m: having adorned him together with his wife with gold thread, rings, / fine clothes, bracelets, incense, garlands, and ointments,

4.111.s:
kāmadevaṃ sapatnīkaṃ guḍakuṃbhopari sthitam ..
tāmrapātrāsanagataṃ haimanetrapaṭāvṛtam .. 4.111.50 ..
4.111.d:
कामदेवं सपत्नीकं गुडकुंभोपरि स्थितम् ॥
ताम्रपात्रासनगतं हैमनेत्रपटावृतम् ॥ 4.111.50 ॥
4.111.m: [she should give] Kāmadeva together with his wife, set upon a jar of raw sugar, / resting on a copper vessel as seat, veiled in cloth with golden thread,

4.111.s:
sakāṃsyabhājanopetamikṣudaṇḍasamanvitam ..
dadyādetena maṃtreṇa tathaikāṃ gāṃ payasvinīm .. 51 ..
4.111.d:
सकांस्यभाजनोपेतमिक्षुदण्डसमन्वितम् ॥
दद्यादेतेन मंत्रेण तथैकां गां पयस्विनीम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.111.m: accompanied by a bell-metal vessel, together with stalks of sugar cane, / and likewise a single milch cow, with this mantra:

4.111.s:
yathāṃtaraṃ na paśyāmi kāmakeśavayoḥ sadā ..
tathaiva sarvakāmāptirastu viṣṇo sadā mama .. 52 ..
4.111.d:
यथांतरं न पश्यामि कामकेशवयोः सदा ॥
तथैव सर्वकामाप्तिरस्तु विष्णो सदा मम ॥ 52 ॥
4.111.m: "Just as I always see no difference between Kāma and Keśava, / so let there always be the attainment of all my desires, O Viṣṇu!

4.111.s:
yathā na kāminīdehātprayāti tava keśava ..
tathāpi mama deveśa śarīrasthaṃ patiṃ kuru ..
tathaiva kāñcanaṃ devaṃ prati gṛhṇandvijottamaḥ .. 53 ..
4.111.d:
यथा न कामिनीदेहात्प्रयाति तव केशव ॥
तथापि मम देवेश शरीरस्थं पतिं कुरु ॥
तथैव काञ्चनं देवं प्रति गृह्णन्द्विजोत्तमः ॥ 53 ॥
4.111.m: Just as [she] does not depart from the body of a passionate woman, O Keśava, / even so, O Lord of gods, make my husband abide in my body!" / In that very way, the best of the twice-born, accepting the golden god,

4.111.s:
ka idaṃ ko'dātkasmā adātkāmaḥ kāmāyādātkāmo dātā kāmaḥ pratigrahītā kāmam̐ samudramāviśamaitatta-iti vaidikamantramīrayet' ..
ko'dāditi paṭhenmantraṃ dhyāyaṃścetasi mādhavam ..
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya visṛjeddvijapuṅgavam ..
śayyāsanādikaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇasya gṛhaṃ nayet .. 54 ..
4.111.d:
क इदं कोऽदात्कस्मा अदात्कामः कामायादात्कामो दाता कामः प्रतिग्रहीता कामम्̐ समुद्रमाविशमैतत्त-इति वैदिकमन्त्रमीरयेत्' ॥
कोऽदादिति पठेन्मन्त्रं ध्यायंश्चेतसि माधवम् ॥
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य विसृजेद्द्विजपुङ्गवम् ॥
शय्यासनादिकं सर्वं ब्राह्मणस्य गृहं नयेत् ॥ 54 ॥
4.111.m: should utter the Vedic mantra: "Who gave this? To whom did he give? Desire gave to desire; desire is the giver, desire the receiver; I have entered desire, the ocean; let this be yours!" / He should recite the mantra beginning with "Who gave?", meditating in his heart on Mādhava. / Then, having circumambulated him, she should dismiss the best of the twice-born. / She should carry the bed, seat, and other [gifts] all to the brāhmaṇa's house.

4.111.s:
tataḥprabhṛti yo'nyopi ratyarthaṃ gṛhamāgataḥ ..
sa samyaksūryavāreṇa samaṃ pūjyo yathecchayā .. 55 ..
4.111.d:
ततःप्रभृति योऽन्योपि रत्यर्थं गृहमागतः ॥
स सम्यक्सूर्यवारेण समं पूज्यो यथेच्छया ॥ 55 ॥
4.111.m: From that time forward, whichever other [man] comes to her house for sexual pleasure / is to be honoured properly according to his wish, exactly like on a Sunday.

4.111.s:
evamekaṃ dvijaṃ śāṃtaṃ purāṇajñaṃ vicakṣaṇam ..
tamarcayeta ca sadā aparaṃ vā tadājñayā .. 56 ..
4.111.d:
एवमेकं द्विजं शांतं पुराणज्ञं विचक्षणम् ॥
तमर्चयेत च सदा अपरं वा तदाज्ञया ॥ 56 ॥
4.111.m: In this way, she should always worship one serene twice-born, learned in the Purāṇas and discerning, / or another by his command.

4.111.s:
na prāpnoti tadā vighnaṃ garbhasūtakajaṃ kvacit ..
daivaṃ vā mānuṣaṃ vā syāduparāgeṇa vā tataḥ .. 57 ..
4.111.d:
न प्राप्नोति तदा विघ्नं गर्भसूतकजं क्वचित् ॥
दैवं वा मानुषं वा स्यादुपरागेण वा ततः ॥ 57 ॥
4.111.m: Then she never meets with an obstacle born of pregnancy or childbirth, / whether divine or human, or arising from an eclipse.

4.111.s:
sādhāranaṣṭapaśuvadyathāśaktyā samāpayet ..
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ veśyādharmamaśeṣataḥ .. 58 ..
4.111.d:
साधारनष्टपशुवद्यथाशक्त्या समापयेत् ॥
एतद्वः कथितं सर्वं वेश्याधर्ममशेषतः ॥ 58 ॥
4.111.m: She should complete [it] to the best of her ability, like one whose domestic animal is ordinary and undamaged. / All this has been declared to you, the duty of a courtesan in full.

4.111.s:
puruhūtena yatproktaṃ dānuvīṣu tato mayā ..
tadidaṃ ca vrataṃ sarvaṃ bhavatīṣu prakāśitam .. 59 ..
4.111.d:
पुरुहूतेन यत्प्रोक्तं दानुवीषु ततो मया ॥
तदिदं च व्रतं सर्वं भवतीषु प्रकाशितम् ॥ 59 ॥
4.111.m: That which was proclaimed by Puruhūta among the Dānavī women, then by me / this entire vrata has been revealed to you,

4.111.s:
sarvapāpapraśamanamanaṃtaphaladāyakam ..
kalyāṇinīnāṃ kathitaṃ kurudhvaṃ tadvarānanāḥ .. 4.111.60 ..
4.111.d:
सर्वपापप्रशमनमनंतफलदायकम् ॥
कल्याणिनीनां कथितं कुरुध्वं तद्वराननाः ॥ 4.111.60 ॥
4.111.m: which pacifies all sins and bestows endless fruit; / it has been spoken for women of good fortune. Undertake it, O fair-faced women!

4.111.s:
etatpārtha mayā pūrvaṃ gopīnāṃ tu prakāśitam ..
purāṇaṃ dharmasarvasvaṃ veśyājanasukhapradam .. 61 ..
4.111.d:
एतत्पार्थ मया पूर्वं गोपीनां तु प्रकाशितम् ॥
पुराणं धर्मसर्वस्वं वेश्याजनसुखप्रदम् ॥ 61 ॥
4.111.m: This was revealed formerly by me, O son of Pṛthā, to the cowherdesses— / the ancient essence of duty that bestows happiness upon the class of courtesans.

4.111.s:
karoti yā'śeṣamakhaṇḍametatkalyāṇinī mādhavalokasaṃsthā ..
sā pūjitā devagaṇairaśeṣairānandakṛtsthānamupaiti viṣṇoḥ .. 62 .. ..
vṛntākavratavidhivarṇanam
4.111.d:
करोति याऽशेषमखण्डमेतत्कल्याणिनी माधवलोकसंस्था ॥
सा पूजिता देवगणैरशेषैरानन्दकृत्स्थानमुपैति विष्णोः ॥ 62 ॥ ॥
वृन्ताकव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
4.111.m:
The auspicious woman who performs this without omission and unbroken, dwelling in the world of Mādhava / and worshipped by the hosts of all the gods, goes to the joyful abode of Viṣṇu.
Description of the procedure for the Aubergine Vrata

4.111.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athāto vṛṃtākavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ..
saṃvatsaraṃ ca ṣaṇmāsāṃstrīnmāsānvā na bhakṣayet ..
atha bharaṇyāṃ maghāyāṃ vā ekarātropavāsaṃ kṛtvā sthaṃḍile devānāhūya gaṃdhadhūpapuṣpanaivedyadīpādinā pūjayet ..
darbhapāṇirgaṃdhodakenāvāhayet ..
yamarājānamāvāhayāmi .. kālamāvāhayāmi .. nīlamāvāhayāmi .. citraguptamāvāhayāmi .. vaivasvatamāvāhayāmi .. mṛtyumāvāhayāmi .. parameṣṭhinamāvāhayāmīti .. tatognimupasamādhāya tilājye juhuyāt ..
yamarājāya svāhā .. kālāya svāhā .. nīlāya svāhā .. citraguptāya svāhā .. vaivasvatāya svāhā .. mṛtyave svāhā .. parameṣṭhine svāheti .. agnirmūrdhetyāhutīstvaṣṭaśataṃ hutvā sviṣṭakṛtiṃ kṛtvā prāyaścittaṃ hutvā brāhmaṇaḥ svayameva karoti .. itareṣāmācāryaḥ..
atha sauvarṇaṃ vṛṃtākaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
kṛṣṇavṛṣabhaṃ gāṃ ca dadyāt ..
karṇaveṣṭāṃgulīyake cchatropānahau kṛṣṇayugaṃ kṛṣṇakaṃbalaṃ ca dadyāt..
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā āśiṣo vācayet ..
pauṃḍarīkāśvamedhaphalamavāpnoti ..
saptakoṭisahasrāṇi nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate ..
saptajanmāṃtaraṃ yāvadyamalokaṃ na paśyatītyāha bhagavānbaudhāyanaḥ ..
vṛṃtākamapratihatāntarahemasiddhaṃ dadyāddvijāya ghṛtatakrasamanvitaṃ yaḥ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaramāsamekaṃ yāmyaṃ na paśyati puraṃ puruṣaḥ kadācit .. 1 .. ..
4.111.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथातो वृंताकविधिं व्याख्यास्यामः ॥
संवत्सरं च षण्मासांस्त्रीन्मासान्वा न भक्षयेत् ॥
अथ भरण्यां मघायां वा एकरात्रोपवासं कृत्वा स्थंडिले देवानाहूय गंधधूपपुष्पनैवेद्यदीपादिना पूजयेत् ॥
दर्भपाणिर्गंधोदकेनावाहयेत् ॥
यमराजानमावाहयामि ॥ कालमावाहयामि ॥ नीलमावाहयामि ॥ चित्रगुप्तमावाहयामि ॥ वैवस्वतमावाहयामि ॥ मृत्युमावाहयामि ॥ परमेष्ठिनमावाहयामीति ॥ ततोग्निमुपसमाधाय तिलाज्ये जुहुयात् ॥
यमराजाय स्वाहा ॥ कालाय स्वाहा ॥ नीलाय स्वाहा ॥ चित्रगुप्ताय स्वाहा ॥ वैवस्वताय स्वाहा ॥ मृत्यवे स्वाहा ॥ परमेष्ठिने स्वाहेति ॥ अग्निर्मूर्धेत्याहुतीस्त्वष्टशतं हुत्वा स्विष्टकृतिं कृत्वा प्रायश्चित्तं हुत्वा ब्राह्मणः स्वयमेव करोति ॥ इतरेषामाचार्यः॥
अथ सौवर्णं वृंताकं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
कृष्णवृषभं गां च दद्यात् ॥
कर्णवेष्टांगुलीयके च्छत्रोपानहौ कृष्णयुगं कृष्णकंबलं च दद्यात्॥
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयित्वा आशिषो वाचयेत् ॥
पौंडरीकाश्वमेधफलमवाप्नोति ॥
सप्तकोटिसहस्राणि नाकपृष्ठे महीयते ॥
सप्तजन्मांतरं यावद्यमलोकं न पश्यतीत्याह भगवान्बौधायनः ॥
वृंताकमप्रतिहतान्तरहेमसिद्धं दद्याद्द्विजाय घृततक्रसमन्वितं यः॥
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमासमेकं याम्यं न पश्यति पुरं पुरुषः कदाचित् ॥ 1 ॥ ॥
4.111.m: The Holy Lord said: / Now therefore we shall explain the rule for the aubergine. / For a year, or six months, or three months, one should not eat [it]. / Then, on the constellation Bharaṇī or Maghā, having fasted for one night and summoned the gods onto a raised ground, he should worship them with fragrance, incense, flowers, food offerings, lamps, and so on. / Holding darbha grass in hand, he should invoke them with perfumed water: / "I invoke Yamarāja; I invoke Kāla; I invoke Nīla; I invoke Citragupta; I invoke Vaivasvata; I invoke Mṛtyu; I invoke Parameṣṭhin." Then, having established the fire, he should make oblations of sesame and clarified butter: / "Svāhā to Yamarāja; svāhā to Kāla; svāhā to Nīla; svāhā to Citragupta; svāhā to Vaivasvata; svāhā to Mṛtyu; svāhā to Parameṣṭhin." Having offered one hundred and eight oblations with [the verse] "Agni is the head", having made the sviṣṭakṛt oblation, and having offered the expiatory oblation, a brāhmaṇa performs it himself; for others, the ācārya does so. / Then he should present a golden aubergine to the brāhmaṇa. / He should give a black bull and a cow; / he should give ear-rings, rings, a royal parasol and shoes, a pair of black garments, and a black blanket. / Having fed brāhmaṇas, he should have them pronounce blessings. / He obtains the fruit of the Pauṇḍarīka and horse sacrifices; / he is glorified on the back of heaven for seventy thousand crores [of years]; / he does not see the world of Yama for as long as seven future births; thus spoke the venerable Baudhāyana. / The man who gives to a twice-born an aubergine made of solid gold inside, accompanied by clarified butter and buttermilk, / having performed the vrata for a year or a single month, never sees the city of Yama.

4.111.s: grahanakṣatravratavarṇanam
4.111.d: ग्रहनक्षत्रव्रतवर्णनम्
4.111.m: Description of the Planet and Constellation Vrata

4.113.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ hyetaduttamam ..
yena lakṣmīnirvṛtistu puṣṭiścaivopajāyate .. 1 ..
4.113.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम् ॥
येन लक्ष्मीनिर्वृतिस्तु पुष्टिश्चैवोपजायते ॥ 1 ॥
4.113.m: The Holy Lord said: / Now therefore I shall declare this supreme secret, / by which fortune, happiness, and prosperity arise,

4.113.s:
sarve grahāḥ sadā saumyā jāyaṃte yena pāṃḍava ..
ādityavāre hastena pūrvaṃ gṛhya vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 2 ..
4.113.d:
सर्वे ग्रहाः सदा सौम्या जायंते येन पांडव ॥
आदित्यवारे हस्तेन पूर्वं गृह्य विचक्षणः ॥ 2 ॥
4.113.m: by which all planets always become gentle, O son of Pāṇḍu. / First having taken [the vow] on a Sunday under the Hasta constellation, the wise man,

4.113.s:
naktoktavidhinā sarvaṃ kuryātpūjāṃ tathā raveḥ ..
pratyakṣaṃ sapta naktāni kṛtvā bhaktiparo naraḥ .. 3 ..
4.113.d:
नक्तोक्तविधिना सर्वं कुर्यात्पूजां तथा रवेः ॥
प्रत्यक्षं सप्त नक्तानि कृत्वा भक्तिपरो नरः ॥ 3 ॥
4.113.m: in accordance with the rule spoken for the nocturnal meal, should perform all worship of the Sun. / Having personally performed seven nocturnal meals, the man devoted to devotion,

4.113.s:
tatastu saptame prāpte kuryādbrāhmaṇavācanam ..
bhāskaraṃ sarvasauvarṇaṃ kṛtvā yatnena mānavaḥ .. 4 ..
4.113.d:
ततस्तु सप्तमे प्राप्ते कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणवाचनम् ॥
भास्करं सर्वसौवर्णं कृत्वा यत्नेन मानवः ॥ 4 ॥
4.113.m: then, when the seventh has arrived, should perform the recitation of blessings by brāhmaṇas. / The man, having diligently made a Sun completely of gold,

4.113.s:
tāmrapātre sthāpayitvā raktapuṣpaiḥ prapūjya ca ..
raktavastrayugacchannaṃ chatropānadyugānvitam .. 5 ..
4.113.d:
ताम्रपात्रे स्थापयित्वा रक्तपुष्पैः प्रपूज्य च ॥
रक्तवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं छत्रोपानद्युगान्वितम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.113.m: placing it in a copper vessel, and having worshipped it with red flowers, / covered with a pair of red garments, accompanied by a pair consisting of a royal parasol and shoes,

4.113.s:
ghṛtena snapanaṃ kṛtvā laḍḍukānvinivedya ca ..
maṃtreṇānena viduṣe brāhmaṇāyopapādayet .. 6 ..
4.113.d:
घृतेन स्नपनं कृत्वा लड्डुकान्विनिवेद्य च ॥
मंत्रेणानेन विदुषे ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् ॥ 6 ॥
4.113.m: having bathed it with clarified butter, and having offered sweetmeat balls, / should present it to a learned brāhmaṇa with this mantra:

4.113.s:
ādideva namastubhyaṃ saptasapte divākara ..
tvaṃ rave tārayasvāsmāna'smātsaṃsārasāgarāt .. 7 ..
4.113.d:
आदिदेव नमस्तुभ्यं सप्तसप्ते दिवाकर ॥
त्वं रवे तारयस्वास्मानऽस्मात्संसारसागरात् ॥ 7 ॥
4.113.m: "O Primal God, praise be to you, O maker of day, whose horses are seven! / O Sun, carry us across this ocean of worldly existence!"

4.113.s:
kṛtenānena rājendra bhavedārogyamuttamam ..
dravyasaṃpatsutaprāptiriti paurāṇikā viduḥ .. 8 ..
4.113.d:
कृतेनानेन राजेन्द्र भवेदारोग्यमुत्तमम् ॥
द्रव्यसंपत्सुतप्राप्तिरिति पौराणिका विदुः ॥ 8 ॥
4.113.m: When this is performed, O king of kings, there will be excellent health, / abundance of wealth, and attainment of sons; thus the Purāṇa-knowers understand.

4.113.s:
avisaṃvādinī ceyaṃ śāntipuṣṭipradā nṛṇām..
tadvaccitrāsu saṃgṛhya somavāraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 9 ..
4.113.d:
अविसंवादिनी चेयं शान्तिपुष्टिप्रदा नृणाम्॥
तद्वच्चित्रासु संगृह्य सोमवारं विचक्षणः ॥ 9 ॥
4.113.m: And this [observance] does not fail, bestowing peace and prosperity upon men. / Likewise, having taken [the vow] on a Monday under the Citrā constellation, the wise man,

4.113.s:
saptame ca tataḥ prāpte dattvā brāhmaṇabhojanam ..
kāṃsyabhājanasaṃsthaṃ vā rājataṃ rājate'tha vā .. 4.113.10 ..
4.113.d:
सप्तमे च ततः प्राप्ते दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणभोजनम् ॥
कांस्यभाजनसंस्थं वा राजतं राजतेऽथ वा ॥ 4.113.10 ॥
4.113.m: and then, when the seventh has arrived, having given food to brāhmaṇas, / having placed King Soma, either of bell-metal or of silver, in a silver vessel,

4.113.s:
pātre kṛtvā somarājaṃ śvetavastrāvaguṃṭhitam ..
pādukopānahacchatrabhājanāsanasaṃyutam .. 11 ..
4.113.d:
पात्रे कृत्वा सोमराजं श्वेतवस्त्रावगुंठितम् ॥
पादुकोपानहच्छत्रभाजनासनसंयुतम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.113.m: veiled in white cloth, / accompanied by sandals, shoes, a royal parasol, a vessel, and a seat,

4.113.s:
dadhyannaśikharaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
maṃtreṇānena rājendra taṃ śṛṇuṣva vadāmi te .. 12 ..
4.113.d:
दध्यन्नशिखरं दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र तं शृणुष्व वदामि ते ॥ 12 ॥
4.113.m: Having offered a heap of curd-rice, he should present it to a brāhmaṇa / with this mantra, O king of kings; listen to it, I recite it to you:

4.113.s:
śrīmahādevajāvallī puṣpagokṣīrapāṃḍura ..
soma saumyo bhavāsmākaṃ sarvadā hyuttamottama .. .. 13 ..
4.113.d:
श्रीमहादेवजावल्ली पुष्पगोक्षीरपांडुर ॥
सोम सौम्यो भवास्माकं सर्वदा ह्युत्तमोत्तम ॥ ॥ 13 ॥
4.113.m: “O thou born of Śrī Mahādeva, pale as a flowering jasmine vine and cow's milk! / O Soma, be gentle and auspicious to us, ever supreme among the best!”

4.113.s:
evaṃ kṛte mahārāja somastuṣṭiprado bhavet ..
bhavaṃti tuṣṭe'trisute sarve sānugrahā grahāḥ .. 14 ..
4.113.d:
एवं कृते महाराज सोमस्तुष्टिप्रदो भवेत् ॥
भवंति तुष्टेऽत्रिसुते सर्वे सानुग्रहा ग्रहाः ॥ 14 ॥
4.113.m: When this is done, O great king, Soma becomes one who grants satisfaction; / when the son of Atri is pleased, all the planets become gracious.

4.113.s:
svātyāmaṃgārakaṃ gṛhya kṣapayennaktabhojanaḥ ..
saptame tvatha saṃprāpte sthāpitaṃ tāmrabhājane .. 19 ..
4.113.d:
स्वात्यामंगारकं गृह्य क्षपयेन्नक्तभोजनः ॥
सप्तमे त्वथ संप्राप्ते स्थापितं ताम्रभाजने ॥ 19 ॥
4.113.m: Taking Aṅgāraka under the Svātī [asterism], one should pass the time eating only a nocturnal meal; / but when the seventh arrives, placed in a copper vessel,

4.113.s:
raktavastrayugacchannaṃ kuṃkumenānulepanam ..
naivedyaṃ haṃtakāraṃ ca pūjya dhūpākṣatādibhiḥ .. 16 ..
4.113.d:
रक्तवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं कुंकुमेनानुलेपनम् ॥
नैवेद्यं हंतकारं च पूज्य धूपाक्षतादिभिः ॥ 16 ॥
4.113.m: covered with a pair of red garments, anointed with saffron, / with an offering of food and an oblation of food, worshiped with incense, unhusked barley-grains and the like,

4.113.s:
maṃtreṇānena taṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine ..
kujanmaprabhavo'pi tvaṃ maṃgalaḥ paṭhyase budhaiḥ ..
amaṃgalaṃ nihatyāśu sarvadā yaccha maṃgalam .. 17 ..
4.113.d:
मंत्रेणानेन तं दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने ॥
कुजन्मप्रभवोऽपि त्वं मंगलः पठ्यसे बुधैः ॥
अमंगलं निहत्याशु सर्वदा यच्छ मंगलम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.113.m: with this mantra one should give him to a householder brāhmaṇa: / ‘Though born of the earth, you are called auspicious by the wise; / swiftly striking down inauspiciousness, grant auspiciousness at all times!’

4.113.s:
viśākhāsu budhaṃ gṛhya sapta naktānyathācaret ..
budhaṃ hemamayaṃ kṛtvā sthāpitaṃ kāṃsyabhājane .. 18 ..
4.113.d:
विशाखासु बुधं गृह्य सप्त नक्तान्यथाचरेत् ॥
बुधं हेममयं कृत्वा स्थापितं कांस्यभाजने ॥ 18 ॥
4.113.m: Taking Budha under the Viśākhā [asterism], one should observe seven nocturnal meals; / having fashioned Budha out of gold, placed in a bell-metal vessel,

4.113.s:
śuklavastrayugacchannaṃ śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
guḍaudanopahāraṃ tu brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 19 ..
4.113.d:
शुक्लवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥
गुडौदनोपहारं तु ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 19 ॥
4.113.m: covered with a pair of white cloths, with white garlands and unctions, / one should present an offering of jaggery-rice to a brāhmaṇa:

4.113.s:
budhaḥ sadbuddhijanano bodhadaḥ sarvadā nṛṇām ..
tattvāvabodhaṃ kuru me rājaputra namonamaḥ .. 4.113.20 ..
4.113.d:
बुधः सद्बुद्धिजननो बोधदः सर्वदा नृणाम् ॥
तत्त्वावबोधं कुरु मे राजपुत्र नमोनमः ॥ 4.113.20 ॥
4.113.m: “Budha is the generator of good intellect, ever the granter of understanding to men; / grant me realization of reality, O prince, salutations, salutations!”

4.113.s:
anurādhāsvathācāryaṃ devānāṃ pūjya bhaktitaḥ ..
pūrvoktakramayogena sapta naktānyathācaret .. 21 ..
4.113.d:
अनुराधास्वथाचार्यं देवानां पूज्य भक्तितः ॥
पूर्वोक्तक्रमयोगेन सप्त नक्तान्यथाचरेत् ॥ 21 ॥
4.113.m: Then, having devoutly worshiped the teacher of the gods under the Anurādhā [asterism], / one should observe seven nocturnal meals according to the rule declared before.

4.113.s:
haimaṃ hemamaye pātre sthāpayitvā bṛhaspatim ..
pītāṃbarayugacchannaṃ pītayajñopavītinam .. 22 ..
4.113.d:
हैमं हेममये पात्रे स्थापयित्वा बृहस्पतिम् ॥
पीतांबरयुगच्छन्नं पीतयज्ञोपवीतिनम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.113.m: Having placed a golden Bṛhaspati into a golden vessel, / covered with a pair of yellow garments, wearing a yellow sacred thread,

4.113.s:
pādukācchatrasahitaṃ sadaṃḍaṃ sakamaṇḍalum ..
saṃpūjya puṣpanikarairdīpadhūpākṣatādibhiḥ .. 23 ..
4.113.d:
पादुकाच्छत्रसहितं सदंडं सकमण्डलुम् ॥
संपूज्य पुष्पनिकरैर्दीपधूपाक्षतादिभिः ॥ 23 ॥
4.113.m: accompanied by wooden sandals and an umbrella, together with a staff and water-pot, / having worshiped him with heaps of flowers, lamps, incense, unhusked barley-grains and the like,

4.113.s:
khaṇḍakhādyopahāraiśca dvijāya pratipādayet ..
dharmaśāstrārthaśāstrajña jñānavijñānapāraga ..
agādhabuddhigāṃbhīrya devācārya namo'stu te .. 24 ..
4.113.d:
खण्डखाद्योपहारैश्च द्विजाय प्रतिपादयेत् ॥
धर्मशास्त्रार्थशास्त्रज्ञ ज्ञानविज्ञानपारग ॥
अगाधबुद्धिगांभीर्य देवाचार्य नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 24 ॥
4.113.m: and with food offerings of sugar candies, he should give it to a twice-born: / ‘O knower of the treatises on dharma and polity, gone to the further shore of knowledge and science! / O teacher of the gods, whose intellect is deep and unfathomable, praise be to you!’

4.113.s:
śukraṃ jyeṣṭhāsu saṃgṛhya kṣapayennaktabhojanaiḥ ..
pūrvoktakramayogena dvijasaṃtarpaṇena ca .. 25 ..
4.113.d:
शुक्रं ज्येष्ठासु संगृह्य क्षपयेन्नक्तभोजनैः ॥
पूर्वोक्तक्रमयोगेन द्विजसंतर्पणेन च ॥ 25 ॥
4.113.m: Taking Śukra under the Jyeṣṭhā [asterism], one should pass the time with nocturnal meals, / following the procedure stated before and by gratifying twice-borns.

4.113.s:
saptame tvatha saṃprāpte sauvarṇaṃ kārayecchubham ..
raupye vā vaṃśapātre vā sthāpayitvā bhṛgoḥ sutam .. 26 ..
4.113.d:
सप्तमे त्वथ संप्राप्ते सौवर्णं कारयेच्छुभम् ॥
रौप्ये वा वंशपात्रे वा स्थापयित्वा भृगोः सुतम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.113.m: When the seventh arrives, he should have an auspicious golden [image] made; / having placed the son of Bhṛgu in a silver or bamboo vessel,

4.113.s:
saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā śvetavastravilepanaiḥ ..
agre tasya pradātavyaṃ pāyasaṃ ghṛta saṃyutam .. 27 ..
4.113.d:
संपूज्य परया भक्त्या श्वेतवस्त्रविलेपनैः ॥
अग्रे तस्य प्रदातव्यं पायसं घृत संयुतम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.113.m: worshiping him with supreme devotion with white garments and unguents, / one should place sweet milk-rice mixed with ghee before him.

4.113.s:
dadyādanena maṃtreṇa brāhmaṇāya vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
bhārgavo bhṛguputro'si śukra kramaviśārada .. 28 ..
4.113.d:
दद्यादनेन मंत्रेण ब्राह्मणाय विचक्षणः ॥
भार्गवो भृगुपुत्रोऽसि शुक्र क्रमविशारद ॥ 28 ॥
4.113.m: The wise person should give it to a brāhmaṇa with this mantra: / ‘You are Bhārgava, son of Bhṛgu, O Śukra, skilled in proper sequence!

4.113.s:
hatvā grahakṛtāndoṣānāyurārogyado bhava ..
mūlena sūryatanayaṃ gṛhītvā bharatarṣabha .. 29 ..
4.113.d:
हत्वा ग्रहकृतान्दोषानायुरारोग्यदो भव ॥
मूलेन सूर्यतनयं गृहीत्वा भरतर्षभ ॥ 29 ॥
4.113.m: Destroying the afflictions caused by the planets, be the giver of long life and health!’ / Taking the son of Sūrya under Mūla, O best of the Bharatas,

4.113.s:
tasmindine pūjanīyaṃ grahatritayamādarāt ..
śanaiścaraśca rāhuśca ketuśceti kramānnṛpa .. 4.113.30 ..
4.113.d:
तस्मिन्दिने पूजनीयं ग्रहत्रितयमादरात् ॥
शनैश्चरश्च राहुश्च केतुश्चेति क्रमान्नृप ॥ 4.113.30 ॥
4.113.m: on that day the triad of planets is to be worshiped with reverence: / Śanaiścara, Rāhu, and Ketu in order, O king.

4.113.s:
homaṃ tilaghṛtaiḥ kuryādgṛhanāmnā tu maṃtravit ..
arkaḥ palāśakhadirau hyapāmārgotha pippalaḥ .. 31 ..
4.113.d:
होमं तिलघृतैः कुर्याद्गृहनाम्ना तु मंत्रवित् ॥
अर्कः पलाशखदिरौ ह्यपामार्गोथ पिप्पलः ॥ 31 ॥
4.113.m: One knowing the mantras should perform a fire-oblation with sesame seeds and ghee using the names of the planets; / arka, palāśa, and khadira, apāmārga, and then pippala,

4.113.s:
uduṃbaraśamīdūrvākuśāśca samidhaḥ kramāt ..
ekaikasya tvaṣṭaśatamaṣṭāviṃśatireva vā .. 32 ..
4.113.d:
उदुंबरशमीदूर्वाकुशाश्च समिधः क्रमात् ॥
एकैकस्य त्वष्टशतमष्टाविंशतिरेव वा ॥ 32 ॥
4.113.m: udumbara, śamī, dūrvā grass, and kuśa grass are the firewood sticks in order; / one hundred and eight or else twenty-eight of each one,

4.113.s:
hotavyaṃ madhusarpibhyāṃ dadhnā vā pāyasena vā ..
saptame tvatha saṃprāpte naktaṃ sūryasutasya tu .. 33 ..
4.113.d:
होतव्यं मधुसर्पिभ्यां दध्ना वा पायसेन वा ॥
सप्तमे त्वथ संप्राप्ते नक्तं सूर्यसुतस्य तु ॥ 33 ॥
4.113.m: one should offer into the fire with honey and ghee, or with curds, or with milk-rice. / When the seventh arrives, the nocturnal meal is for the son of the Sun;

4.113.s:
grahāstrayo'pi kartavyā rājam̐llohamayāḥ śubhāḥ ..
vratāṃte sarvataścaitānsauvarṇānvātha kārayet .. 34 ..
4.113.d:
ग्रहास्त्रयोऽपि कर्तव्या राजम्̐ल्लोहमयाः शुभाः ॥
व्रतांते सर्वतश्चैतान्सौवर्णान्वाथ कारयेत् ॥ 34 ॥
4.113.m: all three planets, O king, should be made auspicious and of iron; / or else, at the end of the votive observance, one may make them completely of gold.

4.113.s:
kṛṣṇavastrayugaṃ dadyādekaikasya kramānnṛpa ..
mṛganābhyā samālabhya kṛśarānvinivedya ca .. 35 ..
4.113.d:
कृष्णवस्त्रयुगं दद्यादेकैकस्य क्रमान्नृप ॥
मृगनाभ्या समालभ्य कृशरान्विनिवेद्य च ॥ 35 ॥
4.113.m: One should give a pair of black garments to each one in order, O king, / smearing them with musk, and having offered dishes of rice and lentils.

4.113.s:
homāvasāne sarvaṃ tadbrāhmaṇāyopapādayet ..
śanaiścara namaste'stu namo'stu rāhave tathā .. 36 ..
4.113.d:
होमावसाने सर्वं तद्ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् ॥
शनैश्चर नमस्तेऽस्तु नमोऽस्तु राहवे तथा ॥ 36 ॥
4.113.m: At the conclusion of the fire-oblation, he should present all that to a brāhmaṇa: / ‘Salutations to you, O Śanaiścara; salutations to Rāhu likewise,

4.113.s:
ketave ca namastubhyaṃ sarvaśāṃtiprado bhava ..
evaṃ kṛte bhavedyastu tannibodha nareśvara .. 37 ..
4.113.d:
केतवे च नमस्तुभ्यं सर्वशांतिप्रदो भव ॥
एवं कृते भवेद्यस्तु तन्निबोध नरेश्वर ॥ 37 ॥
4.113.m: and salutations to you, O Ketu; be the grantors of all peace!’ / Understand, O ruler of men, what happens when this is done:

4.113.s:
yadi bhaumo ravisuto bhāskaro rāhuṇā saha ..
ketuśca mūrdhni tiṣṭhaṃti sarve pīḍākarā grahāḥ .. 38 ..
4.113.d:
यदि भौमो रविसुतो भास्करो राहुणा सह ॥
केतुश्च मूर्ध्नि तिष्ठंति सर्वे पीडाकरा ग्रहाः ॥ 38 ॥
4.113.m: Even if Bhauma, the son of the Sun, and the Sun together with Rāhu / and Ketu stand at the crown of the head, all planets causing torment,

4.113.s: anena kṛtamātreṇa sarve śāmyaṃtyupadravāḥ .. 39 ..
4.113.d: अनेन कृतमात्रेण सर्वे शाम्यंत्युपद्रवाः ॥ 39 ॥
4.113.m: by merely performing this, all afflictions are pacified.

4.113.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute rājansadābhaktisamanvitaḥ ..
tasya sānugrahā sarve yacchanti vijayaṃ sukham ..4.113.40..
4.113.d:
एवं यः कुरुते राजन्सदाभक्तिसमन्वितः ॥
तस्य सानुग्रहा सर्वे यच्छन्ति विजयं सुखम् ॥4.113.40॥
4.113.m: One who does thus, O king, endowed with constant devotion, / to him all the planets, becoming gracious, grant victory and happiness.

4.113.s:
yaścaitacchraṇuyātkalpaṃ grahāṇāṃ paṭhate'pi vā ..
tasya sānugrahā sarve śāṃtiṃ yacchaṃti nānyathā ..41..
4.113.d:
यश्चैतच्छ्रणुयात्कल्पं ग्रहाणां पठतेऽपि वा ॥
तस्य सानुग्रहा सर्वे शांतिं यच्छंति नान्यथा ॥41॥
4.113.m: And whoever hears this procedure of the planets or recites it, / to him all of them, becoming gracious, grant peace, not otherwise.

4.113.s:
śanaiścaraṃ rāhuketū lohapātreṣu vinyaset ..
kṛṣṇāgaruḥ smṛto dhūpo dakṣiṇā cātmaśaktitaḥ ..42..
4.113.d:
शनैश्चरं राहुकेतू लोहपात्रेषु विन्यसेत् ॥
कृष्णागरुः स्मृतो धूपो दक्षिणा चात्मशक्तितः ॥42॥
4.113.m: He should place Śanaiścara, Rāhu, and Ketu in iron vessels; / black agarwood is declared as the incense, and a priestly fee according to one’s means.

4.113.s:
sūryaṃ vidhuṃ kuja budhau guruśukrasaurīnhastādikarkṣasahitānuditakrameṇa..
saṃpūjya hemaghaṭitāndvijapuṅgavāya dattvā pumāngrahagaṇena na pīḍyate'tra ..43..
śanaiścaravratavarṇanam
4.113.d:
सूर्यं विधुं कुज बुधौ गुरुशुक्रसौरीन्हस्तादिकर्क्षसहितानुदितक्रमेण॥
संपूज्य हेमघटितान्द्विजपुङ्गवाय दत्त्वा पुमान्ग्रहगणेन न पीड्यतेऽत्र ॥43॥
शनैश्चरव्रतवर्णनम्
4.113.m:
Having worshiped the Sun, Moon, Mars, and Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, and Saturn, along with their asterisms beginning with Hasta in the declared order, / and having given them fashioned of gold to an eminent twice-born, a man is not afflicted in this world by the host of planets.
Description of the Votive Observance of Śanaiścara

4.114.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
purā tretāyuge pārtha nāvarṣatpākaśāsanaḥ ..
kathaṃcidanayādrājñastasya rāṣṭre samaṃtataḥ .. 1 ..
4.114.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
पुरा त्रेतायुगे पार्थ नावर्षत्पाकशासनः ॥
कथंचिदनयाद्राज्ञस्तस्य राष्ट्रे समंततः ॥ 1 ॥
4.114.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Formerly, in the Tretāyuga, O Pārtha, Pākaśāsana did not rain, / somehow due to the king's injustice, in his kingdom all around.

4.114.s:
tato rāṣṭraṃ kṣudhāviṣṭaṃ babhūvātīva dāruṇam ..
pataṃgamūṣikākīrṇaṃ coravyālabhayākulam .. 2 ..
4.114.d:
ततो राष्ट्रं क्षुधाविष्टं बभूवातीव दारुणम् ॥
पतंगमूषिकाकीर्णं चोरव्यालभयाकुलम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.114.m: Then the kingdom, seized by hunger, became exceedingly terrible, / swarming with locusts and mice, agitated by fear of thieves and wild beasts.

4.114.s:
tasminghorākule kāle sapatnīkaḥ sabālakaḥ ..
kauśikaḥ svagṛhaṃ tyaktvā pararāṣṭramagācchanaiḥ .. 3 ..
4.114.d:
तस्मिन्घोराकुले काले सपत्नीकः सबालकः ॥
कौशिकः स्वगृहं त्यक्त्वा परराष्ट्रमगाच्छनैः ॥ 3 ॥
4.114.m: In that dreadfully afflicted time, with his wife and child, / the sage Kauśika left his home and went slowly to another kingdom.

4.114.s:
mārge'tha gacchatā tena kauśikena maharṣiṇā ..
tyaktaḥ sa bālako hyeko durbharaṃ ca kuṭumbakam .. 4 ..
4.114.d:
मार्गेऽथ गच्छता तेन कौशिकेन महर्षिणा ॥
त्यक्तः स बालको ह्येको दुर्भरं च कुटुम्बकम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.114.m: Then, as he was traveling along the road, that great sage Kauśika / abandoned that one child, his family being hard to support.

4.114.s:
tasminkāle viśeṣeṇa kṣīṇennauṣadhi saṃcaye ..
kṛtvātinirghṛṇaṃ karma gato'sau kauśiko muniḥ .. 5 ..
4.114.d:
तस्मिन्काले विशेषेण क्षीणेन्नौषधि संचये ॥
कृत्वातिनिर्घृणं कर्म गतोऽसौ कौशिको मुनिः ॥ 5 ॥
4.114.m: At that time especially, when stores of grain and medicinal plants were depleted, / having done an exceedingly cruel deed, that sage Kauśika departed.

4.114.s:
so'pi bālo rudandīno diśo vīkṣya sthitaḥ pathi ..
utthāya pippalasyādhaḥ phalānyattuṃ pracakrame .. 6 ..
4.114.d:
सोऽपि बालो रुदन्दीनो दिशो वीक्ष्य स्थितः पथि ॥
उत्थाय पिप्पलस्याधः फलान्यत्तुं प्रचक्रमे ॥ 6 ॥
4.114.m: That boy too, weeping miserably and looking at the directions, stayed on the road; / getting up, he proceeded to eat fruits beneath a pippala tree.

4.114.s:
kūpe jalaṃ papau nityaṃ tatraivāśramamaṃḍale ..
kṛtvā samyak sthito raudraṃ tepe ca vipulaṃ tapaḥ .. 7 ..
4.114.d:
कूपे जलं पपौ नित्यं तत्रैवाश्रममंडले ॥
कृत्वा सम्यक् स्थितो रौद्रं तेपे च विपुलं तपः ॥ 7 ॥
4.114.m: He constantly drank water from a well, right there in the circle of the hermitage; / staying firmly established, he practiced formidable and immense austerity.

4.114.s:
athājagāma bhagavānnārado vedapāragaḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā dīnavadanaṃ kṣudhārtaṃ dvijapotakam .. 8 ..
4.114.d:
अथाजगाम भगवान्नारदो वेदपारगः ॥
तं दृष्ट्वा दीनवदनं क्षुधार्तं द्विजपोतकम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.114.m: Then the venerable Nārada, who has crossed to the further shore of the Vedas, came there; / seeing that young twice-born boy with a miserable face, afflicted by hunger,

4.114.s:
dayayā tasya saṃskāraṃ cakre mauṃjyādibaṃdhanam ..
vedānadhyāpayāmāsa sarahasyapadakramān ..
dadau ca vaiṣṇavaṃ maṃtraṃ dvādaśākṣaramityuta .. 9 ..
4.114.d:
दयया तस्य संस्कारं चक्रे मौंज्यादिबंधनम् ॥
वेदानध्यापयामास सरहस्यपदक्रमान् ॥
ददौ च वैष्णवं मंत्रं द्वादशाक्षरमित्युत ॥ 9 ॥
4.114.m: out of compassion he performed his life-cycle rites, the tying of the mauñjī belt and so forth; / he taught him the Vedas, with the secret teachings and the Pada and Krama methods of recitation, / and he gave him the Vaiṣṇava mantra consisting of twelve syllables.

4.114.s:
vedābhyāsaratasyāsya viṣṇudhyānaparasya ca ..
pratyahaṃ pippalādasya viṣṇuḥ pratyakṣatāṃ yayau .. 4.114.10 ..
4.114.d:
वेदाभ्यासरतस्यास्य विष्णुध्यानपरस्य च ॥
प्रत्यहं पिप्पलादस्य विष्णुः प्रत्यक्षतां ययौ ॥ 4.114.10 ॥
4.114.m:
To this Pippalāda, devoted to the study of the Veda
and intent on meditating upon Viṣṇu, Viṣṇu became visible every day.

4.114.s:
vainateyasamārūḍho nīlotpaladalacchaviḥ ..
caturbhujaḥ pītavāsāḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ .. 11 ..
4.114.d:
वैनतेयसमारूढो नीलोत्पलदलच्छविः ॥
चतुर्भुजः पीतवासाः शंखचक्रगदाधरः ॥ 11 ॥
4.114.m:
Mounted upon the son of Vinatā, with the complexion of a blue lotus petal,
four-armed, wearing yellow garments, bearing conch, discus, and mace.

4.114.s:
sa uvāca tadā tuṣṭo varaṃ brūhi yami cchasi ..
tacchrutvā nāradamukhaṃ samālokya śiśustadā ..
nāradenāpyanujñāto jñānavidyāmayācata .. 12 ..
4.114.d:
स उवाच तदा तुष्टो वरं ब्रूहि यमि च्छसि ॥
तच्छ्रुत्वा नारदमुखं समालोक्य शिशुस्तदा ॥
नारदेनाप्यनुज्ञातो ज्ञानविद्यामयाचत ॥ 12 ॥
4.114.m:
He said then, being pleased, “State the boon that you desire.”
Hearing that, the child, having looked upon the face of Nārada,
then, permitted also by Nārada, asked for the knowledge of spiritual wisdom.

4.114.s:
dattvā jñānaṃ sopadeśaṃ yogābhyāsaṃ ca nirmalam ..
nāgārigamano viṣṇustatraivāntarhitobhavat .. 13 ..
4.114.d:
दत्त्वा ज्ञानं सोपदेशं योगाभ्यासं च निर्मलम् ॥
नागारिगमनो विष्णुस्तत्रैवान्तर्हितोभवत् ॥ 13 ॥
4.114.m:
Having imparted spiritual knowledge together with instruction, and the spotless practice of yoga,
Viṣṇu, whose vehicle is the enemy of serpents, vanished right there.

4.114.s:
tato rājanmahājñānī maharṣiḥ sa śiśustadā ..
nāradaṃ paripapraccha kenāhaṃ pīḍito mune .. 14 ..
4.114.d:
ततो राजन्महाज्ञानी महर्षिः स शिशुस्तदा ॥
नारदं परिपप्रच्छ केनाहं पीडितो मुने ॥ 14 ॥
4.114.m:
Then, O king, that child, a great sage endowed with supreme knowledge,
inquired of Nārada: “By whom have I been tormented, O sage?

4.114.s:
graheṇāgrahabhūtena bālarūpo'pi duḥkhita. ..
na me pitā na me mātā jīvitosmyatipīḍayā .. 15 ..
4.114.d:
ग्रहेणाग्रहभूतेन बालरूपोऽपि दुःखित॥।
न मे पिता न मे माता जीवितोस्म्यतिपीडया ॥ 15 ॥
4.114.m:
Though in the form of a boy, I am afflicted by a planet turned into a non-grasping foe.
I have no father, nor have I a mother; I am alive through extreme torment.

4.114.s:
brāhmaṇyaṃ bhavatā dattaṃ daivānmama dvijottama ..
etacchrutvā śiśorvākyaṃ kathayāmāsa nāradaḥ .. 16 ..
4.114.d:
ब्राह्मण्यं भवता दत्तं दैवान्मम द्विजोत्तम ॥
एतच्छ्रुत्वा शिशोर्वाक्यं कथयामास नारदः ॥ 16 ॥
4.114.m:
Brahminhood was bestowed upon me by you through fate, O best of the twice-born.”
Hearing this speech of the child, Nārada spoke:

4.114.s:
śanaiścareṇa krūreṇa graheṇa tvaṃ hi pīḍitaḥ ..
pīḍitaśca samasto'pi deśoyaṃ maṃdacāriṇā .. 17 ..
4.114.d:
शनैश्चरेण क्रूरेण ग्रहेण त्वं हि पीडितः ॥
पीडितश्च समस्तोऽपि देशोयं मंदचारिणा ॥ 17 ॥
4.114.m:
“Indeed, you are tormented by the cruel planet Śanaiścara,
and this entire country too has been afflicted by the slow-moving one.

4.114.s:
tenaitatte phalaṃ prāptaṃ saiṣaḥ sauriḥ śanaiścaraḥ ..
prajvalannatidarpeṇa sphuratīva nabhastale .. 18 ..
4.114.d:
तेनैतत्ते फलं प्राप्तं सैषः सौरिः शनैश्चरः ॥
प्रज्वलन्नतिदर्पेण स्फुरतीव नभस्तले ॥ 18 ॥
4.114.m:
By him has this consequence been obtained by you; that very son of Sūrya, Śanaiścara,
blazing with excessive pride, seems to flash in the vault of the sky.”

4.114.s:
evamuktaḥ śiśuḥ krodhātprajajvāleva pāvakaḥ ..
ālokya gaganādbhūmau pātayāmāsa vai śanim ..
patamāno gireḥ śṛṃgādbhagnaḥ khaṃjo babhūva ha .. 19 ..
4.114.d:
एवमुक्तः शिशुः क्रोधात्प्रजज्वालेव पावकः ॥
आलोक्य गगनाद्भूमौ पातयामास वै शनिम् ॥
पतमानो गिरेः शृंगाद्भग्नः खंजो बभूव ह ॥ 19 ॥

4.114.s:
dharaṇyāṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāskarātmajamāturam ..
narīnarti bhujakṣepairnārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ .. 4.114.20 ..
4.114.d:
धरण्यां पतितं दृष्ट्वा भास्करात्मजमातुरम् ॥
नरीनर्ति भुजक्षेपैर्नारदो हृष्टमानसः ॥ 4.114.20 ॥
4.114.m:
Seeing the son of the Sun fallen upon the earth and in distress,
Nārada, his mind delighted, danced repeatedly with gestures of his arms.

4.114.s: harṣāddevānathāhūya darśayāmāsa taṃ śanim .. 21 ..
4.114.d: हर्षाद्देवानथाहूय दर्शयामास तं शनिम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.114.m: Then, having summoned the gods out of joy, he showed them that Śani.

4.114.s:
atha devāstathā prāptā brahmarudrendrapāvakāḥ ..
śanaiḥ saṃśamayāsurūcuścedamṛṣiṃ ca tam .. 22 ..
4.114.d:
अथ देवास्तथा प्राप्ता ब्रह्मरुद्रेन्द्रपावकाः ॥
शनैः संशमयासुरूचुश्चेदमृषिं च तम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.114.m:
Then the gods, Brahmā, Rudra, Indra, and Pāvaka, having arrived in that manner,
slowly pacified [him] and spoke thus to that sage:

4.114.s:
svasti te'stu mahābhāga pippalāda mahāmune ..
bhadraṃ te'tra kṛtaṃ nāma nāradena maharṣiṇā ..
anvarthayuktaṃ viprendra jīvitaṃ piplādanāt .. 23 ..
4.114.d:
स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु महाभाग पिप्पलाद महामुने ॥
भद्रं तेऽत्र कृतं नाम नारदेन महर्षिणा ॥
अन्वर्थयुक्तं विप्रेन्द्र जीवितं पिप्लादनात् ॥ 23 ॥
4.114.m:
“Hail to you, O highly fortunate one, O great sage Pippalāda!
An auspicious name was given to you here by the great sage Nārada,
endowed with literal meaning, O best of brahmins, for your life was maintained by eating pippala fruit.

4.114.s:
bhagavanpippalānyattvā jīvito'si yato mune ..
tataśca pippalādeti khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyasi .. 24 ..
4.114.d:
भगवन्पिप्पलान्यत्त्वा जीवितोऽसि यतो मुने ॥
ततश्च पिप्पलादेति ख्यातिं लोके गमिष्यसि ॥ 24 ॥
4.114.m:
O venerable one, since you lived by eating pippala fruits, O sage,
therefore you shall attain renown in the world as Pippalāda.

4.114.s: ye ca tvāṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti snātvā puṣpairmahāṛṣim ..25..
4.114.d: ये च त्वां पूजयिष्यंति स्नात्वा पुष्पैर्महाऋषिम् ॥25॥
4.114.m: And those who, having bathed, will worship you, the great sage, with flowers,

4.114.s:
ihāśrame samabhyetya rūpesminbhaktibhāvitāḥ ..
saptajanmāntaraṃ yāvatputrapautrānugāminaḥ..26..
4.114.d:
इहाश्रमे समभ्येत्य रूपेस्मिन्भक्तिभाविताः ॥
सप्तजन्मान्तरं यावत्पुत्रपौत्रानुगामिनः॥26॥
4.114.m:
having arrived here at this hermitage, filled with devotion toward this form,
up to the extent of seven future births, extending to their sons and grandsons,

4.114.s:
na teṣāṃ bādhikā satyaṃ grahapīḍā bhaviṣyati ..
smariṣyaṃtīha ye ca tvāṃ pippalādeti nāmataḥ ..27..
4.114.d:
न तेषां बाधिका सत्यं ग्रहपीडा भविष्यति ॥
स्मरिष्यंतीह ये च त्वां पिप्पलादेति नामतः ॥27॥
4.114.m:
the affliction caused by planets will truly not torment them.
And those who will remember you here by the name of Pippalāda,

4.114.s:
teṣāṃ śanaiścara kṛtā pīḍā na prabhaviṣyati ..
kṣamasvāsya mahābhāga nirdoṣo'yaṃ grahāgraṇīḥ .. 28 ..
4.114.d:
तेषां शनैश्चर कृता पीडा न प्रभविष्यति ॥
क्षमस्वास्य महाभाग निर्दोषोऽयं ग्रहाग्रणीः ॥ 28 ॥
4.114.m:
to them no affliction wrought by Śanaiścara will prevail.
Forgive him, O highly fortunate one; this leader of the planets is blameless.

4.114.s:
caranvṛkṣaṃ śanaireṣa śubhāśubhaphalapradaḥ ..
hatasādhyā grahāścaite na bhavaṃti kadācana..29..
4.114.d:
चरन्वृक्षं शनैरेष शुभाशुभफलप्रदः ॥
हतसाध्या ग्रहाश्चैते न भवंति कदाचन॥29॥
4.114.m:
Moving slowly through the [zodiacal] tree, he dispenses good and evil fruits;
and these planets can never be subdued by force.

4.114.s:
balihomanamaskāraiḥ śāṃtiṃ yacchaṃti pūjitāḥ ..
ato'rthamasya divase snānamabhyaṃgapūrvakam ..4.114.30..
4.114.d:
बलिहोमनमस्कारैः शांतिं यच्छंति पूजिताः ॥
अतोऽर्थमस्य दिवसे स्नानमभ्यंगपूर्वकम् ॥4.114.30॥
4.114.m:
Worshipped with offerings, oblations, and acts of prostration, they grant peace.
Therefore, on his day, a bath preceded by an oil-massage

4.114.s:
kāryaṃ deyaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ tailamabhyaṃgahetave ..
yastu saṃvatsaraṃ yāvatprāpte śanidine naraḥ ..31..
4.114.d:
कार्यं देयं च विप्राणां तैलमभ्यंगहेतवे ॥
यस्तु संवत्सरं यावत्प्राप्ते शनिदिने नरः ॥31॥
4.114.m:
is to be performed, and oil should be given to brahmins for the purpose of anointing.
Moreover, the person who, for the duration of a year, when the day of Śani has arrived,

4.114.s:
tailaṃ dadāti viprāṇāṃ svaśaktyānyajanepi ca ..
tatassaṃvatsarasyāṃte prāpte tasya dinaṃ punaḥ .. 32 ..
4.114.d:
तैलं ददाति विप्राणां स्वशक्त्यान्यजनेपि च ॥
ततस्संवत्सरस्यांते प्राप्ते तस्य दिनं पुनः ॥ 32 ॥
4.114.m:
gives oil to brahmins, and also to other people according to his capacity,
then, at the end of the year, when his day has arrived once again,

4.114.s:
lohaissaṃghaṭitaṃ sauriṃ tailamadhye vinikṣipet ..
lohabhāṃḍakamadhyasthaṃ kṛṣṇavastrayugacchadam .. 33 ..
4.114.d:
लोहैस्संघटितं सौरिं तैलमध्ये विनिक्षिपेत् ॥
लोहभांडकमध्यस्थं कृष्णवस्त्रयुगच्छदम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.114.m:
should place the son of Sūrya fashioned from iron into the middle of the oil,
situated within an iron vessel, covered with a pair of black garments,

4.114.s:
kṛṣṇagodakṣiṇāyuktaṃ kṛṣṇakaṃbala śāyinam ..
tilatailena ca snānaṃ kṛṣṇapuṣpaiḥ supūjitam ..34..
4.114.d:
कृष्णगोदक्षिणायुक्तं कृष्णकंबल शायिनम् ॥
तिलतैलेन च स्नानं कृष्णपुष्पैः सुपूजितम् ॥34॥
4.114.m:
accompanied by a sacrificial fee of a black cow, resting on a black blanket;
and [having performed] a bath with sesame oil, properly worshipped with black flowers,

4.114.s:
kṛṣṇagaṃdhaiḥ kṛṣṇadhūpaiḥ kṛśarānnaistilaudanaiḥ ..
pūjayitvā sūryaputraṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 35 ..
4.114.d:
कृष्णगंधैः कृष्णधूपैः कृशरान्नैस्तिलौदनैः ॥
पूजयित्वा सूर्यपुत्रं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 35 ॥
4.114.m:
having worshipped the son of the Sun with black perfumes, black incenses, and dishes of kṛśarā and sesame rice,
he should present it to a brahmin,

4.114.s:
maṃtreṇānena brahmarṣe śannodevīti bhaktimān ..
itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ śṛṇu mantraṃ dvijottama .. 36 ..
4.114.d:
मंत्रेणानेन ब्रह्मर्षे शन्नोदेवीति भक्तिमान् ॥
इतरेषां तु वर्णानां शृणु मन्त्रं द्विजोत्तम ॥ 36 ॥
4.114.m:
with this mantra, O brahmin sage, full of devotion: ‘May the divine waters be for our welfare [śaṃ no devīḥ]...’
Now, hear the mantra for the other castes, O best of the twice-born:

4.114.s:
krūrāvalokanavaśādbhuvanaṃ nāśayiṣyati yo graho ruṣṭaḥ ..
tuṣṭo dhanakanakasukhaṃ dadāti sauriḥ śanaiścaraḥ pātu .. 37 ..
4.114.d:
क्रूरावलोकनवशाद्भुवनं नाशयिष्यति यो ग्रहो रुष्टः ॥
तुष्टो धनकनकसुखं ददाति सौरिः शनैश्चरः पातु ॥ 37 ॥
4.114.m:
‘Which planet, when enraged, destroys the world on account of his cruel glance,
[and] when pleased bestows wealth, gold, and happiness—may that son of Sūrya, Śanaiścara, protect [us].’

4.114.s:
yatpurā naṣṭarājyāya nalāya pradadau kila ..
svapne saurirnijaṃ mantraṃ śṛṇu kāmaphalapradam .. 38 ..
4.114.d:
यत्पुरा नष्टराज्याय नलाय प्रददौ किल ॥
स्वप्ने सौरिर्निजं मन्त्रं शृणु कामफलप्रदम् ॥ 38 ॥
4.114.m:
Hear the mantra granting the fruits of desires, which in ancient times, they say,
the son of Sūrya bestowed in a dream upon Nala, whose kingdom was lost:

4.114.s:
kroḍaṃ nīlāñjanaprakhyaṃ nīlavarṇasamasrajama ..
chāyāmārtaṃḍasaṃbhūtaṃ namasyāmi śanaiścaram .. 39 ..
4.114.d:
क्रोडं नीलाञ्जनप्रख्यं नीलवर्णसमस्रजम ॥
छायामार्तंडसंभूतं नमस्यामि शनैश्चरम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.114.m:
‘I bow to Śanaiścara, whose lap resembles blue collyrium, who wears a garland of blue colour,
who was born from Chāyā and Mārtaṇḍa.

4.114.s:
namo'rkaputrāya śanaiścarāya nīhāravarṇāṃjanamecakāya ..
śrutvā rahasyaṃ bhavakāmadaśca phalaprado me bhava sūryaputra .. 4.114.40 ..
4.114.d:
नमोऽर्कपुत्राय शनैश्चराय नीहारवर्णांजनमेचकाय ॥
श्रुत्वा रहस्यं भवकामदश्च फलप्रदो मे भव सूर्यपुत्र ॥ 4.114.40 ॥
4.114.m:
Homage to the son of Arka, to Śanaiścara, dark like collyrium with the colour of mist!
Having heard this secret, O granter of worldly desires, be the bestower of fruits upon me, O son of Sūrya!

4.114.s:
namo'stu pretarājāya kṛṣṇadehāya vai namaḥ ..
śanaiścarāya krūrāya śuddhabuddhipradāyine .. 41 ..
4.114.d:
नमोऽस्तु प्रेतराजाय कृष्णदेहाय वै नमः ॥
शनैश्चराय क्रूराय शुद्धबुद्धिप्रदायिने ॥ 41 ॥
4.114.m:
Homage be to the king of pretas; homage indeed to the one with a black body,
to Śanaiścara, the cruel one, the bestower of pure intellect!’

4.114.s:
ya ebhirnāmabhiḥ stauti tasya tuṣṭo bhavāmyaham ..
madīyaṃ tu bhayaṃ tasya svapne'pi na bhaviṣyati ..42..
4.114.d:
य एभिर्नामभिः स्तौति तस्य तुष्टो भवाम्यहम् ॥
मदीयं तु भयं तस्य स्वप्नेऽपि न भविष्यति ॥42॥
4.114.m:
‘Whoever praises [me] with these names, with him I am well pleased;
moreover, fear of me will not occur to him even in a dream.’

4.114.s:
evamūce śaniḥ pūrvamatastaṃ brāhmaṇe dadet ..
evametadvrataṃ vipra ye cariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ .. 43 ..
4.114.d:
एवमूचे शनिः पूर्वमतस्तं ब्राह्मणे ददेत् ॥
एवमेतद्व्रतं विप्र ये चरिष्यंति मानवाः ॥ 43 ॥
4.114.m:
Thus spoke Śani previously; therefore, one should give that [image] to a brahmin.
O brahmin, those human beings who will observe this vow in this manner,

4.114.s:
sthāvaresthāvare prāpte vatsaraṃ yāvadeva tu ..
teṣāṃ śānaiścarī pīḍā deśe'pi na bhaviṣyati .. 44 ..
4.114.d:
स्थावरेस्थावरे प्राप्ते वत्सरं यावदेव तु ॥
तेषां शानैश्चरी पीडा देशेऽपि न भविष्यति ॥ 44 ॥
4.114.m:
each and every Saturday as it arrives, for the duration of just one year,
to them affliction caused by Śanaiścara will not occur even in [their] country.”

4.114.s:
evamuktvā surāḥ sarve pratijagmuryathāgatam ..
śanaiścaro'pi svasthāne grahāṃte khe pratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 45 ..
4.114.d:
एवमुक्त्वा सुराः सर्वे प्रतिजग्मुर्यथागतम् ॥
शनैश्चरोऽपि स्वस्थाने ग्रहांते खे प्रतिष्ठितः ॥ 45 ॥
4.114.m:
Having spoken thus, all the gods returned whence they had come.
Śanaiścara too was established in his own place in the sky at the end of the planets.

4.114.s:
pippalādo'pi brahmajño brahmājñāṃ pratipālayan ..
śanaiścaraṃ tu saṃpūjya tuṣṭāva racitāñjaliḥ .. 46 ..
4.114.d:
पिप्पलादोऽपि ब्रह्मज्ञो ब्रह्माज्ञां प्रतिपालयन् ॥
शनैश्चरं तु संपूज्य तुष्टाव रचिताञ्जलिः ॥ 46 ॥
4.114.m:
Pippalāda too, the knower of Brahman, obeying the command of Brahmā,
having worshipped Śanaiścara, praised him with folded hands:

4.114.s:
koṇasthaḥ piṅgalo babhruḥ kṛṣṇo raudro'ntako yamaḥ ..
sauriḥ śanaiścaro modaḥ prīyatāṃ me grahottamaḥ ..47..
4.114.d:
कोणस्थः पिङ्गलो बभ्रुः कृष्णो रौद्रोऽन्तको यमः ॥
सौरिः शनैश्चरो मोदः प्रीयतां मे ग्रहोत्तमः ॥47॥
4.114.m:
“Situated in the corner, tawny, reddish-brown, black, fierce, the ender, Yama,
son of Sūrya, Śanaiścara, joy—may the best of planets be pleased with me!”

4.114.s:
śanaiścaramiti stutvā pippalādo mahāmuniḥ ..
khe prajvalanvimānastho dṛśyate'dyāpi mānavaiḥ ..48..
4.114.d:
शनैश्चरमिति स्तुत्वा पिप्पलादो महामुनिः ॥
खे प्रज्वलन्विमानस्थो दृश्यतेऽद्यापि मानवैः ॥48॥
4.114.m:
Having thus praised Śanaiścara, the great sage Pippalāda
is seen even today by human beings blazing in the sky, seated in a celestial chariot.

4.114.s:
idaṃ śanaiścarākhyānaṃ ye śroṣyanti samāhitāḥ ..
teṣāṃ kuruvaraśreṣṭha śaniḥ pīḍāṃ na dāsyati .. 49 ..
4.114.d:
इदं शनैश्चराख्यानं ये श्रोष्यन्ति समाहिताः ॥
तेषां कुरुवरश्रेष्ठ शनिः पीडां न दास्यति ॥ 49 ॥
4.114.m:
Those who, being composed, will listen to this narrative of Śanaiścara,
to them, O best of the Kurus, Śani will not cause affliction.

4.114.s:
kṛṣṇāyasena ghaṭitāṃ graharājamūrtiṃ lohe nidhāya kalaśe tilatailapūrṇe ..
yo brāhmaṇāya ravijaṃ pradadāti bhaktyā pīḍā śanaiścarakṛtā na hi bādhate tam .. 4.114.50 .. ..
ādityadinanaktavidhivarṇanam
4.114.d:
कृष्णायसेन घटितां ग्रहराजमूर्तिं लोहे निधाय कलशे तिलतैलपूर्णे ॥
यो ब्राह्मणाय रविजं प्रददाति भक्त्या पीडा शनैश्चरकृता न हि बाधते तम् ॥ 4.114.50 ॥ ॥
आदित्यदिननक्तविधिवर्णनम्
4.114.m:
Having placed an image of the king of planets fashioned from black iron into an iron pot filled with sesame oil,
he who gives the son of Ravi to a brahmin with devotion—affliction caused by Śanaiścara truly does not torment him.
Description of the rules for the nocturnal meal on the day of Āditya.

4.115.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
yadārogyakaraṃ puṃsāṃ yadanaṃtaphalapradam ..
vrataṃ tadbrūhi govinda sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..1..
4.115.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
यदारोग्यकरं पुंसां यदनंतफलप्रदम् ॥
व्रतं तद्ब्रूहि गोविन्द सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥1॥
4.115.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Tell me that votive observance, Govinda, which brings health to men, / which grants endless fruit, and destroys all sins.

4.115.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
yattadviśvātmano dhāma paraṃ brahma sanātanam ..
sūryāgnicandrarūpeṇa tattridhā jagati sthitam .. 2 ..
4.115.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
यत्तद्विश्वात्मनो धाम परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् ॥
सूर्याग्निचन्द्ररूपेण तत्त्रिधा जगति स्थितम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.115.m:
The holy Kṛṣṇa said:
That supreme eternal brahman, the light of the Universal Soul, / abides threefold in the world in the form of the sun, fire, and moon.

4.115.s:
tamārādhya pumānkiṃ na prāpnoti kurunandana ..
tasmādādityavāreṇa sadā naktāśano bhavet .. 3 ..
4.115.d:
तमाराध्य पुमान्किं न प्राप्नोति कुरुनन्दन ॥
तस्मादादित्यवारेण सदा नक्ताशनो भवेत् ॥ 3 ॥
4.115.m: By worshipping it, what does a man not obtain, son of Kuru? / Therefore, one should always take a nocturnal meal on Sunday.

4.115.s:
utpadyate yadā bhaktirbhānorupari śāśvatī ..
tadārabhya sadā kāryaṃ naktamādityavāsare .. 4 ..
4.115.d:
उत्पद्यते यदा भक्तिर्भानोरुपरि शाश्वती ॥
तदारभ्य सदा कार्यं नक्तमादित्यवासरे ॥ 4 ॥
4.115.m: When eternal devotion toward the sun arises, / beginning from then, a nocturnal meal should always be observed on Sunday.

4.115.s:
pūrvoktavidhinā caiva pūjayitvā dvijottamān ..
tato'stasamaye bhāno raktacandanapaṅkajam .. 5 ..
4.115.d:
पूर्वोक्तविधिना चैव पूजयित्वा द्विजोत्तमान् ॥
ततोऽस्तसमये भानो रक्तचन्दनपङ्कजम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.115.m: And having worshipped the best of brahmins according to the rule declared before, / then, at the time of the sun's setting, having drawn with red sandalwood / a twelve-petalled lotus,

4.115.s:
vilikhya dvādaśadalaṃ pūjya sūryeti pūrvataḥ ..
divākaraṃ tathāgneye vivasvatamataḥ param .. 6 ..
4.115.d:
विलिख्य द्वादशदलं पूज्य सूर्येति पूर्वतः ॥
दिवाकरं तथाग्नेये विवस्वतमतः परम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.115.m: one should worship, uttering 'Sūrya' in the east, / likewise Divākara in the southeast, and Vivasvat next;

4.115.s:
bhagaṃ tu nairṛte devaṃ varuṇaṃ paścime dale ..
mahendraṃ mārutadale ādityaṃ tu tathottare .. 7 ..
4.115.d:
भगं तु नैरृते देवं वरुणं पश्चिमे दले ॥
महेन्द्रं मारुतदले आदित्यं तु तथोत्तरे ॥ 7 ॥
4.115.m: the god Bhaga on the petal in the southwest, Varuṇa on the western petal, / Mahendra on the wind petal, and Āditya likewise in the north;

4.115.s:
śāṃtamīśānabhāge tu namaskāreṇa vinyaset..
karṇikāpūrvapatre tu sūryasya turagānnyaset .. 8 ..
4.115.d:
शांतमीशानभागे तु नमस्कारेण विन्यसेत्॥
कर्णिकापूर्वपत्रे तु सूर्यस्य तुरगान्न्यसेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.115.m: one should install Śānta in the northeast quarter with reverent salutation. / On the eastern petal of the pericarp one should place the sun's horses,

4.115.s:
dakṣiṇe yamanāmānaṃ mārtaṃḍaṃ paścime dale ..
uttareṇa raviṃ devaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu bhāskaram .. 9 ..
4.115.d:
दक्षिणे यमनामानं मार्तंडं पश्चिमे दले ॥
उत्तरेण रविं देवं कर्णिकायां तु भास्करम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.115.m: the one named Yama in the south, Mārtaṇḍa on the western petal, / the god Ravi in the north, and Bhāskara in the pericarp.

4.115.s:
arghyaṃ dadyāttataḥ pārtha satilāruṇacaṃdanam ..
phalākṣatayutaṃ tadvadimaṃ maṃtramudīrayet .. 4.115.10
4.115.d:
अर्घ्यं दद्यात्ततः पार्थ सतिलारुणचंदनम् ॥
फलाक्षतयुतं तद्वदिमं मंत्रमुदीरयेत् ॥ 4.115.10
4.115.m: Then, son of Pṛthā, one should offer an arghya endowed with sesamum and red sandalwood, / accompanied by fruits and unbroken grains, and recite this mantra:

4.115.s:
kālātmā sarvabhūtātmā vedātmā viśvatomukhaḥ..
yasmādagnīṃdurūpastvamataḥ pāhi prabhākara .. 11 ..
4.115.d:
कालात्मा सर्वभूतात्मा वेदात्मा विश्वतोमुखः॥
यस्मादग्नींदुरूपस्त्वमतः पाहि प्रभाकर ॥ 11 ॥
4.115.m: “O soul of time, soul of all beings, soul of the Vedas, facing in all directions! / Since you are embodied as fire and the moon, therefore protect me, O Light-Maker!

4.115.s:
agnimīle namastubhyamiṣe tvorje ca bhāskare..
agna āyāhi varada namaste jyotiṣāṃ pate..12..
4.115.d:
अग्निमीले नमस्तुभ्यमिषे त्वोर्जे च भास्करे॥
अग्न आयाहि वरद नमस्ते ज्योतिषां पते॥12॥
4.115.m: ‘I praise Agni!’ Salutation to you! ‘For food, for strength’ in the sun! / ‘Come, O Agni!’, giver of boons, salutation to you, lord of lights!”

4.115.s:
arghyaṃ dattvā visarjyātha niśi tailavivarjitam ..
bhuñjīta bhāvitamanā bhāskaraṃ saṃsmaranmuhuḥ ..13..
4.115.d:
अर्घ्यं दत्त्वा विसर्ज्याथ निशि तैलविवर्जितम् ॥
भुञ्जीत भावितमना भास्करं संस्मरन्मुहुः ॥13॥
4.115.m: Having offered the arghya, dismissed [the deity], and then at night abstaining from oil, / one should eat with a purified mind, recollecting the Sun repeatedly.

4.115.s:
prāktane'hni śanau caiva tailābhyaṃgaṃ vivarjayet ..
vatsarāṃte kārayitvā kāñcanaṃ kamalottamam .. 14 ..
4.115.d:
प्राक्तनेऽह्नि शनौ चैव तैलाभ्यंगं विवर्जयेत् ॥
वत्सरांते कारयित्वा काञ्चनं कमलोत्तमम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.115.m: On the preceding day, on Saturday, one should also avoid anointing with oil. / At the end of a year, having caused an excellent golden lotus to be made,

4.115.s: puruṣaṃ ca yathāśaktyā kārayeddvibhujaṃ tathā .. 15 ..
