4.115.d: पुरुषं च यथाशक्त्या कारयेद्द्विभुजं तथा ॥ 15 ॥
4.115.m: and, according to one's capacity, having also caused a two-armed image of the Man to be fashioned,

4.115.s:
suvarṇaśṛṃgīṃ kapilāṃ mahārghyāṃ raupyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ savatsām ..
pūrṇe guḍasyopari tāmrapātre nidhāya padmaṃ ca tato nidadhyāt ..9..
4.115.d:
सुवर्णशृंगीं कपिलां महार्घ्यां रौप्यखुरां कांस्यदोहां सवत्साम् ॥
पूर्णे गुडस्योपरि ताम्रपात्रे निधाय पद्मं च ततो निदध्यात् ॥9॥
4.115.m: and a precious brown cow with golden horns, silver hooves, a bronze milking-vessel, and accompanied by her calf— / having placed it on a copper vessel filled with molasses, one should then place the lotus on it.

4.115.s:
gāṃ kalpayitvā puruṣaṃ sapadmaṃ dadyādanekavratanāyakāya ..
avyaṃgarūpāya jitendriyāya kuṭuṃbine śuddhamanuddhatāya .. 17 ..
4.115.d:
गां कल्पयित्वा पुरुषं सपद्मं दद्यादनेकव्रतनायकाय ॥
अव्यंगरूपाय जितेन्द्रियाय कुटुंबिने शुद्धमनुद्धताय ॥ 17 ॥
4.115.m: Having arranged the cow, one should give the image of the Man together with the lotus to a leader of many votive observances, / an unmaimed, sense-controlled householder of pure mind and devoid of pride:

4.115.s:
namo'stu ṛksāmayajurvidhātre padmaprabodhāya jagatsavitre ..
trayīmayāya triguṇātmane ca trilokanāthāya namonamaste ..18..
4.115.d:
नमोऽस्तु ऋक्सामयजुर्विधात्रे पद्मप्रबोधाय जगत्सवित्रे ॥
त्रयीमयाय त्रिगुणात्मने च त्रिलोकनाथाय नमोनमस्ते ॥18॥
4.115.m: “Salutation be to the creator of the Ṛg, Sāma, and Yajur Vedas, the awakener of the lotus, progenitor of the universe! / Consisting of the triad, embodied as the three guṇas, and lord of the three worlds: salutation, salutation to you!”

4.115.s:
ityanena vidhānena varṣamekaṃ tu yo naraḥ ..
naktamādityavāreṇa kuryātsa nīrujo bhavet ..19..
4.115.d:
इत्यनेन विधानेन वर्षमेकं तु यो नरः ॥
नक्तमादित्यवारेण कुर्यात्स नीरुजो भवेत् ॥19॥
4.115.m: By this procedure, whatever man observes a nocturnal meal / on Sunday for one year, he becomes free from disease.

4.115.s:
dhanadhānyasamāyuktaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ ..
martye sthitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ sūryalokamavāpnuyāt .. 4.115.20 ..
4.115.d:
धनधान्यसमायुक्तः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः ॥
मर्त्ये स्थित्वा चिरं कालं सूर्यलोकमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 4.115.20 ॥
4.115.m: Endowed with wealth and grain, accompanied by sons and grandsons, / having dwelt for a long time on earth, he reaches the world of the sun.

4.115.s:
karmasaṃkṣayamavāpya pārthivaḥ śokaduḥkhabhayarogavarjitaḥ ..
syādamitrakulakālasaṃnibho dharmamūrtiramitaujasā yutaḥ .. 21 ..
4.115.d:
कर्मसंक्षयमवाप्य पार्थिवः शोकदुःखभयरोगवर्जितः ॥
स्यादमित्रकुलकालसंनिभो धर्ममूर्तिरमितौजसा युतः ॥ 21 ॥
4.115.m: Attaining the exhaustion of his past deeds, a king freed from sorrow, grief, fear, and disease, / would resemble death to the host of his foes, an embodiment of righteousness, endowed with boundless splendour.

4.115.s:
yā ca bhartṛgurudevatatparā vedamūrtidinanaktamācarat..
sāpi lokamamareśapūjitā yāti kau rava ravernna saṃśayaḥ .. 22 ..
4.115.d:
या च भर्तृगुरुदेवतत्परा वेदमूर्तिदिननक्तमाचरत्॥
सापि लोकममरेशपूजिता याति कौ रव रवेर्न्न संशयः ॥ 22 ॥
4.115.m: And any woman devoted to her husband, elders, and gods who performs the nocturnal meal of the Day of the Embodiment of the Vedas / also goes, honoured by the lord of the immortals, to the world of the sun, O Kuru; there is no doubt.

4.115.s:
yaḥ paṭhedatha śṛṇoti vā naraḥ paśyatītthamatha vānumodayet ..
so'pi śakrabhavane divaukasaiḥ kalpakoṭiśatamekamīḍyate . .. 23 .. ..
4.115.d:
यः पठेदथ शृणोति वा नरः पश्यतीत्थमथ वानुमोदयेत् ॥
सोऽपि शक्रभवने दिवौकसैः कल्पकोटिशतमेकमीड्यते ॥। 23 ॥ ॥
4.115.m: Whatever man recites this, or hears it, or sees it thus, or approves of it, / he too is praised by the dwellers of heaven in Śakra’s abode for a hundred crore of kalpas.

4.115.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāda ādityadinanaktavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ . .. 115 ..
saṃkrāntyudyāpanavarṇanam
4.115.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवाद आदित्यदिननक्तविधिवर्णनं नाम पञ्चदशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ॥। 115 ॥
संक्रान्त्युद्यापनवर्णनम्
4.115.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and fifteenth chapter, named ‘Description of the Rule for the Nocturnal Meal on Sunday’, in the conversation between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Concluding Ceremony of the Solstice and Equinox Observance

4.116.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athānyadapi te vacmi saṃkrāṃtyudyāpane phalam ..
yadakṣayaṃ paraṃ loke purāṇakavayo viduḥ .. 1 .
4.116.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथान्यदपि ते वच्मि संक्रांत्युद्यापने फलम् ॥
यदक्षयं परं लोके पुराणकवयो विदुः ॥ 1 ।
4.116.m:
The holy Kṛṣṇa said:
Now I shall tell you another fruit regarding the concluding ceremony of the saṃkrānti, / which ancient sages know to be imperishable and supreme in the world.

4.116.s:
viṣuve ayane vāpi saṃkrātivratamārabhet ..
pūrvedyurekabhaktena daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam .. 2 ..
4.116.d:
विषुवे अयने वापि संक्रातिव्रतमारभेत् ॥
पूर्वेद्युरेकभक्तेन दंतधावनपूर्वकम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.116.m: At the equinox or at the solstice, one should begin the saṃkrānti observance, / having taken a single meal on the previous day, preceded by cleansing the teeth.

4.116.s:
saṃkrāṃtivāsare prāpte tilaiḥ snānaṃ vidhīyate ..
abhisaṃkramaṇaṃ bhūmau candanenāṣṭapatrakam .. 3 ..
4.116.d:
संक्रांतिवासरे प्राप्ते तिलैः स्नानं विधीयते ॥
अभिसंक्रमणं भूमौ चन्दनेनाष्टपत्रकम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.116.m: When the day of the saṃkrānti has arrived, a bath with sesamum seeds is prescribed. / For the transit, on the ground, with sandalwood, an eight-petalled

4.116.s:
padmaṃ sakarṇikaṃ kuryāttasminnāvāhayedravim ..
karṇikāyāṃ nyasetsūryamādityaṃ pūrvatastataḥ .. 4 ..
4.116.d:
पद्मं सकर्णिकं कुर्यात्तस्मिन्नावाहयेद्रविम् ॥
कर्णिकायां न्यसेत्सूर्यमादित्यं पूर्वतस्ततः ॥ 4 ॥
4.116.m: lotus complete with a pericarp should be made; upon it one should invoke the sun. / In the pericarp one should install Sūrya, then Āditya in the east;

4.116.s:
namaḥ saptārciṣe'gneye yāmye ruṅmaṇḍalāya ca ..
namaḥ savitre nairṛtye varuṇaṃ vāruṇe yajet .. 5 ..
4.116.d:
नमः सप्तार्चिषेऽग्नेये याम्ये रुङ्मण्डलाय च ॥
नमः सवित्रे नैरृत्ये वरुणं वारुणे यजेत् ॥ 5 ॥
4.116.m: ‘Salutation to the Seven-Flamed One’ in the southeast, and to the Orb of Light in the south; / ‘Salutation to Savitṛ’ in the southwest, and one should worship Varuṇa in the west;

4.116.s:
saptasaptiṃ ca vāyavye pūjayedbhāsvatāṃ patim ..
mārtaṃḍamuttare viṣṇumīśāne vinyaseddale .. 6 ..
4.116.d:
सप्तसप्तिं च वायव्ये पूजयेद्भास्वतां पतिम् ॥
मार्तंडमुत्तरे विष्णुमीशाने विन्यसेद्दले ॥ 6 ॥
4.116.m: and worship the Seven-Steeded One, the lord of the luminaries, in the northwest; / one should place Mārtaṇḍa in the north, and Viṣṇu on the petal in the northeast.

4.116.s:
gandhamālyaphalairbhakṣyaiḥ sthaṃḍile pūjayettataḥ ..
candanodakapuṣpaistu dattvārghaṃ vinyasedbhuvi .. 7 ..
4.116.d:
गन्धमाल्यफलैर्भक्ष्यैः स्थंडिले पूजयेत्ततः ॥
चन्दनोदकपुष्पैस्तु दत्त्वार्घं विन्यसेद्भुवि ॥ 7 ॥
4.116.m: Then one should worship on the sacred ground with perfumes, garlands, fruits, and food offerings. / Having offered arghya with sandalwood water and flowers, one should place it on the ground:

4.116.s:
namaste viśvarūpāya viśvadhātre svayaṃbhuve ..
namonamaste varada ṛksāmayajuṣāṃ pate .. 8 ..
4.116.d:
नमस्ते विश्वरूपाय विश्वधात्रे स्वयंभुवे ॥
नमोनमस्ते वरद ऋक्सामयजुषां पते ॥ 8 ॥
4.116.m: “Salutation to you, all-formed, sustainer of all, self-existent! / Salutation, salutation to you, bestower of boons, lord of the Ṛg, Sāma, and Yajur Vedas!”

4.116.s:
anena vidhinā dattvā bhānave'rghyaṃ narottama ..
dvijāya sodakaṃ kumbhaṃ ghṛtapātraṃ hiraṇmayam .. 9 ..
4.116.d:
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा भानवेऽर्घ्यं नरोत्तम ॥
द्विजाय सोदकं कुम्भं घृतपात्रं हिरण्मयम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.116.m: Having offered arghya to the sun by this rule, O best of men, / a pot filled with water and a golden vessel of clarified butter to a brahmin,

4.116.s:
kamalaṃ ca yathāśaktyā kārayitvā nivedayeta..
vidhinānena kartavyaṃ māsi māsi narottama .. 4.116.10 ..
4.116.d:
कमलं च यथाशक्त्या कारयित्वा निवेदयेत॥
विधिनानेन कर्तव्यं मासि मासि नरोत्तम ॥ 4.116.10 ॥
4.116.m: and having caused a lotus to be fashioned according to one's capacity, one should present it. / By this rule it should be performed month after month, O best of men,

4.116.s:
ekabhuktāśanaiḥ puṃbhiḥ sarvametadyathāvidhi ..
ekasminnahni kartavyaṃ vatsarāṃtetha vā punaḥ .. 11 ..
4.116.d:
एकभुक्ताशनैः पुंभिः सर्वमेतद्यथाविधि ॥
एकस्मिन्नह्नि कर्तव्यं वत्सरांतेथ वा पुनः ॥ 11 ॥
4.116.m: by men who eat only a single meal, all this strictly according to the rule, / on a single day or else at the end of the year.

4.116.s:
kauṃteya tasminghṛtapāyasena saṃpūjya vahniṃ dvijapuṃgavāya ..
kumbhānpunardvādaśadhenuyuktāndaurgatyayuktaḥ kuśalāmathaikām .. 12 ..
4.116.d:
कौंतेय तस्मिन्घृतपायसेन संपूज्य वह्निं द्विजपुंगवाय ॥
कुम्भान्पुनर्द्वादशधेनुयुक्तान्दौर्गत्ययुक्तः कुशलामथैकाम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.116.m: O son of Kuntī, having worshipped the fire on that occasion with clarified butter and milk-porridge, to an eminent brahmin / one should offer twelve pots accompanied by cows; but if afflicted by poverty, an efficient single one

4.116.s:
nivedayedbrāhmaṇapuṅgavāya haimīṃ ca dadyātpṛthivīṃ sasasyām ..
śaktyātha raupyāmatha vāpi tāmrīṃ paiṣṭīmaśakto vasudhāṃ vidhāya .. 13 ..
4.116.d:
निवेदयेद्ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवाय हैमीं च दद्यात्पृथिवीं ससस्याम् ॥
शक्त्याथ रौप्यामथ वापि ताम्रीं पैष्टीमशक्तो वसुधां विधाय ॥ 13 ॥
4.116.m: he should present to an eminent brahmin, and he should give a golden earth with crops, / or silver according to ability, or copper; or if unable, having fashioned an earth made of flour,

4.116.s:
sauvarṇasūryeṇa samaṃ pradadyānna vittaśāṭhyaṃ purupo'tra kuryāt ..
kurvannadho yāti narendracandrayāvanmahendra pramukhāḥ sureśāḥ .. 14 ..
4.116.d:
सौवर्णसूर्येण समं प्रदद्यान्न वित्तशाठ्यं पुरुपोऽत्र कुर्यात् ॥
कुर्वन्नधो याति नरेन्द्रचन्द्रयावन्महेन्द्र प्रमुखाः सुरेशाः ॥ 14 ॥
4.116.m: he should bestow it along with a golden sun; a man should not practise deceit regarding his wealth here. / One who does so goes downward, O moon among kings; as long as the lords of gods headed by Mahendra [endure],

4.116.s:
pṛthvī ca yāvatsakulācalā ca yāvacca sūryānilavahnicandrāḥ ..
tāvatsa gandharvakulairaśeṣaiḥ saṃpūjyate bhārata nākapṛṣṭhe .. .. 15 ..
4.116.d:
पृथ्वी च यावत्सकुलाचला च यावच्च सूर्यानिलवह्निचन्द्राः ॥
तावत्स गन्धर्वकुलैरशेषैः संपूज्यते भारत नाकपृष्ठे ॥ ॥ 15 ॥
4.116.m: and as long as the earth with its mountain ranges, and as long as the sun, wind, fire, and moon [endure], / so long is he worshipped by entire hosts of gandharvas in heaven, O Bhārata.

4.116.s:
tatastu karmakṣayamāpya saptadvīpādhipaḥ syātsukulaprasūtaḥ ..
divyaiḥ mukhairyuktavapuḥ sabhāryaḥ prasūtaputrānvayabandhuvargaḥ .. 16..
4.116.d:
ततस्तु कर्मक्षयमाप्य सप्तद्वीपाधिपः स्यात्सुकुलप्रसूतः ॥
दिव्यैः मुखैर्युक्तवपुः सभार्यः प्रसूतपुत्रान्वयबन्धुवर्गः ॥ 16॥
4.116.m: Then, having attained the exhaustion of his past deeds, born into a noble family, he becomes a sovereign of the seven continents, / his person endowed with divine features, accompanied by his wife, having begotten sons, a lineage, and a circle of kinfolk.

4.116.s:
iti paṭhati śṛṇoti yo'tibhaktyā vidhimakhilaṃ ravisaṃkrameṣu puṇyam ..
matimapi ca dadāti so'pi devairamarapatipramukhairmṛtastu pūjyaḥ .. 17 .. ..
viṣṭivratavarṇanam
4.116.d:
इति पठति शृणोति योऽतिभक्त्या विधिमखिलं रविसंक्रमेषु पुण्यम् ॥
मतिमपि च ददाति सोऽपि देवैरमरपतिप्रमुखैर्मृतस्तु पूज्यः ॥ 17 ॥ ॥
विष्टिव्रतवर्णनम्
4.116.m:
Whoever recites or hears with supreme devotion this entire meritorious rite on the transits of the sun, / and whoever also applies his mind [to it], when dead is worshipped by the gods, headed by the lord of the immortals.
Description of the Viṣṭi Votive Observance
